title: Design Director
description:
**Design Director** 




**Orangery® — Guildford, Surrey** 




**Full\-time · Hybrid · £62,000–£68,000** 




  





**\-\-\-\-** 




  





**We're a six\-person B\-Corp studio in Guildford looking for a Design Director. A senior, hands\-on creative who can take an idea, elevate it, and drive it through to work we're all proud to put our name on.** 




  





 Around half your time will be spent on a global sports brand moving into brand\-first, social\-first campaign work — brand guidelines, campaign toolkits, and regional and global rollouts. The other half is varied: rebrands, strategic design projects and campaigns for clients across technology and B2B.
 



  





 You'll work closely with our Executive Creative Director, and you'll direct our freelance bench of 2D, 3D, animation, film and photography specialists, setting the standard and holding the line on quality. There's real scope to get out on shoots, directing photography and video. We're genuinely collaborative — ideas come from everywhere here, and the best one wins regardless of who had it. Leadership is earned, and it's there to take.
 



  





 Everyone here is senior enough to manage their own work and their own diary, and is trusted to get on with it. No unnecessary layers, no agency politics.
 



  





 We're also early in our AI journey, building it into how we brief, research and produce. If that interests you, it's a good moment to join.
 



  





**The role** 




  




* Leading creative direction across brand and campaign work
* Developing campaign ideas that work across multiple channels — social\-first content through to print and environmental
* Building and evolving brand identities, visual systems, guidelines and campaign toolkits for regional and global rollout
* Directing our freelance bench, including film, video and photography direction and editing
* Quality\-checking work to both creative and technical standards before it leaves the studio
* Presenting and defending work directly to clients
* Bringing creative thinking into pitches and new business alongside the ECD



  





**What we're looking for** 




  




* Around 8\+ years in an agency or studio, with time at senior, lead or director level
* A portfolio strong on both concept and craft, showing brand and campaign work — and evidence of consistency across volume, not only one\-off showpieces
* Strong conceptual thinking: you generate original ideas rather than jumping straight to execution, and you can turn a complex brief into a clear creative narrative
* Brand strategy awareness — positioning, audiences, and connecting business objectives to creative solutions
* Fluency in social\-first, platform\-native campaign creative
* An exceptional eye for detail and strong typographic craft
* Confident with print artwork and production
* Experience briefing and directing freelancers — photographers, filmmakers, animators and other specialists
* Experience with high\-profile brands and/or complex campaign rollouts
* Figma as your day\-to\-day, alongside advanced Adobe CS. Motion skills an advantage



  





**A word on sport** 




  





 A meaningful part of this role is racket sports — tennis in particular. We're not just looking for a fan. We're looking for someone who can get properly under the skin of a subculture and make work that people inside it recognise as true. If that's tennis for you, brilliant. If you've done it with running, football, climbing, skate or music, we're just as interested.
 



  





**What we offer** 




  





**£62,000–£68,000 depending on experience, plus:** 




  




* Hybrid working — ideally 3 days a week in the Guildford studio, 2 remote
* 9–5\. No evenings, no weekend heroics
* Genuine autonomy — you manage your own diary
* Exposure to a major global sports brand, alongside work in technology and B2B
* Structured personal development and training
* Pension scheme and salary sacrifice EV scheme
* Birthday day off and volunteer days
* Carbon reduction commitments and regular team culture days
* As a B\-Corp studio, we look for people who share our commitment to responsible, thoughtful ways of working.



  





**Apply** 




  






 We value thoughtful, genuine applications that reflect your own experience and perspective. This helps us understand how you think and approach your work, which is more important to us than polished or generic responses.
 




  






 Please send your
 
**CV and a link to your portfolio** 

 to
 
**careers@orangerycreative.com** 




  






 We're committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences and perspectives, and we believe this makes our work and our business stronger.

title: Creative Director
description:
Condé Nast is one of the world's most renowned media publishing companies, creating and distributing every type of media today, spanning print and digital publishing in all formats. With a portfolio of some of today's most influential brands, the company continues to grow its audience through a global operational and content infrastructure across its 12 owned and operated markets. Headquartered in New York City, the company's owned and operated markets include China, France, Germany, India, Italy, Japan, Mexico \& Latin America, Spain, Taiwan, UAE/Dubai, the U.K., and the U.S., with additional local license partners in over twenty additional markets across the globe. Lead brands include Vogue, The New Yorker, GQ, Architectural Digest, Condé Nast Traveler, Vanity Fair, Wired, Allure, Ars Technica, Bon Appétit, House \& Garden, Pitchfork, Tatler, and Vogue Business.
   

  

**Job Description**
 Location:
   

  

 London, GB
   

  

 Condé Nast is a global media company, home to iconic brands including Vogue, GQ, Glamour, CN Traveller, Vanity Fair, Wired, The World of Interiors, House \& Garden and Tatler, among many others.
   

  

 We are headquartered in New York and London and operate in 32 markets worldwide, with a footprint of more than 1 billion consumers across print, digital, video and social platforms.
   

  

 Condé Nast thrives on collaboration, and our teams come together in the office four days a week (Monday \- Thursday).
   

  

 We value diversity of background, views and cultures. We celebrate people for their personal qualities, skills and contributions, recognising the power our brands have to influence and shape culture.
   

  

 Condé Nast is a global media company producing the highest quality content with a footprint of more than 1 billion consumers in 32 territories through print, digital, video and social platforms. The company’s portfolio includes many of the world’s most respected and influential media properties including Vogue, Vanity Fair, Glamour, Self, GQ, The New Yorker, Condé Nast Traveler/Traveller, Allure, AD, Bon Appétit and Wired, among others.
   

  

 Based in our London office, this role helps to set the creative vision and leads the overarching delivery of global and UK branded content, advertiser partnerships, and brand marketing across Condé Nast’s editorial portfolio. As a culturally attuned, conceptual leader, you will drive 360° creative strategy that connects brands to culture at scale. You bring a track record of editorially inspired work, natural mentorship, and the capability to deputise for the Executive Creative Director—aiding in guiding the department vision, setting creative standards, and inspiring the wider team.
   

  

 Reporting to the Executive Creative Director, you will partner with senior marketing, strategy, and sales leaders to shape major commercial opportunities, pitch transformative partnership ideas, and oversee cross\-departmental execution with editorial teams. Success requires visionary storytelling, deep commercial strategy, and a sharp cultural perspective. The Creative Director oversees overall portfolio output, establishing the creative direction and directing senior talent on high\-stakes, multi\-platform briefs—from global luxury video campaigns to multi\-market event sponsorships.
   

  

 You excel at guiding cross\-functional teams through complex, fast\-paced workflows, bringing executive\-level problem\-solving and strategic clarity to every meeting. The ideal candidate ensures creative excellence while safeguarding Condé Nast’s brand authority, creative standards, and journalistic integrity across all commercial initiatives.
   

  

 Individual \& Team Responsibilities
   

  

* Develop bold multi\-channel creative work that reflects the voice and ethos of all Condé Nast titles for advertisers across categories.
* Assign, collaborate with and direct the work of multi\-disciplinary creatives suitable for each project (art directors, designers, etc).
* Apply strategic insights in order to craft inventive content, experiential solutions, and partnership ideas that align with audience data, brand ethos, and client objectives.
* Direct video and photo shoots with a focus on performance and editorial quality.
* Serve as the primary creative client liaison on campaigns—presenting work, managing feedback, and guiding creative integrity across production.
* Drive brainstorms and work hands\-on when crafting proposals and presentations.
* Propose creative solutions that fit within the provided budgets.
* Ensure all commercial ideas authentically balance the voices and perspectives of our editorial brands with those of our advertising partners.
* Help build a thriving creative department; nurture talent, establish workflow efficiencies, and champion inclusive, forward\-thinking creative culture.
* Deputise for the Executive Creative Director across key business forums, internal leadership meetings, and executive client pitches.


**Essential Skills \& Requirements**
* 10\+ years of experience as a creative lead in premium media or agency environments.
* A demonstrated appreciation for the subject matter and creativity of the brands you’ll represent at Condé Nast.
* Confidence working with and directing artists, experts, celebrities and creators as talent on commercial projects.
* Strong portfolio showcasing work across print, digital, video and events.
* Passion for brand marketing, with a sharp cultural perspective that informs consumer\-facing campaigns.
* Skilled storyteller with excellent written, visual, and verbal presentation abilities.
* Extensive on\-set experience and deep knowledge of video and photography production, from pre\- to post\-production (for digital and print).
* Demonstrated success managing creative teams and working within established systems to improve output and efficiency.
* A creative aesthetic emphasizing current standards in entertainment, fashion, luxury and design.
* Highly organized, adaptable and adept at prioritizing workloads in fast\-paced environments.
* Ability to work fluently with collaborators in production \- writers, DPs, photographers, editors, animators, and designers.
* Proficiency in Google Slides and treatment deck creation. Bonus: familiarity with Adobe Creative Suite and editing software.


**Desired Qualities**
* Culturally informed \- Current on music and entertainment, luxury and fashion, as well as knowledgeable about Condé Nast brands and culture. Additionally, have awareness of relevant artists, and creative vendors.
* Highly imaginative \- You’re a conceptual creative with innovative ideas that challenge outdated approaches to content and the definition of “experiential.”
* Detail\-oriented \- Equally obsessed with creating memorable work and impactful campaigns that solve our client’s challenges.
* Agile and adaptable \- Open to taking input from others and willing to take on essential tasks needed to get the job done.
* Think critically \- You strive to come up with ideas that solve brand challenges, can manage multiple projects at once, and know when to pivot if something isn’t working.
* Have an ego\-less attitude \- You give credit where credit is due, bring a positive attitude to work and support your teammates in gaining visibility and opportunities.
* A natural mentor \- You prioritize diversity, inclusivity, and representation in every stage of the creative process and empathy in team collaboration.


 What benefits do we offer?
   

  

* 25 days holiday (plus bank holidays) and extra days of annual leave if you move house or want to volunteer.
* You’ll have access to a competitive pension scheme, Bupa Private Healthcare, Season ticket loans and eye tests.
* We offer a range of tools to support your wellbeing, including core hours, 10 remote days (from home or a country with a Condé Nast office location), access to our Employee Assistance Programme, corporate gym membership and cycle to work scheme.
* We’re a dog\-friendly office, plus you’ll enjoy discounts and magazine subscriptions, keeping you up to date with all things Condé Nast.
* We encourage personal and professional growth through the Condé Nast Learning Hub, where you’ll find an extensive portfolio of learning courses and training available in local languages.
* Our Employee Resource Groups provide a platform for employees to identify shared objectives, exchange ideas, and work on community priorities for our global workforce.


**What happens next?**
 If you are interested in this opportunity, please apply below, and we will review your application as soon as possible. You can update your resume or upload a cover letter at any time by accessing your candidate profile.
   

  

***Condé Nast is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, age, familial status and other legally protected characteristics.***

title: Creative Director, Brand Studio
description:
**About GitHub**
 GitHub is the world’s leading platform for agentic software development — powered by Copilot to build, scale, and deliver secure software. Over 180 million developers, including more than 90% of the Fortune 100 companies, use GitHub to collaborate, and more than 77,000 organisations have adopted GitHub Copilot.
   

  

**Locations**
 In this role you can work from Remote, United States
   

  

**Overview**
 GitHub is looking for a Creative Director to lead our Brand Studio, our world class creative design team responsible for shaping how GitHub shows up in the world.
   

  

 This team creates the visual identity and creative systems behind GitHub’s most important marketing moments, from global events and product launches to executive presentations, social content, blog storytelling, motion, illustration, and beyond. The work is highly visible, deeply cross\-functional, and central to how developers, customers, and Hubbers experience the GitHub brand.
   

  

 We’re looking for a creative leader who can guide a world\-class team without over\-directing it. Someone who understands how to translate executive priorities, brand strategy, product narratives, and business needs into clear creative direction. The ideal candidate will protect focus, raise the bar, and help the team do its best work, not by getting into every pixel, but by creating the conditions for great creative to happen.
   

  

 This role reports to the VP of Global Brand \& Marketing and will lead a tight\-knit, high\-functioning team of brand designers, motion designers, illustrators, and presentation designers.
   

  

 What success looks like:
   

  

 The right Creative Director will help GitHub’s Brand Studio continue to operate at a world\-class level while giving the team sharper focus, stronger connective tissue, and clearer creative direction.
   

  

 They will not be expected to reinvent a high\-functioning team from scratch. Instead, they will help the studio scale its impact: interpreting the needs of the business, protecting the craft, strengthening the brand system, and ensuring GitHub’s creative work feels unmistakably GitHub—whether it appears on a keynote stage, in a campaign, on social, in a product launch, or inside a deck for our most senior leaders.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead GitHub’s Brand Studio team, providing clear creative direction, strong people leadership, and thoughtful prioritization across a broad range of marketing and brand work.
* Translate business, brand, product, and executive signals into compelling creative strategy and actionable direction for the team.
* Partner closely with Brand Strategy \& Narrative, Integrated Growth Marketing, Product Marketing, Events, Communications, Social, Web, Brand Experience, and executive stakeholders to ensure the GitHub brand is showing up with clarity, consistency, and creative excellence.
* Guide the development of visual systems for campaigns, events, launches, executive storytelling, social moments, editorial content, presentations, and other high\-impact brand experiences.
* Protect the team’s focus by helping sort signal from noise, clarify priorities, manage stakeholder expectations, and ensure the studio is working on the highest\-value creative opportunities.
* Champion the GitHub visual identity, ensuring the brand remains distinct, modern, developer\-authentic, and creatively ambitious.
* Evolve scalable creative systems, templates, guidelines, and design practices that allow the brand to travel consistently across teams, channels, and regions.
* Maintain the team’s culture grounded in trust, craft, collaboration, experimentation, and high standards.
* Coach and develop a talented team of creative specialists, helping each person grow their impact while preserving the autonomy and creative energy that make the studio special.
* Partner with external agencies, freelancers, and production partners when needed, ensuring outside work meets GitHub’s creative bar and brand standards.
* Work closely with the Brand Experience (site) team to ensure the brand is clear, cohesive, and compelling across all web and product surfaces.


**Qualifications**
**Required Qualifications:**
* 12\+ years experience in product or brand design
+ OR Bachelor's Degree in Industrial, Graphic or Motion Design, Product Design, Human Computer Interaction, or related field AND 10\+ years experience in product or brand design
+ OR Master's Degree in Industrial, Graphic or Motion Design, Product Design, Human Computer Interaction, or related field AND 8\+ years experience in product or brand design
+ OR Doctorate in Industrial, Graphic or Motion Design, Product Design, Human Computer Interaction, or related field AND 6\+ years experience in product or brand design
+ OR equivalent experience.

* 5\+ years designing brand systems, visual identity, creative production, and how design scales across marketing channels and organizational needs.
* 5\+ years people management experience


**Preferred Qualifications:**
* A genuine curiosity about developers, software, AI, open source, and GitHub’s role in shaping the future of how the world builds.
* Strong stakeholder management instincts, including the ability to push back with diplomacy, protect creative quality, and keep teams focused.
* Experience partnering across marketing, product, events, communications, web, and executive teams.
* Proven ability to lead senior creative talent without micromanaging. Setting direction, sharpening ideas, and raising the bar while giving teams room to do their best work.
* Ability to balance creative ambition with business realities, timelines, resources, and operational constraints.


**Compensation Range**
 The base salary range for this job is USD $140,400\.00 \- USD $372,300\.00 /Yr.
   

  

 These pay ranges are intended to cover roles based across the United States. An individual's base pay depends on various factors including geographical location and review of experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant. At GitHub certain roles are eligible for benefits and additional rewards, including annual bonus and stock. These rewards are allocated based on individual impact in role. In addition, certain roles also have the opportunity to earn sales incentives based on revenue or utilization, depending on the terms of the plan and the employee's role.
   

  

 This position will be open for a minimum of 3 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.
   

  

**GitHub values**
* Customer\-obsessed
* Ship to learn
* Growth mindset
* Own the outcome
* Better together
* Diverse and inclusive


**Manager fundamentals**
* Model
* Coach
* Care


**Leadership principles**
* Create clarity
* Generate energy
* Deliver success


**Who We Are**
 GitHub is the world’s leading AI\-powered developer platform with 150 million developers and counting. We’re also home to the biggest open\-source community on earth (and 99% of the world’s software has open\-source code in its DNA). Many of the apps and programs you use every day are built on GitHub.
   

  

 Our teams are dreamers, doers, and pioneers, leading the way in AI, driving humanitarian efforts around the globe, and even sending open source to Mars (and beyond!). At GitHub, our goal is to create the space you need to do your best work. We’re remote\-first and offer competitive pay, generous learning and growth opportunities, and excellent benefits to support you, wherever you are—because we know that people flourish when they can work on their own terms.
   

  

 Join us, and let’s change the world, together.

description:
**About Us**
 Circle is building the world’s leading AI\-powered, all\-in\-one platform for digital businesses. We make it possible for creators, coaches, educators, and businesses to bring together their audience with engaging discussions, live streams, events, chat, courses, and payments — all in one place, all under their own brand.
   

  

 We’re proud to be a fully remote company of around 270 (and growing!) team members from 30\+ countries around the world. We seek exceptional individuals around the world, set them up to do the best work of their lives, and in turn, create a meaningful impact in their own lives. We don't track hours, but we do manage for high expectations very closely. We collaborate across time zones, are highly async, and like to document a lot.
   

  

 Twice a year, we bring the whole company together in beautiful places around the world for our company offsites. So far, we’ve hosted offsites in Turkey, Portugal, Mexico, Thailand, Colombia, Italy, Ireland, and more, with still more to come!
   

  

 Check out our
 **Careers** 
 page for more about working at Circle.
   

  

**About The Role**
**We’re excited to bring on Circle’s first Creative Director.**
 This is a unique opportunity to shape how Circle shows up in the world, and define the story of a generational company building the future of digital businesses.
   

  

 We’re looking for an exceptional creative storyteller who can help us develop strong, consistent narratives across everything Circle puts into the world: product launches, campaigns, ads, landing pages, announcements, partnerships, events, and more.
   

  

 You obsess over the power of a great narrative. You believe every word, visual, and detail matters. You have an exceptionally high creative bar, thrive in highly collaborative environments, and know how to influence people through the quality of the work itself.
   

  

 As Circle’s first Creative Director, you’ll first and foremost act as a creative extension of the founders. You will turn their ideas, product strategy, and company vision into narratives that are clear, memorable, and unmistakably Circle across all our assets.
   

  

 On a day\-to\-day basis, you’ll work closely with Circle’s founders and across our in\-house design studio, product marketing, paid media, video, and events teams to elevate our storytelling and creative execution across every major moment.
   

  

**Your goal is to help make Circle one of the most creatively distinct and definitive companies in the category of digital businesses.**
**What You'll Be Doing**
* Shape Circle’s narrative. Work closely with Circle’s founders to synthesize, sharpen, and evolve the story behind our long\-term vision, and translate it into clear, compelling narratives that can travel across everything we do.
* Own the creative direction of our biggest launches and campaigns. Find the angle, develop the brief, shape the story, and obsess over how we make each moment stand out. You’ll partner closely with Product Marketing across launches, announcements, demos, and enablement to ensure everything feels cohesive, intentional, and unmistakably Circle. Doing this well requires developing a deep understanding of our product, customers, and market.
* Be a deeply embedded creative marketing partner to our design studio. You’ll work especially closely with our Design Studio, which is led by one of Circle’s co\-founders and won’t report to you. Success here involves shared taste, mutual trust, healthy creative tension, and the ability to move quickly together. You’ll occasionally lead external agencies as well — and when the moment calls for it, write the high\-stakes copy yourself: the headline, manifesto, launch script, or line someone delivers on stage.
* Raise the bar on our advertising and creative campaigns. Develop the concepts and narratives behind Circle’s ad creative, partnering up our Paid Acquisition team to turn them into high\-performing campaigns. They’ll bring the channel and media\-buying expertise; while you can make sure the creative is worth paying to distribute.
* Direct how our stories come to life across video and events. Get hands\-on with scripts, structure, pacing, and narrative for launch films, social, ads, virtual summits, and other major moments. You won’t be editing videos or producing events yourself, but you’ll understand the craft well enough to have strong opinions about what works in each medium, and collaborate deeply with the specialists who bring it to life.
* Influence the narrative behind brand experiences people remember across our webinars, virtual summits, conferences, and live events to align with company brand vision. This includes everything from the theme and programming to the booth, talks, slides, copy, and small details nobody else would think to obsess over.
* Turn partnerships into stories. Work with our Partnerships team to make more of our collaborations with creators and customers into stories we can distribute across our channels. You can help develop the concept, framing, name, narrative, and creative execution behind our biggest partnerships, and helping our partners tell those stories powerfully themselves.


**What We're Looking For**
* A body of work you’re genuinely proud of. We care far more about what you’ve made than the titles you’ve held or the number of years you’ve been doing it. You should be able to walk us through your best work piece by piece: the problem, the idea, the choices you made, what you personally contributed, and ultimately, whether it worked.
* Exceptional creative taste and judgment. You know great work when you see it, can articulate why it’s great, and have the conviction to push work until it gets there. Just as importantly, you know when an idea is trying too hard, when something is off\-brand, and when your own fingerprints are making the work worse rather than better.
* You’re an exceptional storyteller and writer. You can take something complicated and find the simple, compelling story inside it. You care deeply about language and will happily obsess over a headline, a launch narrative, or a single line of copy until it feels inevitable.
* A strong point of view, and the ability to make it better through collaboration. We don’t want someone who waits for a brief and executes it. We want someone who can tell us what the brief should be, challenge the premise when necessary, elevate ideas coming from the team and our founders, and make a compelling case for a different direction.
* Real fluency in video as a creative medium. You don’t need to shoot, edit, animate, or produce. But you should deeply understand what makes video work, from the script and opening seconds to structure, pacing, emotion, and payoff. You should also understand why a great launch film, social video, customer story, and paid ad require very different creative choices.
* Experience making creative that has to perform. You’ve developed ads and campaigns where the work was ultimately accountable to results. You’ve seen the numbers, learned from them, iterated because of them, and know how to partner with paid acquisition teams without allowing performance marketing to turn into boring marketing.
* An instinct for getting attention without going off script. You understand how to make a brand noticeable, surprising, and culturally relevant without chasing attention for its own sake. Ideally, you can show us a creative risk you fought for that worked, and another you talked the room out of because it wasn’t right for the brand.
* The ability to lead through influence, not hierarchy. There’s no large creative organization reporting to you. Much of your impact will come from getting exceptional work out of designers, marketers, writers, video producers, agencies, and founders who don’t report to you. You know how to raise the creative bar without becoming a bottleneck.
* A great eye for design and deep respect for the craft. You don’t need to be a designer, but you should be able to work shoulder\-to\-shoulder with exceptional ones. Our Design Studio is led by a co\-founder and operates with a very high bar; you’ll need the visual taste, vocabulary, and collaborative instincts to be a trusted creative partner to that team.
* Experience working closely with founders. You’re comfortable working with founders who care deeply about the product, brand, and details. You will need to extract the vision, challenge it when needed, and turn it into something better than either of you would have arrived at independently.
* An obsession with understanding what how to tell the world about we do and why it matters. The best creative work here will come from understanding Circle at a deep level: our product, customers, competitors, category, and where the market is going. You should genuinely enjoy developing that level of context rather than treating it as somebody else’s job.
* Exceptional communication skills. Circle is global, remote, and highly asynchronous. You’ll need outstanding written and verbal English (CEFR C2 or equivalent), and the ability to make your thinking clear enough that great work can move forward even when everyone isn’t in the same room.


**Compensation \& Benefits**
 Circle offers U.S.\-benchmarked compensation globally, equity in the company with ongoing refresh grants, and 35 days of paid time off each year.
   

  

 We’re a remote\-only team that comes together twice a year for company retreats in incredible destinations around the world. Alongside incredible flexibility and autonomy, we offer a benefits package that supports health, wellbeing, and professional growth. Learn more in our Candidate Hub.

* Visit our Candidate Hub to learn more about working at Circle, our benefits, and our hiring process.

description:
**ABOUT US** 




  





 Eostier is a brand group building consumer brands with fully in\-house teams, operating at a $20M\+ annual run rate. This role sits on our new health\-focused supplement brand.
 



 The forecast: mid 8 figures with nine figures within reach. This is one of the first dedicated creative hires on the team that will grow with us.
 



  





**THE ROLE** 




  





 We're looking for an AI focused Creative Director to own the visual side of every ad we run. Not execution, ideation. You're the person who decides what an ad actually shows: the 3D and 2D animation, the b\-roll, the clip concepts, and you make sure it never looks like the last one.
 



  





 This is a hands\-on, ideas\-first role. B\-roll is yours end to end: you come up with what to show and generate it yourself, then hand editors a finished clip to drop into the ad. You already know claymation, Pixar\-style, song ads, and whatever else is working right now, cold, or this isn't for you.
 



  





 For those specialty formats, you write the SOP so editors can execute them without you in the room. Everything else, you're hands\-on: generating the b\-roll visuals and reviewing the 3 editors' work before anything ships.
 



  





**The workflow:**
 a scriptwriter writes the ad. You come up with what the ad should show and how. For specialty formats you make the SOP so the editors can execute it properly.

 animation from inside the vessel, a

 animation inside the vessel and
 
 more diversity especially on the mechanism explanation
 
 during the ad

* Write SOPs for executing specific formats so the video editors can run with your concepts without you in the room
* Manage and review the video editors' work before anything ships. You're the last check that an ad is actually good to go
* Stay ahead of trends: burner accounts on social and the Facebook Ads Library, both for new formats and for how other brands execute and diversify their own visuals
* Test new AI models and workflows regularly so output stays realistic and the outputs gets faster over time

* Strong visual ideation, not just execution. You come up with what to show, not just how to render it
* Comfortable managing and giving direct feedback to a small team of editors
* Obsessive about accuracy: visuals need to match the script, not just look good on their own
* Bonus if you're already using AI tools and workflows to move faster and automate parts of the process

title: Creative Director- Interior Design
description:
1\.1 The Creative Director is the custodian of EVA Interiors’ creative vision, design quality, and aesthetic integrity across all interior design, architectural, and FF\&E outputs.
 



 1\.2 The role exists to institutionalize creativity at EVA Interiors by transforming creative vision into clear standards, guidelines, and governance frameworks, ensuring consistency, excellence, and repeatable quality at scale.
 



 1\.3 The Creative Director ensures that EVA’s creative output reflects a luxury positioning that is innovative, disciplined, commercially viable, and execution\-ready, while continuously evolving to remain relevant and distinctive in the market.
 



  





**2\.1 Creative Vision, Guidelines \& Governance** 



* The Creative Director defines, documents, and continuously refines EVA Interiors’ creative philosophy and design language, ensuring that spatial principles, material hierarchy, detailing standards, colour strategies, and FF\&E integration are formalised within approved governance frameworks.
* The role ensures that all creative outputs demonstrably comply with documented standards, and that any deviation is formally identified, evaluated, and addressed through structured corrective governance mechanisms rather than informal tolerance.
* The Creative Director maintains executive oversight of all design\-related SOPs to ensure sustained alignment between creative integrity, structured workflows, and disciplined project execution.
* Creative standards shall be applied consistently across all projects and shall be subject to continuous refinement informed by documented review outcomes, performance analysis, and institutional learning.



**2\.2 Measurable Creative Output \& First Time\-Right Accountability** 



* The Creative Director is accountable for ensuring that creative leadership translates into measurable, predictable, and disciplined quality outcomes.
* A minimum first\-submission approval rate of (80%) shall be maintained across formal design reviews, unless deviations are supported by documented root cause analysis and clearly defined corrective action plans.
* Review cycles shall remain within agreed revision thresholds. Recurrent rework patterns shall trigger structured evaluation, accountability review, and systemic improvement measures rather than normalization.
* All scheduled creative reviews constitute mandatory leadership obligations. Attendance shall be maintained consistently. In cases of unavoidable absence, formal delegation of documented decision authority shall be established in advance. Any missed review shall require written explanation and rescheduling within (24\) hours.
* Approvals, rejections, and required design modifications shall be communicated within agreed review timelines to prevent avoidable production delays or adverse impact on project revenue realization, forecast integrity, or client confidence.
* Review feedback and formal approval decisions shall be issued within (24\) hours of the review session unless otherwise formally justified in writing.
* Creative authority within EVA shall operate as a performance accelerator and governance safeguard, never as a constraint on disciplined production.



**2\.3 Structured Review Cadence \& Institutional Discipline** 



* The Creative Director is responsible for maintaining a defined, documented, and consistently executed creative governance rhythm across the organization.
* At minimum, one structured Creative Review session shall be led weekly, and one formal Quality Retrospective shall be conducted monthly. Each session shall produce documented minutes, clearly assigned accountability, and tracked follow\-up actions.
* Recurring quality deviations, review inefficiencies, or creative inconsistencies shall be translated into updated guidelines, strengthened enforcement protocols, or revised governance standards.
* Creative governance within EVA shall be cyclical, documented, and continuously reinforced to ensure institutional maturity and sustained quality performance.



**2\.4 Commercial Alignment \& Revenue Protection** 



* The Creative Director is accountable for ensuring that creative decisions are aligned with approved project timelines, revenue realization schedules, forecast commitments, and overall project profitability.
* The Creative Director shall collaborate with Planning and Operations to ensure that creative timelines and review cycles are realistically reflected in revenue forecasts, milestone commitments, and execution sequencing.
* Creative refinement shall not introduce avoidable delays that negatively affect revenue progression, cash flow timing, forecast accuracy, or client confidence.
* Where creative ambition presents potential timeline, cost, or commercial exposure, such implications shall be proactively identified, formally evaluated, and resolved in coordination with project leadership and Executive Management.
* Design excellence within EVA is expected to unlock commercial value while preserving disciplined control over schedule, cost, and revenue integrity.



**2\.5 Escalation \& Risk Management Obligation** 



* Any creative, quality, review\-related, or design governance issue that may materially impact project timelines, revenue realization, client confidence, or brand reputation shall be escalated to Executive Management within (24\) hours.
* Escalation shall include a documented impact assessment, root cause analysis, and proposed mitigation strategy.
* No material creative risk shall remain unaddressed, undocumented, or without executive visibility.



**2\.6 Enforcement Authority \& Team Performance Accountability** 



* The Creative Director is responsible for enforcing compliance with approved design standards, governance frameworks, and review discipline across all design personnel.
* Where repeated non\-compliance, quality deviation, review absence, or execution inconsistency occurs, the Creative Director shall initiate structured corrective action in coordination with Executive Management and Human Resources.
* Delegation of responsibilities does not eliminate accountability for creative outcomes. Enforcement authority is inherent to the role and integral to its seniority, Sustained failure to meet defined governance cadence, revision thresholds, escalation timelines, or documented enforcement obligations shall constitute performance non\-compliance and shall be subject to formal performance review in accordance with company policy.



**2\.7 Innovation \& Strategic Creative Development** 



* The Creative Director leads structured innovation initiatives designed to enhance differentiation, strengthen quality standards, and improve execution efficiency.
* Innovation must be practical, buildable, commercially responsible, and clearly linked to brand positioning or project value.
* Creative experimentation must be governed, documented, and selectively integrated into live projects where appropriate.



**2\.8 FF\&E Library Governance \& Design Asset Control** 



* The Creative Director holds strategic ownership of EVA’s FF\&E Library and ensures that it remains curated, quality\-controlled, commercially viable, and aligned with EVA’s luxury positioning.
* All additions shall meet defined standards of originality, feasibility, execution readiness, and brand coherence.
* The FF\&E Library shall function as an active production, quality\-control, and creative governance asset supporting consistency and efficiency across projects.



**2\.9 Leadership Presence \& Accessibility** 



* The Creative Director is expected to maintain consistent on\-site leadership presence during critical review cycles, high\-visibility project phases, and production\-intensive periods.
* Leadership availability and accessibility are structural expectations of the role. Remote work arrangements shall not compromise review cadence, enforcement discipline, team accessibility, or executive responsiveness and require formal approval in accordance with company policy.
* Creative leadership within EVA requires visible authority, sustained engagement, and operational presence commensurate with the seniority of the role.



  





**Please share your CV and your portfolio to hrhead@evainteriors.ae**

 You own creative from the first client call to the last day on set. That means running the pre\-production call, diagnosing the right format instead of taking the order, writing the creative document, and handling shoot day logistics.

 Not a producer role. Not a place to build a reel of things nobody asked for.

 Intro call, then a working session. We will give you a real intake transcript and 45 minutes, and ask for a shotlist and an interview question set. Then a conversation about a format recommendation you would have to defend.
 



  





 $80\-$100k. Health, Dental, PTO.

Eterniti is the leading operator of vacation rentals in iconic holiday destinations, led by a passion for excellence, authentic adventures, and hospitality. With over €2 billion in assets under management, we operate 800\+ chalets, villas and apartments under 3 consumer brands: Emerald Stay (our 4\* brand), Bo House (our 5\* brand) and Verbier Exclusive (our Palace brand). Our guests can discover our properties in more than 25 exceptional destinations across Europe and North America. We are a fast\-growing company generating around €100M in annual revenue, backed by more than €50M raised from top\-tier investors. Join us at a pivotal moment, with the ambition and the means to keep raising the bar.  

  

We are looking for a talented **part\-time People Director (50\-60%)** to join our dynamic team, at our Barcelona office. In this role, you will be exposed to an international group spanning various business units, where your ability to protect and nurture our culture and to excel at recruitment will be absolutely key to your success.

 **RESPONSIBILITIES**  

  

**Strategic HR \& business partnering**

* Act as HR Business Partner for all companies in the group.
* Ensure HR monitoring and compliance.
* Be accountable for the OKRs process, together with our Chief of Staff.
* Run the annual employee survey and propose an annual HR plan based on the results.
* Own, monitor and act on the people dashboards to steer performance across destinations.
* Prepare the people slides for our board meetings.

**Culture, communication \& engagement**

* Be the guardian of our group's culture.
* Lead HR and internal communication projects (internal newsletters, AI trainings, Learning \& Development, etc.).
* Organise and host our annual offsite for the Eterniti and Emerald Stay team.

**Talent acquisition \& development**

* Oversee recruitment and training.
* Participate in team members' onboardings and offboardings.
* Deliver individual training sessions (e.g. presentation or communication skills).
* Help managers develop their coaching and mentoring skills.

**Team management, entities \& tools**

* Manage two HR team members.
* Complete the HR integration with the Jewels (acquired companies).
* Handle key individual HR matters and HR situations that escalate.
* Be accountable for our HR tools: JazzHR and Skello.


Depending on priorities as well as your bandwidth, skills and interest, you may be involved in other projects, in line with your qualifications.

 **KEY INFORMATION**

* Employment start: as soon as possible.
* Reporting to the CEO (Maxime Friess) and COO (Laurent Lacourt).
* Position based in Barcelona.
* Occasional travel across our entities and destinations, as needed
* Permanent contract (indefinite Spanish contract)
* Part\-time position: 20 to 24 hours / week (i.e 50%\-60%). Workdays will be Tuesdays and Wednesdays (at the office), plus another half\-day or weekday to be confirmed (home office possible).
* The application journey has 5 key steps:
	+ Step 1: screening call for selected candidates.
	+ Step 2: case study.
	+ Step 3: video interview with our Chief People Officer and our HR Manager.
	+ Step 4: video interview with our COO.
	+ Step 5: video interview with our CEO.
	+ Step 6: references check.

 **ABOUT YOU**

**We’d love to hear from you if…**

* You have solid senior HR / People experience, ideally across several entities or countries: at least 5 years.
* You are an entrepreneur at heart and have prior experience at a fast\-growing startup \- we expect you to be proactive and constructive at all times; you thrive in a fast\-paced environment.
* You combine strategic HR business partnering with a hands\-on, get\-things\-done approach.
* You are a natural people leader who builds trust and handles confidential matters with discretion.
* You have a good working knowledge of labour and employment frameworks (France and Spain a plus).
* You are comfortable steering with data, dashboards and KPIs, and strong with digital tools.
* You speak (and write) French and English fluently; Spanish is a plus.
* You can work in the EU without visa sponsorship.

**ABOUT US**


We offer a work environment that values and empowers people while fostering personal development. Our culture is dictated by the following values :

* **Make Mistakes** \- We foster a creative environment where the best ideas win, where it is okay to make mistakes and unacceptable not to learn from them.
* **Question** \- We don't accept the status quo and look for ways to leverage technology while empowering people.
* **Speak Up** \- We are true people who give honest feedback, who are not afraid to share opinions and who don't talk behind one's back.
* **Think Big** \- While staying humble, we aim for the stars and work towards established goals and metrics.
* **Don’t Compromise** \- We are obsessed with quality, like a Swiss watchmaker.
* **Care** \- We care about our team members, our partners and our clients, and make our passion and our work one and the same.


We are demanding \- everyone really counts at Eterniti. But keep in mind that we value hard work and give growth opportunities to those who deserve it. We want you to grow with the company.  

  

*We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to thrive. All qualified applicants will be considered without regard to any characteristic unrelated to their skills and experience.*

**Oh, we’ve got perks...**

* **Flexible work environment**: we have a flexible home office policy; you'll work at the office on Tuesdays and Wednesdays, the rest of the time, it's up to you. Feeling like working with another view? We offer 15 days yearly of remote work from wherever you’d like
* **Flexible benefits**: you’ll get a card to spend on what matters most to you: food, transport, or health insurance to optimize your net income
* **Discount on Emerald stays**, during specific periods, on selected properties
* **Regular team outings and events**: because work is fun when you’re part of an awesome team
* **External coaching**: for supervisor level and above \- we believe and invest in you
* **Anniversary perks**

 **Ready to join?**

### **If you're willing to bring your creativity, passion for service, and high\-energy vibe to Eterniti, we want to hear from you. Apply today and let's start this exciting journey together!**

title: Associate Director, Biostatistics - IQVIA Biotech (m/w/d)
description:
Barcelona, Spain \| Full time \| Home\-based \| R1566436


  
**Job Description**
-------------------


IQVIA Biotech has an exciting position within its EU Biostats team. As the Biotech and Emerging Biopharma arm of IQVIA, we continue to grow and win new business. Historically IQVIA Biotech focused on Oncology, Dermatology and Medical Device studies but with the addition of CNS, Immunology and Cardiovascular we have a need for a strong Lead Statistician.


We're looking for enthusiastic and independent professionals with great communication skills who are willing to work from home with an international team. This is the perfect opportunity to join an established department and develop leadership skills.


IQVIA Biotech specialises in working with smaller biotech and emerging biopharma clients and as such we have a vibrant, fast\-paced work environment. You'll be working with a lot of the new innovative and upcoming research groups across a variety of therapy areas.


The ideal candidate will possess extensive oncology drug development experience across a broad range of oncology indications, with demonstrated expertise in applying advanced statistical methodologies throughout the clinical development lifecycle.


They should have the technical expertise to provide senior\-level statistical review and oversight of Statistical Analysis Plans (SAPs), ADaM specifications and datasets, Tables, Listings, and Figures (TLFs), and other key study deliverables, ensuring scientific rigor, quality, and consistency across programs.


The candidate will be an effective people leader with a proven ability to mentor, develop, and support biostatistical staff across global regions, including Europe and JPAC.


Strong customer engagement and relationship management skills are essential, including the ability to serve as a trusted statistical advisor to emerging biopharma customers who may have limited experience with clinical development, regulatory requirements, and statistical considerations.


The successful candidate will also have experience supporting regulatory submissions and interacting with regulatory agencies. Experience participating in and leading bid defense meetings is expected, along with the ability to coach and develop future Statistical Team Leads by strengthening their customer\-facing, business development, and presentation skills.


### **ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS, DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**


* Collaborate with internal program staff and sponsors on the implementation and analysis of statistical aspects of research protocols.
* Provide statistical consultation for clinical programs, including but not limited to protocol development, randomization, sample size assessments, efficacy evaluations, and data review.
* Define and manage project timelines for specific projects, and ensure that project timelines are met for both internal and external clients.
* Ensure that project tasks are completed with superior quality for both internal and external clients.
* Review, approve and develop, as needed, the statistical analysis summary and analysis plans, including textual description of planned analysis and mock\-ups of data displays.
* Oversee and/or perform statistical analyses, including hypothesis testing and modeling.
* Interact with Medical Writers to ensure appropriateness of data inferences and/or write pertinent sections of a clinical study report.
* Interface with clients and/or regulatory agencies as the project biostatistician.
* Ability to oversee a program of studies.
* Assist the Manager and Sr. Director in defining and maintaining departmental standards, SOPs and working practices.
* Provide leadership, mentoring and statistical support for Biostatistics staff.
* Assist the Manager and Sr. Director in development of training materials and execution of training in Biostatistics and general Clinical Reporting activities, for new and existing Clinical Reporting staff.
* Make presentations to clients and other interested individuals about the processes and procedures of the Clinical Reporting department.
* Assist the Manager in the coordination of project tasks and resources across the Biostatistics group, and act as backup during the Manager's absence, as assigned.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

### **KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES:**


* Understanding of GCP, ICH, and FDA guidelines and regulations applicable to conduct clinical research.
* Advanced knowledge of statistical methods used in the design and analysis of Phase I\-IV clinical trials.
* Experience with SAS Base and SAS Stat.
* Experience with other statistical software packages, such as N\-Query, S\-Plus.
* Ability to work creatively and independently to carry out assignments of a complex nature.
* Must be skilled in effective time management.
* Ability to work effectively and cooperatively with other professional staff members.
* Ability to communicate effectively, both verbally and in writing, with all levels of staff and with the public.

### **MINIMUM RECRUITMENT STANDARDS:**


* Masters\-level degree in Statistics, Biostatistics or related field with eight years relevant CRO industry or biotech experience; or
* Doctorate\-level degree in Statistics, Biostatistics or related field with six years relevant CRO industry or biotech experience.
* Data handling and analysis experience.
* Excellent interpersonal and organization skills.

**This role is not eligible for UK visa sponsorship**


IQVIA is a leading global provider of clinical research services, commercial insights and healthcare intelligence to the life sciences and healthcare industries. We create intelligent connections to accelerate the development and commercialization of innovative medical treatments to help improve patient outcomes and population health worldwide. Learn more at https://jobs.iqvia.com


IQVIA is committed to integrity in our hiring process and maintains a zero tolerance policy for candidate fraud. All information and credentials submitted in your application must be truthful and complete. Any false statements, misrepresentations, or material omissions during the recruitment process will result in immediate disqualification of your application, or termination of employment if discovered later, in accordance with applicable law. We appreciate your honesty and professionalism.



**Where you'll work**
---------------------


### **Home\-based**


You’ll work remotely, with the flexibility to do your best work from home. Supported by collaborative tools and a global team, you’ll stay connected while enjoying the autonomy and balance that comes with a fully remote role.


  
**Culture**
-----------


Culture at IQVIA is built on a shared belief: that when people are empowered with better data, smarter technology and deeper expertise, they can change what’s possible for patients. Across every team and every corner of the globe, you’ll find colleagues who genuinely care — about the mission and about each other. That’s what makes this a place where people tend to stay, grow and do the best work of their careers.

title: SEO/GEO Manager
description:
**About the opportunity**
-------------------------



As the SEO \& GEO Manager at N26, you will be responsible for driving organic user acquisition across all digital channels and emerging AI search engines (e.g., Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT Search, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini). You will blend technical SEO rigor, data analytics, high\-authority content strategy, and semantic optimization to ensure N26 remains the primary mobile banking recommendation across traditional search engines and AI discovery platforms.



You will sit at the intersection of Marketing, Data, Product, and Content, scaling our organic footprint across multiple European markets while building N26's pioneer strategy in AI search visibility.

  


**In this role, you will:**


**Traditional \& Technical SEO**


* Search Strategy: Define, execute, and scale the multi\-market organic search roadmap across key N26 operating markets (Germany, France, Spain, Italy, Austria, and pan\-Europe).
* Technical SEO Leadership: Partner with Product and Web Engineering teams to maintain flawless technical site health, addressing site speed, crawlability, indexing, Core Web Vitals, dynamic rendering, and international multi\-language architecture (hreflang).
* High\-Intent Content Strategy: Collaborate with the Product Marketing and Brand teams to build and optimize localized, compliant fintech content targeting high\-intent, converting keywords.


**Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) \& AI Visibility**


* AI Search Strategy: Develop N26's framework for GEO, optimizing web presence to maximize brand recommendation, inclusion, and positive sentiment in AI\-generated answers (e.g., ChatGPT Search, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews).
* Knowledge Graph \& Entity Management: Optimize structured data (Schema.org), digital entity relationships, and authoritative external references to establish N26 as the definitive financial authority for LLMs.
* Citation \& Share of Voice Monitoring: Establish benchmarks, tracking metrics, and custom tools to measure N26's share of AI voice (SoAIV) and recommendation rates against competitors in conversational search.


**Analytics, Testing \& Reporting**


* Performance Tracking: Deliver standard organic acquisition dashboards tracking organic traffic, sign\-ups, and keyword/entity rankings.
* Testing \& Experimentation: Run continuous A/B and multivariate tests on title tags, semantic markup, content structuring, and internal linking to drive conversion rate optimization (CRO) and crawl efficiency.
* Market Insights: Monitor algorithm updates, AI model updates, and regulatory shifts to proactively adapt our growth tactics.

**What you need to be successful:**
-----------------------------------


* Experience: 4\+ years of hands\-on experience in SEO within high\-growth tech companies, fintechs, or large\-scale consumer digital products across multi\-language markets.
* GEO \& AI Search Mastery: Proven understanding of how Large Language Models (LLMs) ingest, index, and cite web sources, alongside practical experience optimizing content for AI platforms.
* Technical Proficiency: Strong command of HTML/CSS, technical SEO auditing tools (Screaming Frog, Log analysis, etc.), dynamic rendering, and structured data implementation.
* Data Fluency: Advanced knowledge of Google Search Console, Google Analytics 4 (GA4\), Ahrefs, Semrush, and SQL/Python/R (a plus for large dataset analysis and API integrations).
* Language: Fluent written and spoken English. Professional proficiency in German, French, Spanish, or Italian is a strong advantage.


**Nice\-to\-Haves**


* Experience working with programmatic SEO and automated content workflows.
* Familiarity with vector databases, semantic search embeddings, and RAG (Retrieval\-Augmented Generation) concepts.
* Experience in App Store Optimization (ASO) for iOS and Android.

  


**What's in it for you:**
-------------------------


Accelerate your career growth by joining one of Europe's most talked about disruptors * .
* Employee benefits that range from a competitive personal development budget, work from home budget, discounts to fitness \& wellness memberships, language apps and public transportation.
* As an N26 employee you will have access to a Premium subscription on your personal N26 bank account. As well as subscriptions for friends and family members.
* Additional day of annual leave for each year of service.
* A high degree of autonomy and access to cutting edge technologies \- all while working with a friendly team of peers of diverse nationalities, experiences, and backgrounds.
* A relocation package with visa support for those who need it.

**Who we are**
--------------



N26 has reimagined banking for today's digital world. Technology and design empower everything we do and it's how we are building the global banking platform the world loves to use.



We've eliminated physical branches, paperwork, and hidden fees for an elegant digital experience and supreme savings. Giving people the power to live and bank their way is what gets us out of bed in the morning and inspires the work that we do.



We are headquartered in Berlin with offices in multiple cities across Europe, including Vienna and Barcelona, and a 1,500\-strong team of more than 80 nationalities.


**Do you see yourself thriving in this role?** We'd love to see your application even if you don't meet 100% of the criteria. You may just be the right fit for this or other roles!


**Equal opportunities for all**



At N26, we believe our strength lies in our people and the varied perspectives they bring. We strive to build diverse teams that drive innovation and business success. We actively seek talent from all backgrounds and welcome applications from all genders, cultures, sexual orientations, abilities, neurodiversities, and ages.



We are committed to providing an excellent and accessible candidate experience. If you require any accommodations to make this process work for you, please let us know. We're here to support you!



Discover more about Diversity \& Inclusion at N26: https://n26\.com/en\-eu/diversity\-and\-inclusion

title: Course Content Manager
description:
**Application deadline: 24 September 2026 at 17:00 (Barcelona time)**  

  

**Who are we?**  

  

EIT Urban Mobility is an initiative of the European Institute of Innovation and Technology (EIT), a body of the European Union and Europe's largest network for transport innovation in cities.

  

Our mission is to accelerate change towards a sustainable model of urban mobility and liveable urban spaces. We connect public and private actors and provide them with access to markets, talent, finance and knowledge.

  

Using cities as living labs, our industry, research and university partners will demonstrate how new technologies can work to solve real problems in real cities by transporting people, goods and waste in smarter ways.

 **About EIT Urban Mobility Academy:**

  

Our EIT Urban Mobility Academy is a collaborative arena for lifelong learning, helping to build critical capabilities for innovation and transformation. We are training the next generation of urban mobility practitioners, needed by the urban mobility ecosystem of the future. The webpage of EIT Urban Mobility Academy is:  

https://www.eiturbanmobility.eu/academy/

  

Within the Academy, Urban Mobility Explained (UMX) offers a variety of training programmes and experiences on hot topics in urban mobility and transport for professionals and organisations around Europe. In close collaboration with universities, business schools, consultancies and mobility experts, this lifelong learning initiative uses different formats including light online material in a YouTube channel, online courses (asynchronous), and face\-to\-face (F2F) courses (on\-site, online synchronous and blended). More information on UMX: https://urbanmobilityexplained.eu/

 **Be part of a team where:**  

  

The **Course Content Manager** will play a pivotal role in shaping the present and future of UMX. Reporting to the Head of Professional Education, you will support the UMX team in maintaining operational excellence, ensuring full compliance, and successfully delivering UMX courses in compliance with EIT Urban Mobility and EIT requirements.

  

You will help shape the future development of the UMX portfolio by identifying emerging topics, sourcing expertise, converting knowledge into high\-impact learning experiences, and ensuring our content remains aligned with the evolving needs of cities, public authorities, mobility operators and industry stakeholders across Europe.

  

You will support EIT Urban Mobility's long\-term strategy by developing high\-impact courses that generate independent value and revenue within our five Priority Domains: (1\) shared and public transport (2\) urban logistics, (3\) mobility AI and data management, (4\) electrification and alternative fuels, and (5\) health and mobility.

  

As part of this role, you will support the development of EIT Urban Mobility's Autonomous Mobility Academy initiative. Working alongside internal and external subject\-matter experts, you will contribute to programme design, ecosystem building, expert sourcing, content governance, funding opportunities and project development activities.  

  

**Key responsibilities:**

  

* Strategic Content Development \& KPI Compliance: Support the delivery and continuous improvement of UMX courses, ensuring they meet revenue, KPI and compliance requirements. Identify emerging mobility trends and strategic topics, and transform research, project outputs and thought leadership into new learning products, use cases and educational assets. Support the definition of content priorities and future portfolio growth opportunities.
* Expert Sourcing, Network Building \& Knowledge Management: Build and maintain a high\-quality network of urban mobility and transport experts across Europe and beyond. Develop and manage a centralised expert database, identify and engage contributors for learning activities, and establish processes that ensure the quality, relevance and transferability of expertise across the organisation.
* Autonomous Vehicles Academy Development \& Project Management: Act as the primary operational lead supporting the development of EIT Urban Mobility's Autonomous Mobility Academy Initiative. Coordinate stakeholders, partnerships and project development activities, while supporting funding opportunities, ecosystem engagement and programme planning. Work closely with internal and external experts to ensure activities remain aligned with organisational priorities and market needs.
* Content Governance, Review \& Quality Assurance: Act as content owner for a portfolio of UMX learning activities. Review and challenge content to ensure it is accurate, practical and relevant for target audiences, while working closely with subject\-matter experts and internal teams to maintain high quality standards and continuously improve the learner experience.
* Knowledge Intelligence \& Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Monitor developments across the mobility ecosystem and identify reports, studies, project outputs and market insights that can be transformed into learning assets and new course opportunities. Collaborate with marketing, business development, learning and other EIT Urban Mobility teams, while contributing to wider organisational initiatives, events and thought leadership activities.

  

  

**What you will bring along the way:**  

  

**Must\-haves**

  

* 7\+ years of professional experience in urban mobility, transport innovation, mobility technology, innovation ecosystems or closely related sectors, including experience working with experts, knowledge products, training programmes or thought leadership initiatives.
* 3\+ years working experience(s) in managing/producing education or learning activities and trainings, preferably in a blended format (partly online, partly on\-site), ideally for a professional or lifelong learning audience.
* Strong interest in mobility innovation, emerging technologies, transport digitalisation and the future of urban mobility.
* Proven ability to identify, assess and engage subject\-matter experts and build professional networks across complex stakeholder ecosystems.
* Ability to translate research findings, project outputs and technical knowledge into practical learning materials and educational products.
* Strong critical thinking skills with the ability to assess content quality, challenge assumptions and work effectively with senior experts.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills in English (C1 level or above), both written and spoken.
* Committed, proactive, trustworthy, accurate, and respectful of timelines and deadlines.
* A positive 'can\-do' and hands\-on mindset, curious and fast digital learner capable of adapting to digital tools like Netsuite and WordPress.

  


**Nice\-to\-haves**

  

* Experience working in or with an EU institution or EU\-funded programme or organisation.
* Experience working in or with public/private partnerships.
* Demonstrable experience, project involvement and/or an active professional network in autonomous mobility.
* Any additional EU language is a plus.

  

  

**What's in it for you:**

  

* Work in an international environment with a company culture focused on empowerment, thriving and continuous growth.
* Join a creative and diverse team of highly driven individuals that take out\-of\-the\-box thinking to another level.
* Strike the right work\-life balance: on top of the flexible hours and remote working options and facilities, you will be granted 27 days of paid time\-off to rest and re\-energize.

What if you could redesign how medicines move through Development and help innovative treatments reach patients faster?

description:

Kantox is a Barcelona\-based fintech acquired by BNP Paribas in 2022\. As Director of Revenue Operations, you will sit at the intersection of internal commercial execution and parent company alignment, reporting directly to the Chief Commercial Officer.


This is not a coordination role. You will own the RevOps function, lead the relationship with BNP Paribas commercial leadership, and drive the commercial initiatives that determine how Kantox scales.

**What you will work on**


Strategic Leadership

* Working hand in hand with the Chief Commercial Officer
* Building strategic reviews and recommendations for key meetings including Strategic Reviews with BNP, Kantox Board meetings, and Quarterly Commercial meetings
* Ensuring all decisions made in the Commercial leadership team are executed seamlessly, in collaboration with Sales Team Managers
