title: Senior UX Designer (Space Engineers Franchise)
description:
At Keen Software House, we develop large\-scale sandbox simulation games like Space Engineers 1 and Space Engineers 2, built around engineering, construction, destruction, physics, emergent gameplay, and player creativity, together with the proprietary technology that powers them.



We are looking for a **Senior UX Designer** to join our international team working across **Space Engineers and Space Engineers 2**.



Space Engineers is a complex sandbox game built around engineering, construction, exploration, survival, and player creativity. That complexity is part of what makes the game unique \- but it also creates significant UX challenges.



We are looking for someone who can take real ownership of how players interact with our systems, identify usability problems, and turn complex mechanics and information into clear and intuitive player experiences.



Because we are a relatively small team, we are looking for a hands\-on and versatile UX Designer who can contribute beyond UX theory, wireframes, and documentation. Strong UX expertise is the foundation of the role, but ideally you also bring visual/UI design skills or, alternatively, experience with technical UI prototyping, integration, or implementation. Visual/UI design is particularly valuable for us given the current composition of the team.



You will work closely with Game Design, Art, Engineering, Production, and QA, helping shape both existing and new features from early concepts through to implementation.



We expect you to act as a proactive UX partner \- identify friction, challenge existing solutions when needed, test assumptions, and help us establish stronger UX principles across both games.


**While our studio is based in Prague, we offer the flexibility to work remotely (CET \+/\- 2 hours).**



If you enjoy challenging work, autonomy, impact, and responsibility, come and join us

  


**Required profile**
--------------------


* **5\+ years of professional experience as a UX Designer, Game UX Designer, or similar role, with significant experience working in the video game industry on PC and/or console games**
* Proven experience designing UX for shipped video games, ideally across multiple features or systems
* Strong portfolio or case studies demonstrating your UX process, including problem definition, user flows, wireframes, prototypes, iteration, and final solutions
* Hands\-on approach to UX design, **with experience in at least one adjacent discipline that allows you to contribute beyond UX documentation – ideally UI/visual design, or alternatively technical UI prototyping, integration, or implementation**
* Strong understanding of interaction design, information architecture, user flows, usability principles, navigation systems, and information hierarchy
* Experience working on sandbox, simulation, strategy, management, or other systems\-heavy games
* Strong experience designing UX for complex and interconnected game systems, such as inventories, building systems, crafting, progression, control schemes, or similar mechanics
* Ability to make complex mechanics and information understandable and intuitive without removing their depth
* Strong wireframing and prototyping skills using Figma or equivalent tools
* Experience creating and evolving UX/UI design systems, interaction patterns, and reusable component libraries
* Experience designing UX for both mouse \& keyboard and controller\-based interaction
* Experience validating UX solutions through usability testing, playtesting, player research, player feedback, analytics, telemetry, or similar methods
* Knowledge of accessibility principles in game UX
* Strong design judgment – able to identify usability problems and their root causes, propose practical solutions, and explain design decisions using player needs, evidence, and clear reasoning
* Ability to work effectively with Game Design, UI Art, Engineering, Production, and QA, understand technical and production constraints, and incorporate them into UX solutions
* Proactive and self\-driven, with the ability to work independently, iterate quickly, receive feedback, and adapt solutions when needed
* Fluent English, spoken and written
* Shares and upholds our High Standards

**Nice to have**
----------------


* Strong visual/UI design skills, including typography, layout, iconography, visual hierarchy, and the ability to take UX concepts through to polished, production\-ready interface designs
* Experience creating or adapting UI assets and working within an established visual language or art direction
* Experience implementing or integrating UI directly in a game engine or proprietary engine
* Experience combining UX design with UI/visual design and/or technical implementation within the same role
* Experience working on live games and improving established systems without disrupting existing player workflows or expectations
* Experience working on sci\-fi, simulation, engineering, or other technically oriented games

**Key responsibilities**
------------------------


* Report to the Production Director and be part of a Game design team
* Take ownership of UX across **Space Engineers and Space Engineers 2**, covering both existing systems and new features
* Identify player friction and usability problems, understand their root causes, and propose practical improvements
* Work with Game Design, UI Art, Engineering, Production, and QA from the early stages of feature development to shape solutions that balance player needs, game design intent, visual clarity, technical feasibility, and production constraints
* Translate complex mechanics, systems, and requirements into clear and intuitive player experiences


**Define and improve:**


* + player flows and navigation
	+ information architecture and interaction patterns
	+ menus, HUD, and in\-game interactions
	+ system feedback
	+ onboarding and discoverability
* Create user flows, wireframes, prototypes, and UX specifications, exploring and validating solutions early before significant development time is invested
* Take solutions beyond UX documentation where appropriate to your skill set – whether through polished UI/visual design, high\-fidelity prototyping, or contributing to UI integration and implementation
* Use playtesting, player feedback, analytics, telemetry, and other available evidence to validate solutions and guide iteration
* Follow UX solutions through development, review implementation, and help ensure the intended player experience is preserved in the final product
* Establish and evolve consistent UX principles, interaction patterns, and design systems across both games
* Clearly communicate UX problems, design decisions, and trade\-offs to stakeholders using evidence, player needs, and clear reasoning
* Balance usability with game depth, technical limitations, development cost, existing player expectations, and long\-term maintainability
* Help improve UX practices across the wider development team and ensure UX is considered throughout development rather than treated as a final review step

**What we value**
-----------------


* Hold yourself to A\-player standards
* **Player\-first thinking without oversimplification** – make complex systems understandable while preserving the depth that makes Space Engineers unique
* **Hands\-on, versatile design** – UX should not stop at diagrams or recommendations; be comfortable turning ideas into tangible solutions and contributing beyond a narrowly defined UX role when needed
* **Problem solving over screen production** – understand the underlying player problem before designing the interface
* **Systems thinking** – understand how individual interactions connect to the broader player experience
* **Strong judgment and prioritisation** – recognise where UX problems have the greatest impact, understand trade\-offs, and focus effort where it matters most
* **Clarity over cleverness** – favour solutions that players can understand naturally, without unnecessary complexity
* **Iteration over attachment** – explore quickly, test assumptions, take feedback well, and change direction when a better solution emerges
* **Ownership and proactivity** – do not wait for perfectly defined UX problems; identify what needs to be solved and help drive it forward
* **Evidence over opinion** – use player behaviour, usability principles, testing, and clear reasoning rather than personal preference
* **Clear and direct communication** – explain UX problems, decisions, and trade\-offs clearly and challenge ideas constructively

**What you'll find at Keen Software House:**
--------------------------------------------


**Impact**


* Leave your mark on one of the most technically ambitious sandbox engineering games ever made.
* Join an international team tackling hard problems


**How we work:**


* Hybrid by default: work from home when you want
* Low bureaucracy, fast decisions


**Time off \& wellbeing**


* 25 days of annual leave.
* Flexible sick leave.


**Workspace**


* Modern offices at Oranžerie, Prague \- quiet focus zones, beautiful garden, great daylight, quality equipment, bike storage, gym and shower, fully stocked kitchen, lunches prepared by our private chefs


**Community**


* Regular team breakfasts, workshops, and relaxed meetups (BBQ, game nights, parties, teambuildings)

* Experience owning a multi\-team product area end to end, with accountability for both delivery and the value delivered

* Fluent English, written and spoken, with the ability to operate effectively across cultures and geographies.

description:

Parsec is hiring a **Senior Director, Technical Services** to unify and scale the technical backbone of its Professional Services organization. This role owns three distinct but interdependent workstreams: Advisory, Delivery, and Support. Each currently operates with its own rhythm, skill set, and client touchpoints. The mandate for this role is to bring these workstreams together under one operating model so that clients, SI partners, and internal teams experience a consistent standard of technical excellence, regardless of which workstream is engaged.



This is a build\-and\-run role. The teams exist today; the person in this seat will professionalize how they operate, scale them as the business grows, and ensure new hires ramp to full productivity on a defined timeline. Success is measured by predictable delivery, fewer escalations, improved resource utilization across workstreams, and a technical organization that partners with Enablement, Sales, and SI/GSI partners as a single, credible voice on TrakSYS.

  


**Role Characteristics**


* **Organizational Span:** Owns three workstreams: Advisory, Delivery, and Support, all spanning approximately 30–40 FTEs based primarily in the US and Spain, with additional coverage across Europe.
* **Delivery Accountability:** Accountable for delivery outcomes across all three workstreams, including quality, timeliness, and client/partner satisfaction.

**Key Responsibilities**


* **Advisory Workstream**


* Own the quality bar for design artifacts produced by Solution Architects and Tech Leads, ensuring consistency across SI partner\-led and Parsec\-led engagements.

* **Delivery Workstream**


* Manage the engineering resource pool as a shared capacity model: intake, prioritization, staffing, and rebalancing across concurrent projects.
* Partner with assigned Project Managers on scope, timelines, and quality gates without owning the PM function.

* **Support Workstream**

* Develop a repeatable mentoring and knowledge\-transfer offering for clients and SI partners.

* **Cross\-Workstream Responsibilities**

**Qualifications**

* **Multi\-Function Leadership**: Demonstrated experience managing multiple technical functions concurrently (e.g., solution architecture/advisory, engineering delivery, and technical support) as a unified organization.

title: Senior Direct-Response Video Editor, DTC Performance Ads
description:
**About Us**


HarZa is a fast\-growing operator of direct\-to\-consumer brands in health and wellness. Our flagship brand, Rejuvacare, serves over 400,000 customers who trust us with their health, and we are now launching and scaling new portfolio brands. The company has scaled 12x in a single year to over 150 people across 15\+ countries. We are remote\-first, async\-first, and hold a high standard of accountability across everything we do. Paid media is our growth engine, and creative volume is what makes it scale.

**The Role**


You will be the editing engine of a performance pod: a small team built around a creative strategist, a media buyer, and a copywriter, shipping direct\-response ads for claims\-led health and wellness brands. This is not a brand content role and not an organic social role. Every asset you cut exists to convert on paid traffic, and your work is measured by how it performs, not only by how it looks.


The creative challenge is specific: our products solve problems (chronic pain, mobility, wellbeing) whose results are not visually obvious. Your edits build belief through mechanism explanation, testimonials, UGC structures, advertorials, and VSL\-style long form, always with awareness that we operate in a compliance\-sensitive category. You will produce both short\-form ads (15 to 60 seconds) and long\-form direct\-response formats (2 to 6 minutes), and a large part of your week is iterating winners: new hooks, new openings, cutdowns, and format variations of ads that are already scaling.


This is a high\-volume seat and we say so openly. The target output is at least one long\-form ad of around 5 minutes plus 2 to 3 short\-form videos per working day, which comes to roughly 15 to 20 delivered assets per week including iterations. If that rhythm sounds extreme, this is not the right role. If it sounds like the environment you already work in, we should talk.

**What You Will Own**


Direct\-response editing at volume. Editing short\-form and long\-form paid ads from strategist scripts and briefs, shipping platform\-native formats for Meta, TikTok, and YouTube, and sustaining the daily delivery target of one long\-form plus 2 to 3 short\-form videos without sacrificing the craft details that drive performance: hooks, pacing, captions, sound design, and pattern interrupts.


Winner iteration and creative testing. Producing hook variations, cutdowns, re\-orders, and format swaps of winning ads as a first\-class deliverable. Feeding the testing loop the pod runs every week and turning performance feedback into the next round of edits quickly.


Claims\-led storytelling. Building belief for outcomes the viewer cannot see: visualizing mechanisms, structuring testimonial and UGC narratives, editing advertorial and VSL long form that holds attention for minutes, and handling claims with compliance awareness.


Pod collaboration and documentation. Working async\-first inside the pod with your strategist and media buyer, keeping Asana as the single source of truth for briefs, versions, and delivery status, and turning feedback into revised cuts without friction or ego.

 **Requirements**  

Proven experience editing paid direct\-response ads for DTC or ecommerce brands, where your videos ran on real media budgets and you saw the numbers. Fluency in both short\-form ad formats and long\-form DR (VSLs, advertorials, 2\+ minute belief\-building videos). A demonstrated high\-volume rhythm: you have sustained daily ad output in a testing environment, not one polished piece per week. Working knowledge of the metrics that judge your work (hook rate, hold rate, CTR, CPA or ROAS) and a track record of letting data change your edits. Experience in health, wellness, supplements, or other claims\-sensitive verticals is a strong plus. Full professional proficiency with a modern editing stack, reliable remote setup, and the self\-management to thrive in an async\-first, output\-measured company.

 **Benefits**  

A fully remote position at a high\-growth DTC operator launching new brands. Real ownership inside a performance pod where your work directly drives scale. Paid time off, wellness stipend, company\-funded computer allowance after tenure milestone, monthly bonus structure, birthday gift card, and in\-country meetup allowance. A culture that rewards output, speed, and mastery of craft.

title: Senior Direct Response Funnel Copywriter & Strategist
description:
About Us


HarZa Group is a fast\-growing operator of direct\-to\-consumer brands in health and wellness. Our flagship brand, Rejuvacare, serves more than 400,000 customers with products targeting chronic pain and mobility, including RejuvaKnee, FootRenew, RejuvaFlow and OzemPatch. We ship primarily to the United States and run a membership program that powers recurring revenue. The company has scaled 12x in a single year to nearly 150 people across more than 15 countries. We are remote\-first, async\-first, and hold a high standard of accountability across everything we do.


The Role


We are looking for an exceptional senior direct response copywriter to take ownership of our post\-click funnels. This is not a role for someone who receives a brief, writes the copy and moves on. We are looking for someone who treats funnels the way an exceptional creative strategist treats advertising: research the customer and the market, form a hypothesis, develop the concept, write the copy, get the funnel launched, study the performance, identify the constraint, develop the next test, and turn every result into a feedback loop.


You will be deeply involved in the commercial performance of everything you write. Once a funnel goes live you should be watching click\-through rates, advertorial to sales page click\-through, quiz completion, sales page and checkout conversion, revenue per visitor, average order value, order bump and upsell take rates, refund rates and contribution margin. A page is not finished when the copy is approved. It is finished when it has launched, been measured, and produced a learning that improves the next page.


Your ultimate objective is to remove the founders from writing and reviewing routine funnel copy. Initially they will remain closely involved and may still write a large share of it. You will work directly with them, learn their frameworks, understand their decision\-making, and gradually take ownership of the function. Success means reaching the point where the founders no longer need to write funnel copy, rewrite your work, or independently double\-check it before launch. From there you create leverage through AI systems, documented processes and, in time, additional writers trained and managed beneath you.


A Note on the Category


This is claims\-led direct response, not product\-led ecommerce, and the distinction matters more than any other line in this description. Our products address chronic pain and mobility. The benefit is not visually obvious, it cannot be demonstrated in a photograph, and it cannot be sold on aspiration. Belief has to be built through mechanism, proof, advertorial and presell structure, and honest handling of objections, all inside the compliance limits of a health category.


Copywriters who have scaled fashion, accessories, beauty or other visually self\-evident products often find that their playbook does not transfer. A strong track record in a product\-led category is welcome but does not substitute for this. We will prioritize candidates who have written for health, wellness, supplements or another claims\-sensitive category and who understand what can and cannot be said.


Why This Role Is Different


The founders have generated more than nine figures in post\-purchase upsell revenue in under twenty\-four months. That figure is post\-purchase upsell revenue specifically, not total front\-end company revenue. You will get direct access to the frameworks behind those results, existing research, templates, processes and funnel data, direct feedback and training from the founders, a portfolio of brands and offers with significant traffic, a high\-volume testing environment where your ideas get launched and measured, and real commercial data across multiple funnel types, offers and traffic sources.


This is an opportunity to develop beyond being a copywriter. The right person can progress toward Head of Funnel Copy, Head of Funnel Strategy, Director of Conversion, or operator of one of our portfolio brands. We prefer to promote from within, and progression is based on commercial results, leadership ability and the amount of responsibility you can absorb.

 **Requirements**  

What You Will Own


Post\-Click Funnel Strategy


Act as the strategic owner of post\-click messaging and conversion copy. Participate in marketing, campaign and offer planning, understand what each traffic source needs after the click, and ensure message continuity between the advertisement, presell page, sales page, checkout and upsell journey. Recommend the right funnel format based on the offer, traffic source, customer awareness and market sophistication, and determine when a campaign needs an advertorial, listicle, quiz, long\-form page, short\-form page or another structure. Collaborate with media buyers and creative strategists to understand the promise that generated the click, and identify disconnects between the ad message and the landing page experience. Your remit begins at the click, but you must understand the whole acquisition system to make intelligent post\-click decisions.


Customer and Market Research


Research the customer before developing the copy. Analyze reviews, surveys, support tickets, customer interviews, call transcripts, refund reasons and community discussions. Study competitor offers, positioning, mechanisms, pricing and funnel structures. Identify desires, fears, frustrations, failed solutions, objections and buying triggers, understand the customer's level of awareness and the sophistication of the market, and distinguish between what customers say they want and what their behaviour suggests they value. Build voice\-of\-customer libraries that preserve the language customers actually use, validate that claims are supportable and appropriate for the category, and convert raw research into usable copy insight rather than research documents nobody reads.


Hypothesis Before Writing


Every meaningful funnel project begins with a clear hypothesis. Identify the metric or funnel stage being targeted, diagnose the likely reason for underperformance, state the customer insight behind the diagnosis, define what will change and why it should influence behaviour, select a primary success metric and the guardrails around it, and determine what result would validate or invalidate the idea. The first question is not what copy should I write. It is what is the constraint, why does it exist, and what evidence suggests this is the right solution.


Writing Complete Funnels


Write and optimize new offer positioning, unique mechanisms, big ideas, hooks and leads, advertorials, listicles, quiz flows, long\-form and short\-form sales pages, product detail pages, offer sections, pricing and bundle presentation, guarantees, checkout copy, order bumps, post\-purchase upsells, downsells, cross\-sells, funnel transitions, calls to action, and the supporting briefs for page graphics and visual proof. You must be able to develop a major long\-form funnel from a blank page and equally to identify and rewrite the one critical section inside an existing funnel.


The Offer, Not Only the Words


Copy cannot be separated from the offer. You will think critically about positioning, price, quantity, bundles, discounts, bonuses, guarantees, payment options, shipping thresholds, subscription structures, order bumps, upsell sequencing and offer continuity through the funnel. You should be willing to conclude that the copy is not the main problem and that the right recommendation is to change the offer, reorder the upsells, change the price, improve the guarantee, remove a step or target a different segment. Your responsibility is to improve the commercial result, not to defend the original brief.


Funnel Economics


Understand the underlying economics of each offer, including selling price, cost of goods, pick and pack, shipping, payment processing, discounts, refunds, chargebacks, subscription take rates, upsell margins, gross and contribution margin, customer acquisition cost, and revenue and profit per visitor. A higher AOV is not automatically better if contribution margin falls, a higher conversion rate is not better if refunds rise, and a pricing test must be judged on full funnel economics rather than one isolated metric. You do not need to be a finance professional. You do need to think like an owner.


Staying Close to Live Performance


Once your copy is launched, confirm the correct version went live, review performance against the control and at each funnel step, segment where appropriate, compare mobile and desktop, look for discrepancies between traffic sources, use heatmaps and behavioural data where helpful, and compare primary against guardrail metrics. Document what worked, what did not and why, recommend the next action, and feed every meaningful learning back into research and writing. You should feel personal ownership of the result without becoming defensive when an idea loses. A losing test that produces a real learning is useful. A test launched without a hypothesis and never reviewed is not.


The Learning System and AI Leverage


Build and maintain a searchable archive of tests and results recording the original problem, hypothesis, change, result and learning. Identify recurring patterns across brands and funnel types, separate genuine principles from conclusions drawn on insufficient data, convert repeated winners into reusable frameworks, and prevent failed concepts from being unknowingly repeated. Insight should become company knowledge rather than living in one person's head.


Alongside that, become highly AI\-enabled. Use and improve AI\-assisted systems for research synthesis, voice\-of\-customer clustering, transcript and review analysis, competitor and mechanism research, angle development, hypothesis generation, copy outlining, first drafts, variations, objection identification, quality control, claim consistency review, funnel analysis and test documentation. You will not use a generic chatbot to produce first drafts. You will help build structured processes containing the right context, approved source material, brand knowledge, customer research, historical winners, founder frameworks, defined quality criteria and clear review stages. The standard is not whether AI was used. It is whether AI helped us produce better research, better copy, more tests and faster learning without lowering quality.


What We Are Looking For


Substantial professional experience in direct response copywriting, gained over several years writing for real offers with meaningful traffic. A portfolio containing both long\-form and short\-form funnel copy, significant experience writing for cold traffic, and proven experience in DTC ecommerce, direct response or another measurable\-response environment. Evidence that your work has generated meaningful revenue or measurable conversion improvement. Experience writing complete funnels rather than isolated page sections, including advertorials, listicles, sales pages, quizzes, checkouts and post\-purchase upsells.


Experience in health, wellness, supplements or another claims\-sensitive category, and an understanding of how to build belief where the benefit is not visually demonstrable. A strong grasp of customer awareness, market sophistication, offers, mechanisms, leads, proof, objections and risk reversal. The ability to conduct and synthesize deep customer research and turn it into a clear hypothesis and a persuasive argument.


Strong analytical fluency and comfort with funnel performance data, the ability to diagnose where a funnel is losing customers, a working understanding of AOV, revenue per visitor, upsell take rates, gross margin and contribution margin, experience creating and evaluating conversion tests, and the ability to distinguish correlation, noise and meaningful evidence.


Strong AI fluency with evidence of using AI inside a real research, writing or analysis workflow. The ability to write quickly without sacrificing strategic depth, the confidence to challenge a weak brief or assumption, the humility to change direction when the data disproves an idea, the communication skills to work with founders, media buyers, designers and analysts, and the potential to train and lead additional writers as the function grows. You must be able to overlap consistently with our collaboration window of 8:00am to 12:00pm EST.


High\-volume Meta, native, Google or affiliate traffic, post\-purchase upsell funnels, portfolio or multi\-brand environments, CRO or direct response agencies, subscription offers, and experience building copy systems or training programs are all highly advantageous.


Evidence We Expect to See


Applicants should demonstrate results, not simply submit polished writing samples. Strong evidence includes funnel revenue, conversion rate improvements, revenue per visitor and AOV improvements, upsell take rate and contribution margin improvements, results against an established control, evidence of scaling an offer, before and after funnel performance, and a sequence of tests showing how an insight developed over time.


We understand that candidates may be under confidentiality agreements. Results can be anonymized, but you should still be able to explain what the offer was, what the original problem was, what you personally owned, what research you conducted, what hypothesis you formed, what you changed, which metric moved, how much traffic supported the conclusion, and what happened next. We are more interested in clear thinking and honest attribution than impressive numbers without context.


This Role Is Not


This is not a junior copywriting position, a brand copy role, a content or social media role, or an ad\-copy\-only position. It is not a role where you write from a brief without questioning it, where your responsibility ends when the document is submitted, or where you would rather your work was not measured. It is not a pure CRO analyst role in which you never write, nor a management\-only role in which you no longer produce. It is not for someone who uses AI to generate generic copy and calls that leverage, who needs the founders to supply every angle and mechanism, who waits to be told which test to run, or who blames media buying, design or development without investigating the full funnel.

 **Benefits**  

What We Offer


A fully remote senior position with genuine ownership of a function that directly determines how fast the business can move. We offer paid time off, a monthly wellness stipend, medical insurance support, a company\-funded computer allowance after a tenure milestone, a birthday gift card, an in\-country meetup allowance, and participation in company\-funded leadership offsites. You will have direct access to the founders, a high\-volume testing environment, and the mandate to build the system rather than inherit someone else's process.

title: Senior Marketing Artist (Space Engineers Franchise)
description:
At Keen Software House, we develop large\-scale sandbox simulation games like Space Engineers 1 and Space Engineers 2, built around engineering, construction, destruction, physics, emergent gameplay, and player creativity, together with the proprietary technology that powers them.  

  

We are looking for a **Senior Marketing Artist** to join our international team working on **Space Engineers and Space Engineers 2**.



We are looking for a strong visual artist who can take real ownership of how Space Engineers is presented across marketing channels. You will turn in\-game content, screenshots, 3D assets, and ideas into high\-quality promotional visuals, while also actively helping define what our marketing materials should look like, how they should be structured, and where the visual quality can be pushed further.



You will work across a wide range of marketing and promotional materials \- from key visuals, store assets and campaign graphics to screenshots, banners, logos, splash screens, social media content, and other 2D artwork.



This is not a purely execution\-focused role. We are looking for someone who can identify opportunities independently, challenge existing approaches when needed, propose stronger visual solutions, and help establish and evolve a consistent marketing art direction for Space Engineers.



You should combine a strong artistic eye with speed, versatility, and practical execution \- someone who can explore multiple directions quickly, make sound visual decisions, work with feedback, understand the purpose behind each asset, and consistently deliver polished results.



We expect you to act as a proactive visual partner to the team, not simply wait for briefs \- spotting what is missing, proposing what should be created, and helping raise the overall standard of our marketing presentation.


**While our studio is based in Prague, we offer the flexibility to work remotely (CET \+/\- 2 hour)**



If you enjoy challenging work, seek autonomy, thrive on impact and responsibility, and want to work in a friendly environment with an inspiring international team, then come and join us!


**Required profile**
--------------------


* **6\+ years of professional experience as a Marketing Artist, 2D Artist, or Graphic Designer in the video game industry, specifically working on PC and/or console games.**
* Basic knowledge of or hands\-on experience with motion graphics and animation tools such as Adobe After Effects or similar software.
* Strong portfolio demonstrating high\-quality video game marketing and promotional artwork
* Experience creating and defining brand identities from the ground up, as well as evolving established visual identities across multiple marketing channels and asset types.
* Proven experience creating assets such as:
* + key visuals and campaign artwork
	+ promotional and store screenshots
	+ banners and social media assets
	+ splash screens
	+ logos and branding elements
	+ promotional compositions based on in\-game or 3D content
* Strong skills in Adobe Photoshop
* Strong skills in Adobe Illustrator
* Excellent understanding of composition, typography, color, lighting and visual hierarchy


**Experience creating assets for Steam, PlayStation, Xbox and other gaming platforms**


* Experience working with 3D assets or game engines to prepare promotional compositions and screenshots
* Knowledge of Blender, Unreal Engine, Unity or similar 3D tools
* Strong photo manipulation, image editing and post\-processing skills
* Ability to take existing in\-game content and transform it into compelling promotional visuals
* Ability to adapt to an established visual identity while also proposing new creative directions
* Ability to receive feedback, make changes quickly and iterate efficiently
* Strong attention to detail combined with the ability to balance quality and delivery speed
* Proactive, self\-driven mindset and ability to work independently
* Fluent English, spoken and written
* Shares and upholds our High Standards


Due to the seniority of this role, we will only consider candidates who meet the requirements above.


### **Nice to have**


* Experience with motion graphics or video editing
* Familiarity with Figma
* UI/UX or in\-game UI experience
* Experience working on sci\-fi, simulation or technically oriented games

**Key responsibilities**
------------------------


* Report to the Executive Producer
* Help define, maintain, and evolve the visual brand identity of Space Engineers across marketing materials, platforms, and campaigns.
* Create high\-quality marketing and promotional artwork for Space Engineers and Space Engineers 2
* Develop compelling visual concepts based on in\-game content, screenshots, 3D assets and existing game art
* Create a wide range of graphical materials, including:
* + key visuals
	+ promotional screenshots and beauty shots
	+ store and platform assets
	+ banners
	+ social media graphics
	+ splash screens
	+ logos and branding elements
	+ campaign visuals
	+ event and presentation materials
	+ other 2D promotional artwork
* Capture, compose and post\-process in\-game imagery to achieve strong promotional quality
* Adapt key visuals into multiple formats, resolutions and platform requirements while maintaining consistency and quality
* Collaborate with artists, marketing, production and other disciplines to understand the purpose and audience of each asset
* Explore multiple visual directions quickly before committing to final polish
* Maintain consistency with the established artistic direction and identity of Space Engineers
* Take technical and production constraints into account when proposing concepts and solutions
* Incorporate feedback efficiently and bring assets to a high\-quality final state
* Identify opportunities to improve workflows, templates and production efficiency, particularly for recurring marketing assets

**What we value**
-----------------


* Hold yourself to A\-player standards
* **Strong visual judgment** – understand what makes an image compelling, readable and effective
* **Speed, clarity and ownership** – we expect results, not status updates
* **Iteration over attachment** – explore quickly, take feedback well and be willing to discard an idea when a better one emerges
* **Purpose\-driven design** – understand what an asset needs to communicate rather than simply making it look attractive
* **Versatility** – comfortably switch between different types of marketing and 2D tasks
* **Direct communication and execution** – no politics, no hiding behind blockers, no red tape

**What you'll find at Keen Software House:**
--------------------------------------------


**Impact**


* Leave your mark on one of the most technically ambitious sandbox engineering games ever made.
* Join an international team tackling hard problems


**How we work:**


* Hybrid by default: work from home when you want
* Low bureaucracy, fast decisions


**Time off \& wellbeing**


* 25 days of annual leave.
* Flexible sick leave.


**Workspace**


* Modern offices at Oranžerie, Prague \- quiet focus zones, beautiful garden, great daylight, quality equipment, bike storage, gym and shower, fully stocked kitchen, lunches prepared by our private chefs
  


**Community**


* Regular team breakfasts, workshops, and relaxed meetups (BBQ, game nights, parties, teambuildings)

title: Supply Chain Optimization Planner
description:
### **¡Lidera la Transformación Data\-Driven de nuestra Cadena de Suministro!**

  

En Leroy Merlin España estamos inmersos en la reinvención de nuestra Supply Chain, construyendo un sistema planificado, industrializado, centralizado y data\-driven. Buscamos un/a Supply Chain Optimization Planner que sea el motor de este nuevo proceso, conectando estrategia, datos y ejecución operativa. Si te apasiona la analítica avanzada, prosperas resolviendo problemas complejos en un entorno de alta visibilidad y quieres orquestar el flujo de producto extremo a extremo, ¡este es tu proyecto transformador!

#### **Este reto es para ti si…**

* Tienes una sólida **Formación Superior** en Ingeniería, Matemáticas, Estadística o similares, lo que te permite abordar problemas con una metodología analítica rigurosa.
* Aportas una **experiencia de 3 a 5 años** en Supply Chain, con foco en planificación, optimización y/o consultoría especializada en la cadena de suministro.
* Tienes experiencia demostrable en **análisis y gestión de datos**, siendo muy valorable tu manejo de SQL y lenguajes analíticos como Python.
* Te motiva la estrategia de red (network design) y la alta capacidad de liderar proyectos transversalmente con múltiples stakeholders.

#### **Qué harás**


Serás el motor de la planificación integrada, garantizando que los volúmenes planificados sean ejecutables y eficientes a lo largo de toda la cadena:

* **Liderazgo de Planificación**: Liderarás la planificación a medio y corto plazo (Sales \& Operations Execution), utilizando y optimizando herramientas de machine learning.
* **Optimización y Algoritmos**: Supervisarás, parametrizarás y propondrás mejoras en las herramientas y algoritmos que definen los volúmenes de aprovisionamiento y las necesidades de transporte.
* **Orquestación Transversal:** Asegurarás que la planificación integra los planes de venta de Demand Planning y coordinarás la capacidad de recepción necesaria en centros de distribución y tiendas.
* **Eficiencia en Transporte:** Trabajarás conjuntamente con el equipo de Transporte para mejorar el posicionamiento y la consecución de almacenes, supervisando el máximo llenado y eficiencia de nuestro transporte.
* **Impacto Estratégico:** Tu función será clave para conectar estrategia, datos y ejecución, facilitando la visibilidad del flujo de producto desde el proveedor hasta el cliente final.

#### **Si lo que más valoras es…**

* **Aprendizaje y desarrollo:** Trabajar con datos reales en una red logística compleja, aprendiendo sobre inventarios y Supply Chain en un retailer líder.
* **Impacto visible:** Ver cómo tus decisiones mejoran la experiencia del cliente, la disponibilidad de producto y los costes logísticos.
* **Trabajo en equipo:** Colaborar con múltiples áreas y ser el punto de conexión entre estrategia, datos y operación.
* **Cultura cercana y humana:** Un entorno donde se fomenta la autonomía, la mejora continua y la colaboración.

#### **Lo que ofrecemos**

* **Un Onboarding de Impacto:** Una inmersión completa en nuestra estrategia de Supply Chain y red logística para que comprendas el flujo del producto desde el origen hasta el cliente.
* **Desarrollo Profesional:** Oportunidad de liderar proyectos estratégicos en un entorno *Data\-Driven*, con acceso a formación continua en herramientas de análisis y gestión de inventarios.
* **Flexibilidad y Conciliación:** Disfruta de la comodidad del **trabajo híbrido (2 días de teletrabajo a la semana)** y de **horarios flexibles** que facilitan tu equilibrio personal y profesional.
* **Beneficios de Bienestar:** Acceso a **seguro de salud privado** y programas de salud y bienestar diseñados para cuidar de ti.
* **Accionariado y Retribución Flexible:** Te ofrecemos la posibilidad de formar parte del éxito de la compañía a través de nuestros planes de participación.

  

Tu visión analítica y estratégica será la clave para que nuestra red logística funcione con la máxima precisión. Si estás listo/a para transformar los datos en decisiones que impacten directamente en la satisfacción de nuestros clientes y en la sostenibilidad de nuestra operación... **¡te estamos buscando!**

description:

------------------



Xsolla is looking for a Senior Delivery Manager to help bring greater clarity, coordination, and operational discipline across our product development teams.



This role sits at the center of product execution, working closely with Product Managers, Engineers, Designers, Analytics, Marketing, and other Delivery Managers to ensure teams are aligned on priorities, dependencies, timelines, and changes.



The Senior Delivery Manager will own the operating rhythm of the team: maintaining the backlog and roadmap, running engineering ceremonies, surfacing risks and blockers, and ensuring that changes are communicated clearly—not just what is changing, but why.



Beyond day\-to\-day delivery, this person will also play an important role in identifying broader operational challenges and working with leadership to improve how the team plans, communicates, prioritizes, and executes.



### **Key Responsibilities**


### **Cross\-Functional Alignment**


* Work closely with Product Managers, Engineers, Designers, Analytics, Marketing, Project Managers, and other stakeholders to ensure alignment across initiatives.
* Maintain visibility into dependencies, timelines, priorities, and risks across teams.
* Proactively identify areas where teams are becoming misaligned and drive the conversations necessary to resolve them.
* Ensure stakeholders understand both what the team is doing and how individual activities connect to broader product and business priorities.

### **Team Execution \& Scrum**


* Run and facilitate engineering scrum ceremonies, including stand\-ups, sprint planning, refinement, retrospectives, and other working sessions as needed.
* Ensure teams leave meetings with clear decisions, owners, and next steps.
* Track blockers and risks through resolution rather than simply documenting them.
* Help create a predictable and effective operating cadence between Product and Engineering.

### **Backlog \& Roadmap Management**


* Build, maintain, and continuously improve the team backlog and roadmap in partnership with Product and Engineering leadership.
* Ensure work is clearly prioritized, appropriately structured, and visible to stakeholders.
* Maintain clarity between committed roadmap work, future opportunities, operational improvements, and unscheduled backlog items.
* Identify dependencies, sequencing challenges, and resource conflicts before they become delivery issues.

### **Change Management \& Communication**


* Communicate changes to priorities, timelines, scope, and direction clearly and proactively.
* Help teams understand the why behind changes so that Engineers, Designers, and other stakeholders have the context necessary to make better decisions.
* Ensure important decisions and changes are documented and communicated consistently across impacted teams.
* Help reduce confusion caused by fragmented or inconsistent communication.

### **Operational Improvement**


* Identify recurring execution challenges, process breakdowns, organizational friction, and operational gaps.
* Work with leadership to understand root causes and define strategies for addressing them.
* Translate operational strategies into actionable improvements for the team.
* Continuously evaluate how planning, prioritization, communication, and execution processes can be improved.
* Encourage accountability across teams and help ensure problems are driven toward resolution rather than passed between functions.
### **What Success Looks Like**



Success in this role means teams have greater clarity and predictability in how they operate.



The right candidate will help create an environment where:


* Teams understand what the highest priorities are and why.
* Product, Engineering, Design, Analytics, and Marketing remain aligned as plans evolve.
* Roadmaps and backlogs accurately reflect the work of the team.
* Risks and dependencies are surfaced early rather than discovered late.
* Changes are communicated clearly and with appropriate context.
* Meetings result in decisions and action rather than additional ambiguity.
* Operational problems are identified proactively and systematically improved.
* Leadership has confidence in the team’s ability to execute against its commitments.
### **Skills \& Experience**


### **Strong Communication**


* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills.
* Able to communicate effectively across technical, product, creative, and business teams.
* Comfortable facilitating discussions involving competing priorities or viewpoints.
* Able to simplify complex situations and provide teams with clear direction and context.

### **Highly Organized**


* Exceptional organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple initiatives, dependencies, stakeholders, and timelines simultaneously.
* Strong attention to detail while maintaining awareness of broader strategic priorities.
* Comfortable creating structure in environments where processes or responsibilities may not yet be clearly defined.

### **Diligent \& Proactive**


* Does not wait for problems to become urgent before addressing them.
* Proactively identifies risks, gaps, dependencies, and areas of confusion.
* Consistently follows through on decisions, commitments, and open items.
* Takes ownership of driving issues toward resolution.

### **Strategic \& Operational Thinking**


* Able to distinguish between isolated execution problems and broader systemic challenges.
* Comfortable working with leadership to improve how teams operate.
* Strong problem\-solving skills and an ability to identify root causes rather than treating symptoms.
* Able to balance immediate delivery needs with longer\-term improvements to team effectiveness.
### **Preferred Experience**


* Significant experience in Project Management, Program Management, Product Operations, or a similar role within a technology or software organization.
* Experience working closely with Product Management and Engineering teams.
* Strong understanding of Agile/Scrum development practices.
* Experience managing product roadmaps, engineering backlogs, and cross\-functional dependencies.
* Experience working in complex organizations with multiple teams and stakeholders.
* Experience in gaming, payments, e\-commerce, or technology platforms is a plus.

title: Machine Learning Operations Architect (with medical device experience)
description:
#### **Your mission**

  

We are scientists, doctors, techies and humanity lovers, with the mission of pioneering real time precision neurology to cure brain\-related disorders. INBRAIN harnesses the extraordinary material properties of Graphene, the world’s thinnest and nobel\-prize winning material, to build high resolution neural systems. *Our mission is to decode and modulate neural networks to restore people's lives.*  

  

As a **Machine Learning Operations Architect**, you will architect and own the model lifecycle governance and deployment infrastructure. The role bridges **MLOps engineering with medical\-device design\-control practice**: it defines how models are versioned, validated, and promoted, and builds the change\-control framework (aligned with a PCCP\-style approach) that governs how adaptive, continuously\-learning models can be safely updated post\-deployment.  

  

You will be at the forefront of bringing advanced healthcare solutions to market, making a tangible difference in people´s lives worldwide.

#### **Your profile**

 **Main Responsibilities:**

  

* Design and build the model versioning, lineage, and validation\-evidence system that ties every trained model to its training data, the data source origin, risk management, and clinical evidence.
* Draft and maintain a Predetermined Change Control Plan (PCCP)\-style framework defining permitted modification types, bounds, and automated re\-validation protocols for adaptive models, in collaboration with clinical, regulatory, product and software stakeholders.
* Design and configure the CI/CD pipeline for training, validating, and promoting models, running on infrastructure provided by the Software team, with promotion gates across Development, Testing, Acceptance and Production (DTAP) tiers.
* Build drift and performance monitoring for models and define triggers for scheduled vs. drift\-triggered retraining as part of post\-market surveillance activity.
* Deployed and maintained processes and services versioning and tracing them against design\-control processes.

  

**Mandatory Qualifications and Soft skills:**  

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, Electrical Engineering or a related field.
* At least **4\-5 years of Hands\-on** **ML Ops** **engineering experience (preferably in medtech industry)**: model versioning/registries (MLFlowor equivalent), CI/CD for ML, containerized deployment (Kubernetes), and workflow orchestration (e.g.Argo or equivalent).
* **Strong Architecture experience within industry setting (only academia or traineeship will not be considered).**
* Proven experience shipping ML into a regulated or safety\-critical environment (medtech \- priority, automotive, aerospace), has designed systems to automatize design\-control processes (e.g.IEC 62304, ISO 13485, DO\-178C, ISO 26262\) and has used them from the inside.
* Strong infrastructure\-as\-code skills and comfort directly supporting data scientists to productionize research code written in Python.
* **Fluency in English** required (English is company language).
* Direct experience with continuous/adaptive learning systems under a change\-control or PCCP\-like framework, delivering personalized evolving models in contrast to single model validation for universal use releases.
* Comfortable operating at the intersection of engineering and regulatory/clinical teams, translating design\-control requirements into concrete technical implementation.
* Pragmatic about scope and sequencing — able to prioritize the governance/compliance work.
* Strong written documentation skills, given the role's heavy emphasis on producing auditable change\-control and validation records.

  

**Nice to have:**  

* Experience with FDA's Predetermined Change Control Plan (PCCP) guidance or equivalent adaptive\-SaMD regulatory frameworks (e.g.through an imaging/diagnostic AI company that has filed one).
* Background in adaptive neurostimulation, closed\-loop deep brain stimulation or closed\-loop diabetes management with insulin pumps.
* Familiarity with clinical data standards (FHIR, SNOMED CT, NWB/BIDS) and ISO 14155/MDR/ICH E9 evidence frameworks.

#### **Why us?**

  

We are looking for someone who Is ready to proactively bring new ideas to the team, push boundaries, and constantly look for innovation. At INBRAIN we believe in shared success and diverse ways of thinking, here you'll learn, grow, and advance in an innovative culture  

  

**WHAT CAN WE OFFER TO YOU?**

  

* A collaborative environment where innovative ideas flourish and teamwork drives us forward. At INBRAIN, we believe the power of collective intelligence is unique. You will be part of a team that thrives on open communication, knowledge sharing and mutual respect.
* Meaningful Work Impact: Our projects are not only exciting and challenging but also have a positive impact on the industry and society as a whole. You'll be part of a team that strives to create meaningful change.

* Internal flexible compensation scheme

***Applications must be submitted in En******glish***  

  

At INBRAIN, we're not just offering a job – we're inviting you to be part of a transformative journey, Are you ready to transform lives? Join us!  

  

***\#diverseandinclusive***  

We believe that a diverse and well\-balanced workforce drives innovation. At INBRAIN, we foster the inclusion of all people regardless of culture, age, gender, sexual orientation, identity and diverse abilities or any other status.#### **About us**

**At Inbrain Neuroelectronics, we built our company around a simple belief: great science needs great people.**

description:
About Us


HarZa Group is a fast\-growing operator of direct\-to\-consumer brands in health and wellness. Our flagship brand, Rejuvacare, serves more than 400,000 customers with products targeting chronic pain and mobility, including RejuvaKnee, FootRenew, RejuvaFlow and OzemPatch. We ship primarily to the United States and run a membership program that powers recurring revenue. The company has scaled 12x in a single year to nearly 150 people across more than 15 countries. We are remote\-first, async\-first, and hold a high standard of accountability across everything we do.


The Role


We are a direct\-to\-consumer business where technology is a direct function of marketing. Our marketing team can develop a campaign idea and write the copy for it in a single day, but that idea only starts producing revenue once it has become a live, accurate and fully functioning landing page, checkout or funnel. The speed of our production function therefore sets the speed of the entire business.


We are hiring a Head of Web Production to build and own the operating system through which marketing requirements become live digital experiences. Your responsibility is not to manage tasks, chase deadlines or add project management meetings. It is to redesign how the work gets done. You will examine every stage of production, remove unnecessary handoffs, improve requirements, manage dependencies, install effective quality controls, and decide where AI, automation, page builders, reusable components or traditional development should be used.


For every requirement you should be asking whether this genuinely needs a developer, whether it can be built from an existing component or template, whether an AI\-enabled page builder can complete most of it, whether the marketing team can safely complete it without engineering, whether the requirement can be eliminated or standardized, whether the quality check can be automated, and why it is taking as long as it is. Your job is to protect the business objective while continuously challenging the method used to achieve it.


To be explicit about scope, this is not a cloud infrastructure or site reliability role. This is web production and development operations for a high\-volume direct response marketing business.

 **Requirements**  

What You Will Own


The Production Operating System


Map and redesign the workflow from marketing request to production launch, identifying bottlenecks, unnecessary handoffs, waiting time and duplicated work, and establishing clear ownership at every stage. Define what information must exist before work can begin, create work\-in\-progress limits and prioritization rules, and build separate production lanes for urgent changes, standard pages, experiments and complex technical projects so that urgent work stops destroying the predictability of planned work. Create clear escalation paths for blockers and for requirements that change mid\-build.


Requirements and Task Definition


Build standardized briefs for landing pages, checkouts, funnels, upsells and technical changes, and establish a Definition of Ready for every category of work so that incomplete or ambiguous requests never enter development. Ensure every requirement carries complete copy, design direction, references, responsive behaviour, tracking requirements and acceptance criteria, and translate marketing intent into specifications that developers and page builders can execute without repeated clarification. Create a controlled process for requirements that change after development has begun.


AI\-First Production


Audit the full production process for opportunities to use AI and automation, evaluate AI coding tools, AI page builders, no\-code platforms, reusable components and template\-based systems, and determine the right balance between developers, page builders, designers and AI\-enabled operators. Build workflows where AI converts approved briefs, copy and designs into high\-quality first drafts, install guardrails that allow non\-developers to build safely without damaging performance, tracking or brand standards, and reduce repetitive development through reusable sections and approved design systems. Measure the actual impact of AI on cycle time, cost, quality and throughput rather than assuming it.


Dependencies and Capacity


Create visibility over the workload and capacity of development, design and other shared resources, identify dependencies before work enters production, and sequence work based on when copy, graphics, video, development and approvals will realistically be available. Prevent developers from being assigned work that cannot be completed because a dependency is missing, build a capacity planning system that lets marketing understand what can actually be delivered and when, and surface constraints early enough for the business to reprioritize or find an alternative. Reduce reliance on informal messages and on individual managers holding critical information in their heads.


Quality Built Into the Process


Move quality control upstream instead of relying on final\-stage inspection. Introduce developer self\-QC before any task is submitted, create standardized QC checklists by page and funnel type, define acceptance criteria before development begins, and establish an independent final QC process that does not depend entirely on one person. Implement automated testing wherever practical, including visual regression, broken links, responsive layouts, tracking, checkout functionality, browser compatibility and page performance. Categorize defects, track root causes, and ensure repeated defects change the underlying system, checklist, component or training rather than being corrected one at a time.


Team Structure and Capability


Lead the existing production team and raise its operating standard. Determine which work should be completed by developers and which should be completed by AI\-enabled production specialists, and make sure capability is matched to the work. Coach the team on estimation, task clarification, self\-QC and AI\-assisted workflows, set clear performance expectations for speed, predictability and quality, and build enough documentation and shared visibility that the function does not depend on any single person holding critical context.


The Measurement System


Build and maintain reporting on request\-to\-launch cycle time, active production time versus waiting time, throughput by work category, on\-time delivery, clarification interactions after assignment, first\-pass QC rate, average revision rounds, escaped defect rate, rework hours, blocker age, the share of work completed through reusable components or AI\-assisted workflows, cost per page or funnel, and marketing launch delays caused by technology or creative dependencies. These metrics exist to improve the system, not to generate reporting.


How Success Will Be Measured


Your first thirty days are about establishing a baseline. We do not currently measure cycle time, waiting time, clarification loops, rework or escaped defects, so your first task is to map the current state from request to launch and put real numbers against it, then produce a prioritized roadmap for improving the system. We would rather agree ambitious targets against real data than hand you numbers invented before anyone measured anything.


By sixty days we expect a standardized intake and requirements process, clear Definitions of Ready and Done, service\-level expectations by category of work, visibility over development and creative capacity, dependency planning across copy, design, video, development, tracking and approvals, piloted AI\-assisted and template\-driven workflows, and a live operating dashboard covering speed, quality and throughput.


By ninety days we expect the function to be trending strongly toward a materially shorter median request\-to\-launch cycle time, the large majority of work delivered by the committed date, the large majority of work passing final QC without another development round, a sharp reduction in issues identified after approval by the CEO or the media buyer, full visibility over active work, dependencies, blockers and capacity, standard page types produced without bespoke development, and higher throughput without a corresponding increase in headcount. Exact targets will be finalized against your baseline.  

  

What We Are Looking For


Significant experience improving the operations of a web development, digital production or growth technology team, with a proven record of reducing delivery time, increasing throughput or improving first\-pass quality. Experience in an environment where development speed directly affects revenue. A strong working understanding of landing pages, ecommerce funnels, checkouts, upsells, testing and conversion\-focused web production.


Enough technical depth to challenge estimates, architecture choices and development approaches, including a working understanding of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, APIs, analytics, tracking, page builders and modern web development workflows. Experience implementing AI tools or automation inside a real production environment rather than as a pilot or a talking point. Experience designing intake processes, acceptance criteria, capacity planning and quality control systems, and a strong grasp of dependencies and constraint management.


The ability to communicate effectively with marketers, copywriters, designers, media buyers and developers, and the confidence to challenge senior stakeholders when a requirement is unclear, unnecessarily complicated or being solved in the wrong way. Strong analytical ability, comfort making decisions from operational data, and a bias toward simplification, standardization and measurable results.


Experience with direct response ecommerce, high\-volume web production, Shopify, Checkout Champ, Figma, landing page builders, CRO testing and marketing analytics is highly advantageous. Formal qualifications are not required where there is strong evidence of relevant outcomes. You must be able to overlap consistently with our collaboration window of 8:00am to 12:00pm EST.


This Role Is Not


This is not a traditional cloud\-infrastructure DevOps role, a Jira administration role, a project coordinator position, or a role focused on running agile ceremonies. It is not a role for someone who accepts every requirement without questioning it, whose first answer to any constraint is additional headcount, who can describe AI tools but has never embedded them into an operational workflow, or who wants engineering leadership disconnected from marketing and revenue.

 **Benefits**  

What We Offer


A fully remote senior position with genuine ownership of a function that directly determines how fast the business can move. We offer paid time off, a monthly wellness stipend, medical insurance support, a company\-funded computer allowance after a tenure milestone, a birthday gift card, an in\-country meetup allowance, and participation in company\-funded leadership offsites. You will have direct access to the founders, a high\-volume testing environment, and the mandate to build the system rather than inherit someone else's process.

**Responsibilities**

**Job ID** R\-259736 **Date posted** 09/09/2026

**About AstraZeneca and AISI**


At AstraZeneca, technology and science meet to change what is possible for patients. We are building a connected, end\-to\-end Enterprise AI engine — uniting data foundations, AI technology, process reinvention, and business\-facing AI to accelerate results across the whole value chain. Success depends on being exceptional connectors: you will actively leverage existing capabilities, celebrate and promote reuse, export breakthrough ideas across geographies and functions, and obsess over scaling impact rather than building in isolation.


AI Science \& Innovation (AISI) sits at the centre of AstraZeneca's R\&D AI transformation. Our remit is to build, buy, and deliver the AI models and agents that change pipeline outcomes across discovery, translational science, biomarkers, and clinical development.


Within AISI, the Clinical AI teams are building world\-class AI capability to accelerate the design, conduct, and analysis of clinical trials across our BioPharmaceuticals pipelines — spanning both early and late phase programmes. We partner closely with clinical development, regulatory, and biometrics teams to bring better treatments to patients faster, while adhering to the highest evidentiary standards.


**The Opportunity**


Bringing new treatments to patients demands scientific excellence at every stage of development. In the Clinical AI team, we focus on one of the most data\-rich and decision\-intensive parts of that journey: clinical development. Trial design, patient selection, dose optimisation, biomarker strategy, and safety evaluation each represent genuine opportunities where AI and machine learning can add rigour, speed, and precision — not as a replacement for clinical and statistical expertise, but as a powerful complement to it. We hold ourselves to measurable standards of improvement, and we build methods that can be evaluated, reproduced, and trusted in regulatory settings.


You will work across the enterprise to define and deliver on AstraZeneca's most pressing clinical development questions — leading cross\-functional teams spanning the key BioPharmaceuticals disease areas of cardiovascular, renal, metabolic disease, respiratory, immunology and cell\-therapy. You and the team will develop reusable methods and enterprise\-scale approaches that measurably advance the late\-stage drug pipeline. This is a high\-visibility opportunity to shape how AstraZeneca does AI for BioPharmaceuticals clinical development — from methodology standards to external scientific influence.


AI for clinical development is a field in motion. Foundation models, agentic systems, and causal AI are advancing rapidly, and the regulatory and methodological frameworks around them are evolving in parallel. As a Director, Data Scientist, you will define and drive the AI methodology agenda for one or more programmes within Clinical AI, leading by scientific influence and matrix coordination rather than through a formal hierarchy. You will be the scientific authority that study teams, biometrics, and regulatory colleagues turn to — and AstraZeneca's voice externally at the critical moment when the rules of the road for AI in clinical trials are being written.


**Key Responsibilities**


* Define and drive the AI methodology roadmap for assigned Clinical AI programmes, spanning early and late phase clinical development, and aligning AI/ML priorities with clinical and business objectives.
* Lead, by matrix influence and scientific authority, the delivery of the most complex and high\-stakes AI projects — from problem definition and methodology selection through validation, regulatory alignment, and scaled adoption across the enterprise.
* Develop and govern reusable, enterprise\-grade AI methods and evaluation frameworks for clinical trial settings, including innovative trial design support, dose optimisation, biomarker discovery, digital twins, predictive and prognostic modelling, and safety and efficacy signal detection.
* Champion data\-centric AI practices at programme level: govern the acquisition, curation, and quality control of datasets for model training, post\-training, benchmarking, and evaluation across clinical and regulatory settings.
* Partner with Clinical Development, Biometrics, Regulatory, and Study Teams to embed AI strategy and validated solutions into study design and decision\-making at programme level.
* Shape the AI evidence component for regulatory submission packages; act as the scientific and methodological voice in regulatory engagements involving AI/ML methods or innovative trial designs (FDA, EMA, MHRA).
* Evaluate and champion cutting\-edge AI methodologies — including foundation models, agentic AI systems, generative patient models, multimodal learning, Bayesian inference, causal inference, and model calibration and domain adaptation — proposing fit\-for\-purpose approaches with robust evaluation criteria and risk assessment.
* Establish and maintain external collaborations with academic institutions, technology partners, and industry consortia to access novel capabilities and advance the scientific agenda.
* Represent AstraZeneca at scientific conferences, standards bodies, and peer\-reviewed venues; contribute first\- or last\-author publications in leading ML and clinical AI journals.
* Serve as a technical mentor and thought partner for Associate Directors and Senior Data Scientists within the Clinical AI team; promote scientific rigour, reuse, and a culture of learning in public.
* Contribute to the broader AISI AI for Clinical Development strategy, including cross\-functional ways of working, tooling governance, and methodology standards.

**Essential Requirements**


* PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, Mathematics, Biomedical Informatics, Computational Biology, or a closely related quantitative discipline — with a strong, hands\-on computational track record.
* 4–8 years of post\-PhD experience in AI and machine learning method development, with demonstrated and sustained impact in clinical, biomedical, or drug development settings (e.g. models delivered, first\-author publications, patents, SaMD filings, open\-source projects).
* Deep experience, knowledge, and understanding of one or more fields of biology, with hands\-on experience working with biological data such as molecular (DNA, RNA, protein), imaging (radiology, microscopy), or clinical text (EHR, clinical notes).
* Deep expertise in modern AI methodologies, including one or more of: foundation model training and fine\-tuning; Bayesian inference; temporal and longitudinal modelling; multimodal integration; model calibration and domain adaptation; data\-centric AI; model interpretability; model post\-training and alignment.
* Exceptional software engineering skills: Python, deep learning frameworks (e.g. PyTorch), frontier coding agent frameworks, modern LLM tooling, and cloud platforms (e.g. AWS, Azure, GCP).
* Demonstrated experience translating AI methods into applications that inform clinical and/or biomedical decisions, including prospective evaluation or contribution to submission\-relevant evidence.
* Track record of driving scientific influence across cross\-functional communities — ML, clinical, biostatistics, regulatory — without relying on formal authority.
* Peer\-reviewed publications in clinical AI, computational drug development, or leading ML venues (e.g. NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, Nature Medicine, Lancet Digital Health).
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with demonstrated ability to translate technical findings for clinical, regulatory, and executive audiences.

**Desirable Skills and Experience**


* Direct industry experience in early or late phase BioPharmaceuticals clinical development, including clinical trial design, biomarker discovery, companion diagnostics, dosing, safety, endpoints, or regulatory processes.
* Direct experience contributing to FDA, EMA, PMDA, or MHRA submissions involving AI/ML methods or innovative trial designs.
* Prior regulatory engagement on AI methodology, complex innovative trial design, or AI/ML qualification opinions.
* Experience with MLOps and LLMOps at scale, including CI/CD pipelines and enterprise deployment.
* Open\-source contributions, workshop organisation, or standards\-body participation.
* Knowledge of computing hardware and its impact on model training and inference at scale.
* Experience in a complex global organisation spanning multiple sites and therapy areas.
* Strong proficiency in augmenting — but not supplanting — daily knowledge work with agentic AI tools.
* Proactively up\-to\-date with the latest AI research; tries out new tools and methods of interest without waiting to be directed.

**Why AstraZeneca?**


Here, technology and science meet to change what is possible for patients. You will join a company investing boldly in AI and data to become truly data\-led, where unexpected teams come together to address problems that have never been solved before. When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we ignite bold thinking with the power to inspire life\-changing medicines.


The playbook for AI in clinical development will be written in the next two to three years. You will help write it — with an outsized voice at regulatory agencies, scientific consortia, and external partners during the narrow window when the rules of the road for AI in pivotal evidence are being defined. We hire for learning agility and technical excellence. The strongest candidates here learn fast, are comfortable with ambiguity, prototype early, fail forward, and partner credibly across communities. title: Design Engineer - Creative & Studio
description:
**About ElevenLabs**
--------------------


ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.


We launched in January 2023 with the first human\-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses \- from fast\-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia.
