description:
**Job Description:**
--------------------

**Employer:** **DWS Group**

**Title:** **Corporate Functions AI Strategy and Adoption Lead, Director**

**Location:** **Madrid**

**Job Code:** *placeholder for LinkedIn job wrapping*

**About DWS:**

Today, markets face a whole new set of pressures – but also a whole lot of opportunity too. Opportunity to innovate differently. Opportunity to invest responsibly. And opportunity to make change.


Join us at DWS, and you can be part of an industry\-leading firm with a global presence. You can lead ambitious opportunities and shape the future of investing. You can support our clients, local communities, and the environment.


We’re looking for creative thinkers and innovators to join us as the world continues to transform. As whole markets change, one thing remains clear; our people always work together to capture the opportunities of tomorrow.


As investors on behalf of our clients, it is our role to find investment solutions. Ensuring the best possible foundation for our clients’ financial future. And in return, we’ll give you the support and platform to develop new skills, make an impact and work alongside some of the industry’s greatest thought leaders. This is your chance to achieve your goals and lead an extraordinary career.


This is your chance to invest in your future.


Read more about DWS and who we are here.


**Team / division overview**

The role sits at the intersection of hands\-on delivery and strategic influence. You will work directly with engineers, analysts, delivery leads, and business stakeholders to identify meaningful AI use cases, build practical examples, coach teams, and remove blockers to adoption. At the same time, you will translate what is being learned on the ground into clear recommendations for leadership, tooling, governance, roadmap choices, and ways of working.


Reporting into the Head of Corporate Functions (CF) Technology, you will be embedded in the area where AI adoption needs to happen. You will also work closely with the DWS AI Centre of Excellence, ensuring that Corporate Functions is both aligned to enterprise AI direction and actively shaping it through real delivery experience. You will help create and nurture the Corporate Functions AI Community of Practice, so that knowledge, experimentation, and adoption are shared across teams rather than remaining isolated in individual pockets.


**Your responsibilities –**

As Corporate Functions AI Strategy and Adoption Lead, Director, you will:


* Act as the primary AI champion embedded within the delivery and operational teams, working alongside engineers, analysts, and delivery leads to embed AI into everyday practice.
* Lead and facilitate the AI Open House and equivalent adoption programmes including curating peer wins, facilitating skill\-building segments, and visibly resolving blockers.
* Coach individuals and teams on practical AI use, from prompt engineering and gen\-AI features through to building RAG pipelines and agentic workflows.
* Serve as the primary convenor and energiser of the AI Community of Practice ensuring it has rhythm, relevance, and genuine peer ownership.
* Curate and grow a shared knowledge base of AI use cases, prompt libraries, lessons learned, and emerging tools relevant to the team.
* Design and run lightweight experimentation programmes including challenges, hackathons, discovery sprints that surface new AI applications and build confidence across teams.
* Act as the CF technology team’s primary AI thought leader and strategic advisor to leadership translating field\-level insight into strategic recommendations.
* Stay current with AI developments across the industry particularly in financial services and bring relevant intelligence into AI CoE leadership conversations and roadmap decisions.
* Advise CF business stakeholders on how AI can be applied to their specific domains, translating technical capability into business value language.
* Build, test, and iterate on AI\-powered tools, prototypes, and integrations demonstrating feasibility and sparking wider adoption through working examples.
* Design and implement end\-to\-end AI solutions including RAG pipelines, LLM\-powered applications, and agentic workflows that connect AI to real business processes.
* Evaluate internal and SaaS AI models, platforms, and tooling including LLMs, agentic frameworks, and productivity tools and make grounded recommendations based on practical, production\-aware experience.

We are looking for


* Demonstrable hands\-on experience building software, with confidence working in a modern development environment and credibility with engineering teams.
* Practical, working experience with AI models and tools including LLMs, prompt engineering, AI\-assisted coding tools such as GitHub CoPilot or equivalent. Demonstrable delivery of at least one RAG implementation, an agentic workflow, a fine\-tuned model, or a production LLM integration.
* A genuine track record of driving AI adoption within an organization, making it happen at the team level and measuring what changed.
* Experience working in or closely with technology teams in complex organizations — ideally within financial services, professional services, or similarly regulated environments.
* Demonstrated ability to work across multiple organizational layers from coaching junior developers to briefing senior leadership
* Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs.
* Proficiency in Python (strongly preferred) and comfort working in a modern development environment
* Working knowledge of LLM APIs such as OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure OpenAI, or equivalent and experience building applications on top of them beyond simple prompting.
* Hands\-on experience with AI development tooling: vector databases, embedding models, orchestration frameworks, and evaluation and observability approaches.
* Understanding of agentic AI patterns, including tool use, planning, multi\-agent coordination with experience designing or building systems that use them.
* Understanding of how regulated financial services organizations operate including data sensitivity, compliance constraints, and the specific risk appetite that shapes technology decisions.
* Awareness of how leading financial institutions are approaching AI adoption.
* Ability to translate AI capability into business value language relevant to financial services such as risk reduction, control improvement, cost efficiency, revenue enablement, client experience and making the case to non\-technical stakeholders.
* Demonstrably well\-read on AI developments. You follow research, read technical blogs, track model releases, and can hold a credible conversation about where the field is heading and what it means for the organisation.
* Strong understanding of change management and adoption dynamics. You know why people resist new tools and how to meet them where they are and led early interest into sustained adoption.
* Curious about the intersection of AI and organisational design \-how capability builds, how communities form, and what it takes to move an institution rather than just a team.

**What we’ll offer you:**

At DWS we’re serious about diversity, equity and creating an inclusive culture where colleagues can be themselves and it’s important to us that you enjoy coming to work \- feeling healthy, happy and rewarded. At DWS, you’ll have access to a range of benefits which you can choose from to create a personalised plan unique to your lifestyle. Whether you’re interested in healthcare, company perks, or are thinking about your retirement plan, there’s something for everyone.


DWS’ Hybrid Working model is designed to find the right balance between in\-person collaboration and engagement in the office, which is core to our working culture, and working from home. Each business group varies on the split between time spent in the office and at home, but this will be discussed and made clear as part of your application and interview process. We will continue to review and evolve our working environments and methods to ensure that we are working in the best way possible for our people.


If you require any adjustments or changes to be made to the interview process for any reason including, or related to a disability or long\-term health condition, then please contact your recruiter and let them know what assistance you may need. Examples of adjustments include providing a change to the format of the interview, or providing assistance when at the DWS office. This will not affect your application and your recruitment team will discuss options with you.


We at DWS are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace, one that embraces dialogue and diverse views, and treats everyone fairly to drive a high\-performance culture. The value we create for our clients and investors is based on our ability to bring together various perspectives from all over the world and from different backgrounds. It is our experience that teams perform better and deliver improved outcomes when they are able to incorporate a wide range of perspectives. We call this \#ConnectingTheDots.

Meticulous attention to detail
  
Proactive attitude and ability to work independently while contributing to team objectives
  
Ability to mentor and develop junior team members
  
Meticulous attention to detail
  
Expert proficiency in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint)
  
Willingness to travel regularly throughout Europe for client meetings and site inspections
  
Additional European languages are beneficial but not essential
  
  

What You Can Expect From Us
  
  

At JLL, we make sure that you become the best version of yourself by helping you realize your full potential in an entrepreneurial and inclusive work environment. Our Total Rewards program reflects our commitment to helping you achieve your career ambitions, recognizing your contributions, investing in your well\-being, and providing competitive benefits and pay.
  
  

**We offer:**  

Opportunities for career growth and professional development
  
Collaborative and innovative work environment
  
Competitive salary and performance\-based bonuses
  
Global exposure within a leading real estate services firm
  
  

If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements below. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!
  
  

Personalized benefits that support personal well\-being and growth:

We have operations in over 80 countries and a workforce of over 102,000 individuals around the world who help real estate owners, occupiers and investors achieve their business ambitions. As a global Fortune 500 company, we also have an inherent responsibility to drive sustainability and corporate social responsibility. That’s why we’re committed to our purpose to shape the future of real estate for a better world. ### **Atolls is the world's largest community\-driven shopping platform, active in 20\+ markets.**



We help millions make smarter spending decisions across discovery, evaluation, and (re\-)purchase by connecting people with the right brands and retailers.



Our 1,000\+ team across 10 countries builds products used every day at global scale, where you'll have real ownership and see your impact. Want to shape the destinations people rely on to shop with confidence? Keep reading.

### **About This Role:**



We are looking for a **Head of Product Operations** (m/f/d) to join our Product team in Munich, Madrid, London or Paris with a hybrid work setup. In this role, you will lead and improve the operations that are directly linked to our products. Your work will directly impact our operational integrity notably by enhancing fraud detection, streamlining customer support processes, or managing cash projections. All of which are critical to delivering a trustworthy and seamless experience for our users.



This dedicated product operations position was triggered by the launch of new offer types within our product, and the scope of the role will expand as we innovate with our product.



Your contributions will help shape how millions of consumers interact with our platforms, guiding them to make smart, fair, and rewarding choices.


### **Our Benefits:**



At Atolls, we believe in nurturing both your professional and personal growth. Here's what you can expect:


* A culture that values personal and professional development, with internal mobility opportunities.
* A supportive and open\-minded team that embraces diverse perspectives and innovative ideas.
* 32 days of paid vacation plus your birthday off, giving you the time you need to recharge.
* A flexible hybrid working scheme to balance work and life.
* Access to a learning budget and internal training to help you grow in your role.
* Mental health coaching to support your well\-being.
* Regular global and local get\-togethers to celebrate successes and build connections.
* The possibility of taking a sabbatical after three years with the company.
* A cloud\-based company setup, providing flexibility and collaboration opportunities no matter where you are.


* *These are global benefits that apply to all employees, with additional local perks based on your location.*

### **Responsibilities:**



In this role, you will:


* Drive the entire fraud management and detection across all our product types and at payment process level
* Streamline customer support workflows
* Oversee the maintenance of our coupon auto apply and app to app operations
* Partner with finance to ensure we have enough cash on all our providers' account
* Work cross\-functionally with Product and other teams to translate business needs into scalable operational solutions and continuously improve the performance of our rewards products.


The role is bound to increase in scope. We expect you to champion the use of AI and automation to generate operational insights and drive improvements.

  

### **Your Profile:**



We're looking for someone with


* 3 \- 5 years of experience in strategy consulting, mergers and acquisitions, or operations in tech
* A Master degree from a Tier 1 University
* **Strategic \& Analytical Skills:** Strong problem\-solving and analytical capabilities, with the ability to break down complex business problems, identify opportunities, and develop scalable solutions.
* **Operational Excellence:** Proven ability to design, standardize, and optimize processes across complex or rapidly evolving products and organizations.
* **Leadership \& Collaboration:** A strong leadership track record
* **Mindset:** A proactive and persistent mindset, adaptability in a dynamic environment, and a strong interest in leveraging AI and automation to improve operational efficiency and decision\-making.
* **Language requirements:** Fluent in English and any other European languages is a plus.


### **Our hiring process:**


* **TA Call**: Meet one of our Talent Experts and get to know Atolls better.


* **Technical Round**: Focus on the technical aspects of the role *(Through a Live Case)*, and meet your potential manager.


* **Final Round**: Meet other Atollians ️  

*It varies from 1 to 3 interviews*



* *Some processes might slightly change according to needs*


#### **Ready to apply?**



Be part of a destination where your work helps millions of people make better decisions every day. One focused application is all we need. If you truly fit more than one role, you're welcome to apply to **up to three.** This helps us match you with the right opportunity faster.


**We review every application with equal care and will reach out if your profile aligns. Apply now with your CV in English.**

At Atolls, we want to ensure that all employees can thrive in an inclusive environment. Our employment opportunities are open to every gender, race, religion, age, sexual orientation, ability, place of origin, or socioeconomic status. We remain committed to a culture of diversity, equity and belonging, where all employees are welcomed, respected, connected, and engaged.



As part of our recruitment process at Atolls, we use AI tools for interview recording and transcription. These tools are designed to assist our teams and are never used independently to make hiring decisions. **Every assessment and hiring decision is made by our hiring panel and team through human judgment.**

The use of AI, or the choice not to use it, will not affect your application in any way.

title: People Operations Shared Service Specialist
description:
**Company Description**  

Radisson Hotel Group is one of the world's largest hotel groups with ten distinctive hotel brands, and more than 1,500 hotels in operation and under development in 95\+ countries. The Group’s overarching brand promise is Every Moment Matters with a signature Yes I Can! service ethos. People are at the core of our business success and future. Our people are true Moment Makers and together we bring the culture, spirit, environment and opportunities that empower you to be your best, every day, everywhere, every time. Together, we make Every Moment Matter.

 **Job Description**  

We are currently seeking a People Operations Shared Service Specialist to join our dynamic team in Madrid, supporting our People Operations activities across France.


We are looking for someone with the right mindset above all, someone who is service\-oriented, solutions\-focused and proactive, with a genuine desire to anticipate the needs of People Managers and deliver a positive experience throughout the employee lifecycle.


In this role, you will provide first\-level People Operations support and guidance to Department Heads, responding to queries relating to HR and payroll policies, procedures and programmes. Queries will be managed through a ticketing system according to priority, with complex or sensitive matters escalated to the People Operations Business Partner for France, where appropriate.


You will provide comprehensive administrative support across the employee lifecycle, from recruitment and pre\-employment through to onboarding, employee changes and post\-hire administration. This will include, but is not limited to:

* Posting and closing vacancies through SmartRecruiters and Workday.
* Initiating and validating position and employee changes in Workday.
* Supporting the recruitment process and gathering feedback to help continuously improve the candidate and hiring manager experience.
* Managing a range of HR administration through Workday, the ATS and other People \& Culture systems and tools.
* Providing general HR and payroll administration support.

**Onboarding \& Employee Experience**


You will work closely with Department Heads to ensure a smooth, engaging and positive onboarding experience for new colleagues.


This will include:

* Preparing and sending onboarding documentation.
* Reviewing and validating required forms to ensure compliance and appropriate benefits setup.
* Configuring onboarding workflows and ensuring relevant information and access are in place within Workday.
* Supporting new hire communications and announcements.
* Gathering feedback and identifying opportunities to continuously improve the onboarding experience.

**Performance Management**


Support the administration and coordination of the performance management process, working closely with the People Operations Business Partner for France and the HRIS team.

**HR Administration \& Compliance**


Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date employee records and HR documentation, ensuring compliance with legal requirements, RHG standards, processes and appropriate authorisation protocols.


Provide additional support across benefits administration, leave management and other People Operations activities as required.

**Collaboration \& Continuous Improvement**


Work closely with the People Operations Business Partner and the wider People Operations Shared Services team to deliver an efficient, consistent and high\-quality service.


You will also contribute to continuous improvement initiatives, identifying opportunities to simplify processes, improve the employee and manager experience and enhance the way People Operations services are delivered.

 **Qualifications**  

* Previous experience in Human Resources, People Operations, personnel administration, training and development, or a similar role.
* Experience within the hospitality or wider service industry is highly desirable.
* Good understanding of HR and payroll processes, policies and best practices.
* Experience using Workday, SmartRecruiters or similar HRIS/ATS platforms would be an advantage.
* Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office applications.
* Strong communication and customer service skills, with a proactive and solutions\-focused approach.
* Excellent attention to detail, organisation and confidentiality.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, work to deadlines and adapt to a fast\-paced and changing environment without compromising quality.
* A collaborative approach, with the ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a wider team.
* Strong problem\-solving skills and the confidence to know when an issue requires escalation.

  

**Additional Information**  

Why Join Radisson Hotel Group?  

  

Live the Magic of Hospitality \- Be part of a team that creates exceptional experiences and memorable moments every day. Let your Yes I Can! spirit shine as you bring hospitality to life.  

  

Build a Great Career \- No matter your background or experience, we invest in your growth, learning, and career development, helping you reach your full potential.  

  

Experience the Team Spirit \- Join a workplace that’s inclusive, fun, and meaningful. We celebrate diversity, support one another and foster a sense of belonging through our Employee Resource Groups and inclusion initiatives.  

  

Lead with Your Ambition \- Your ideas, passion and drive matter! We empower you to make a difference—in hospitality, your community and beyond.  

  

Enjoy Global \& Local Perks \- No matter where you’re located, you’ll enjoy exclusive global benefits \- like special hotel rates for you and your loved ones at our hotels worldwide. Plus, you’ll have access to local perks and rewards tailored to your country, making your experience even more rewarding!  

  

Join us in shaping the future of hospitality! If you’re ready to bring your talent, energy, and passion, we’d love to hear from you.  

  

Apply now and let’s make every moment matter.  

  

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, abilities, and experiences. If you need any adjustments during the application process, please let us know.

Mandarin Oriental Hotel Group is the award\-winning owner and operator of some of the most luxurious hotels, resorts and residences located in prime destinations around the world, with a strong development pipeline. Increasingly recognised for creating some of the world’s most sought\-after properties, the Group provides legendary service inspired by Asian heritage whilst representing the very cutting\-edge of luxury experiences.


Set against the stunning backdrop of Puerto Portals, Mandarin Oriental Punta Negra pulses with the vibrant spirit of Mallorca. Based at Mandarin Oriental Punta Negra, Mallorca, as the Social Media Manager, you will be responsible for developing and implementing social media strategies in order to increase online presence and improve marketing and sales efforts of the resort and its outlets. * With the guidance of the Director of Marketing Communications, design and implement the hotel’s social media and e\-commerce strategy with KPIs.
* Proactively plan creative, compelling, and targeted social media activity and campaigns.
* Stay informed of upcoming trends and developments within the field of social media.
* Research and develop new ways to leverage social content to improve performance.
* Setting KPIs for social media agencies and using relevant social media monitoring tools to manage all the resort’s social channels.
* Conduct competitive analysis of studies on competition and provide recommendations on content changes for the resort’s social channels.
* Oversee and manage all social media accounts for the resort, including each F\&B outlet, while leading community management strategies and daily engagement for every account.
* Prepare and implement the annual social media content strategy in accordance to brand.
* Plan and execute social media influencer campaigns, working closely with local and/or international influencers / KOLs and with the Public Relations agency.
* Collaborate create and execute social media campaigns that will generate leads, drive quality traffic and fans/follower’s engagement.
* Prepare monthly reports on social media for distribution to department heads and executive committee.
* Work closely with various departments to produce quality content for social media.
* Writing, commissioning, and editing materials for a range of key hotel audiences for use across all social media platforms.
* Plan, organize and oversee all social media photography / videography sessions.

Experience and education


* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, eCommerce Management, or a related field.
* Minimum of 2 years of solid experience in a similar role, preferably within the luxury hospitality sector (resort experience is considered a plus).

description:
**Retail Manager \- Travel Retail, Southern Europe****6 Month FTC**

***About Charlotte Tilbury Beauty***


Founded by British makeup artist and beauty entrepreneur Charlotte Tilbury CBE in 2013, Charlotte Tilbury Beauty has revolutionised the face of the global beauty industry by de\-coding makeup applications for everyone, everywhere, with an easy\-to\-use, easy\-to\-choose, easy\-to\-gift range. Today, Charlotte Tilbury Beauty is a truly global business, delivering market\-leading growth, innovative retail and product launches fuelled by industry\-leading tech — all with an internal culture of embracing challenges, disruptive thinking, winning together, and sharing the magic. The energy behind the brand is infectious, and as we grow, we are always looking for extraordinary talent who want to be part of this our success and help drive our limitless ambitions.

**About the role**


We’re looking for an ambitious and experienced Retail Manager to join our fabulous, newly appointed Travel Retail team, focusing on the Northern Europe region.


Responsibilities include building retailer relationships, identifying commercial opportunities, leading a field team comprising of store\-based business managers and retail artists and managing corresponding budgets, showcasing strong budget management capability and being confident in retail sales forecasting, reporting and data analysis.


KPIs are retail sales achievement, market share gains, mystery shopping score and team turnover.

**As a Retail Manager you will**

**Sales Objectives and Market Share Gains**

* Define development and growth strategies with the Head of Travel Retail, Europe for the designated accounts and implement them successfully in stores.
* Deliver sell\-out in line with forecast commitments.
* Identify and capitalise on opportunities to drive brand awareness, performance, and market share across the region.

**Account Management**

* Build strong relationships with retailer contacts to optimise brand presence, maximize share of voice, and negotiate industry\-leading joint trading plans.
* Deliver regular business/sales updates and critical market insights, acting as the connection between our stores and the Magic Office.
* Lead quarterly business reviews and half\-year external strategy meetings, producing strong insights and action\-driven 360 plans.

**High Performance Teams**

* With the people partner, recruit high performing Retail teams for each store launch.
* Set ambitious and achievable sales targets to the field teams.
* Lead and inspire your team of business managers and retail artists.
* When needed, address performance and engagement needs identified, building an environment of inclusion and motivation within your defined area.
* Work alongside the field training manager to ensure commercial and development training needs are met within the region.

**Brand Image Building and Launch of New Campaigns**

* Work in close collaboration with Travel Retail Marketing \& VM teams to develop trade plans and on\-counter activities.
* Successfully launch and sustain new products and campaigns as per the global Travel Retail Marketing strategy.

**Effective Commercial \& Budget Management**

* With the Head of Travel Retail, Europe, monthly retail forecasting by store.
* In alignment with finance and retailer partners, forecast and manage all retail staffing costs, including recommended FTEs, commissions and incentives management.
* Manage T\&E budget, staying within approved monthly expenditure.

**Operational Excellence**

* Set standards for executional excellence, support new processes, and work cross\-functionally to enhance brand presentation and in\-store execution, including but not limited to assortment, stock availability on counter, price updates.

  

**Requirements**  

* Must be able to travel within region and to Magic Office regularly. Roughly a 40/60 split
* Wide experience in Retail or Sales Management, with direct experience in Travel Retail desirable but not mandatory
* Strong people focus, team spirited and passionate about developing teams.
* Proven track record of successful negotiations \& ability to influence others.
* Target\-focused and results\-driven.
* Excellent numerical and analytical skills.
* Effective communicator, both written and verbal with a structured and organised approach
* Excellent presentation skills and classroom delivery
* Personable and approachable; able to build rapport quickly \& effectively
* Self\-starter; able to motivate oneself and others
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and adapt to changing priorities. Agility is key!
* Solution\-oriented with ability to problem solve in a timely manner
* Spanish language is desirable but not mandatory

*Charlotte Tilbury is a fast\-paced and dynamic environment where nimble mindsets, striving to deliver the best and wanting to be part of a global \#dreaamteam are key. Even though we have requirements, our experience and background are just a guide, we still love to welcome applicants with more or less experience stated, provided necessary skills can be demonstrated.*

 **Benefits**  

* Be a part of this values driven, high growth, magical journey with an ultimate vision to empower everyone, everywhere to be the best version of themselves
* 25 days holiday (plus bank holidays) with an additional day to celebrate your birthday
* Inclusive parental leave policy that supports all parents and carers throughout their parenting and caring journey
* Financial security and planning with our pension and life assurance for all
* Wellness and social benefits including Medicash, Employee Assist Programs and regular social connects with colleagues
* And not to forget our generous product discount and gifting!

*At Charlotte Tilbury Beauty, our mission is to empower everybody in the world to be the most beautiful version of themselves. We celebrate and support this by encouraging and hiring people with diverse backgrounds, cultures, voices, beliefs, and perspectives into our growing global workforce. By doing so, we better serve our communities, customers, employees \- and the candidates that take part in our recruitment process.*

*If you want to learn more about life at Charlotte Tilbury Beauty please follow our* *LinkedIn page!*

description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Please note: This job is advertised for Luxembourg but can be located in any of our EU sites or offices.  

  

We are seeking a Senior Analyst to own the analytical backbone across multiple high\-impact domains within EU Inbound Supply Chain. This is not a single\-metric reporting role you will design scalable data architectures, build production\-grade analytics systems, and drive strategic decisions through data, working across both real\-time streaming and batch processing to get the team the right data at the right time.  

  

The ideal candidate pairs deep technical expertise in data engineering and analytics with the ability to influence cross\-functional stakeholders and turn ambiguous business problems into measurable solutions. You're equally comfortable building scalable pipelines on AWS services over terabytes of data, architecting a real\-time monitoring solution, presenting to senior leadership, or prototyping GenAI tools to scale analytical capacity.  

  

What makes this role unique:  

\- Context\-switching is the job \- one week you're decomposing a delivery\-accuracy variance across the EU network; the next you're building a real\-time Inbound Management pipeline; the week after you're prototyping a GenAI tool that auto\-generates root\-cause narratives for business reviews.  

\- Federated stakeholder model \- you'll work across Engineering, Science, Transportation, Planning, Finance, and Operations. Aligning on definitions and building shared analytical frameworks matters as much as writing the code.  

\- GenAI as a force multiplier \- you won't just use AI tools, you'll build them: agentic deep\-dives, automated narrative generation, and intelligent alerting that scale analysis across inbound speed, DEA, and transportation optimization.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Design and own end\-to\-end data architectures spanning real\-time streaming (Kinesis, Flink) and batch processing (EMR, Redshift, Athena), selecting the right paradigm for the latency, volume, and criticality at hand.
* Build production\-grade, scalable ETL/ELT pipelines processing multi\-TB datasets daily across Redshift, Athena, S3, and DynamoDB with data\-quality checks, monitoring, and alerting.
* Architect real\-time analytics for operational monitoring: live visibility into inbound flows, delivery accuracy, dock congestion, and network disruptions.
* Own metric frameworks and reporting: design KPIs, build automated dashboards (QuickSight), support WBR/MBR narratives, and own the “why” through root\-cause analysis when metrics move.
* Develop GenAI\-driven tooling and agentic workflows that automate reporting narratives and root\-cause analysis, reducing time\-to\-insight from days to minutes.
* Drive deep\-dive investigations across complex, multi\-source datasets tracing issues to specific products, warehouses, or routes, then quantifying network\-wide impact with statistical methods.

  

A day in the life  

You'll have exposure to the full data\-product lifecycle — from defining metrics to designing architectures, building pipelines, and delivering insights to senior leadership. A typical week might include:  

* Designing pipelines that unify real\-time event streams (shipment scans, trailer movements, inventory updates) and batch sources (forecasts, historical performance) into a single analytical layer.
* Writing advanced SQL across multiple sources to investigate why delivery promises were missed from the customer order through placement, transportation, and fulfillment.
* Building Python\-based automation for anomaly detection, statistical modeling, and reporting.
* Iterating on GenAI\-powered tools and presenting data\-driven recommendations, with clear quantification of customer and cost impact, to senior leadership.
* Triaging emerging operational issues from real\-time dashboards and providing data\-backed context.

  

About the team  

The Global Operational Excellence (GOX) team drives operational improvements across Amazon’s EU fulfillment network and ROW. We work at the intersection of technology and operations to optimize how inventory is placed, moved, and delivered reducing costs while improving customer experience. Our team leverages large\-scale data analysis, automation, and cross\-functional collaboration to solve complex supply chain challenges across Inbound Speed, Delivery Estimate Accuracy (DEA), and network performance.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field such as statistics, mathematics, data science, computer science, economics, engineering, or operations research.
* Experience in analytics, data engineering, or business intelligence at a large\-scale enterprise, including data\-warehouse architecture, data modeling, and ETL/ELT pipeline design.
* Advanced SQL and programming (Python or equivalent) to extract, transform, and clean large (multi\-TB) datasets, plus scripting for pipeline automation and scheduling.
* Experience with both real\-time streaming (e.g., Kinesis, Kafka, Flink) and batch processing (e.g., EMR, Hive) systems, and with data\-visualization tools (QuickSight, Tableau, or similar).
* Experience translating operational problems into analytical solutions and communicating results to senior leadership (Director/VP) with clear business\-impact quantification.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Master's degree in statistics, data science, computer science, operations research, or an equivalent quantitative field.
* Experience with AWS services including S3, Redshift, Athena, EMR, Kinesis, Lambda, Glue, Step Functions, SageMaker, and DynamoDB.


\- Experience with GenAI/LLM integration \- building AI\-assisted analytical tools, prompt engineering, RAG architectures, or agentic workflows.  

* Experience with statistical analysis and experimentation (design of experiments, causal inference, A/B testing) and ML/data\-mining pipelines.
* Knowledge of supply\-chain operations (inventory placement, network optimization, transportation, fulfillment) and Amazon internal data systems (Andes/Redshift, Cradle, Data Central, EDX).

The department is the organization in charge of designing, developing and delivering Training and Operations Support solutions required by Airbus Defence and Space Customers to operate efficiently and safely their Airbus military aircraft. title: Customer Success Manager - Madrid (F/M/X)
description:
Madrid  

Permanent contract · Start date: ASAP  

International environment

**Do you enjoy taking ownership, solving problems, and building things from scratch?**
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


At Combo, we're looking for our next **Customer Success Manager to take care of our Spanish market**.


Spain is a strategic market for Combo. We already have an established local Sales team and a growing customer base. Our next challenge is to continue structuring our Customer Success approach while ensuring our Spanish customers get the support and experience they need to succeed with Combo.


This is a highly hands\-on and operational role.


You won't simply manage a portfolio of customers. You'll take ownership of their overall experience: from supporting key accounts to handling day\-to\-day requests, while also building scalable processes that will allow us to grow.

**More than 150,000 employees use Combo every day.**
----------------------------------------------------


To check their schedules. Track their hours. Manage their teams.


At Combo, we build HR solutions for companies with deskless teams: restaurants, hotels, retailers, pharmacies, bakeries, sports and leisure businesses, and more.


The adventure started in 2016 with a simple idea: making HR easier for businesses and the people who run them.


Today, thousands of companies across Europe rely on Combo to simplify their day\-to\-day HR operations.


Our platform brings together the tools teams need every day: scheduling, contract management, payroll preparation, team communication, and productivity tracking.


And we're still growing.

**Your role**
-------------


You'll be the main point of contact and advocate for our Spanish customers.


Your mission is simple: help them get the most out of Combo while building a Customer Success approach that can scale with our business.


The role combines **Account Management, Customer Success, Customer Care, and continuous improvement**.

### **You'll support our customers every day**


You'll build strong and trusted relationships with our key accounts and help them get the most value from Combo.


You'll also handle more operational requests from customers with speed, empathy, and pragmatism.


You'll become a key point of contact for our Spanish customers and make sure every interaction with Combo leads to a clear and useful outcome.

### **You'll build processes that can scale**


Not every customer needs the same level of support.


For our key accounts, you'll provide a more personalised and proactive approach.


For the rest of our customer base, you'll design and implement scalable ways to provide value: webinars, communication campaigns, automated sequences, content, Help Center articles, and more.


The goal? Deliver the right level of support at the right time, without relying exclusively on manual interactions.


You'll identify friction points throughout the customer journey and find practical ways to simplify and automate recurring interactions.

### **You'll keep a close eye on customer health**


You'll maintain a clear understanding of your customer base.


Product usage, engagement, satisfaction, churn risks: you'll know where to look and how to interpret the signals.


You'll identify potential risks early and implement concrete action plans to prevent churn.


Data quality is essential in this role. Your CRM will be reliable, your customer information up to date, and your tracking rigorous enough to give the wider team a clear view of what's happening.

### **You'll bring the voice of the Spanish market to Combo**


You'll be close to our Spanish customers.


Their feedback, frustrations, and needs will be valuable insights for the rest of Combo.


You'll structure this feedback and turn it into clear, actionable insights for our Product and Operations teams.


Your role won't simply be to forward customer requests.


You'll help us understand what's really happening on the ground and what our Spanish customers need.

**This role is made for you if...**
-----------------------------------


You have at least **2 years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or Customer Support**, ideally in a B2B SaaS environment.


You've already worked with customers requiring different levels of support and are comfortable combining **High Touch and scalable, Low Touch approaches**.


You're a natural problem solver.


When something isn't working perfectly, your first instinct is to understand the situation and find a practical solution.


You don't need every process to already exist before moving forward. You're comfortable structuring, testing, and building things.


You're autonomous, organised, and comfortable in a fast\-paced environment.


You care about the quality of your work, especially when it comes to customer follow\-up and data. For you, keeping a clean and reliable CRM isn't just a detail.


You're also comfortable with numbers and able to understand topics related to HR or payroll.


And most importantly:


**You're a native or fully fluent Spanish speaker**, both written and spoken.


**You're fluent in English**, as you'll work daily with your manager and international teams.


French is a strong plus, but not a requirement.

**Why join Combo?**
-------------------


Because you won't be joining a Customer Success organisation where everything has already been figured out.


You'll have a customer base to support, but also plenty of things to build.


You'll have a real impact on how we support our Spanish customers: improving processes, structuring data, creating playbooks, and testing new approaches.


You'll work closely with our Spanish Sales team while also being part of an international Customer Success organisation.


This is a role for someone who enjoys autonomy, thrives in fast\-moving environments, and gets just as much satisfaction from solving a customer problem as from building a process that prevents it from happening again.

**What we offer**
-----------------


**A gross annual fixed salary between €34K and €41K**, depending on your experience.


And also:

* **Stock options** once your probation period has been successfully completed
* ️ **Meal vouchers**
* **A 40\-hour working week**
* A role based in our **Madrid office**
* An international environment, working closely with teams in France
* A high\-impact role with real ownership over a strategic market and customer base
* ️ The opportunity to build, structure, and improve the way we support our customers in Spain
* A close\-knit local Sales team, backed by an established and growing European scale\-up
* Plenty of autonomy and room to make an impact

**Our hiring process**
----------------------

**Step 1 – HR Screening (30 min)**


A first conversation with **Thomas, Talent Acquisition Manager**, to get to know each other, tell you more about Combo, and discuss your experience and expectations.

**Step 2 – Management Fit (60 min)**


A conversation with **Estelle, Head of Customer Success**, to discuss the role in more detail, your experience, and how you approach Customer Success and customer management.

A practical exercise designed to better understand how you approach real\-life situations you could face in the role.

------------------


At Combo, we believe diverse teams make better decisions, build better products, and create stronger companies.


We're committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive and grow.

title: Science Operations Scientist
location: Villanueva de la Cañada, MD, ES
description:
**Job Requisition ID:** 20826
  
**Date Posted:** 3 September 2026
  
**Closing Date:** 24 September 2026 23:59 CET/CEST
  
**Publication:** Internal \& External
  
**Type of Appointment (learn more):** 4 years, extendable to indefinite
  
**Directorate:** Science
  
  

**Workplace:**  

Villanueva de la Cañada, ES
  
  

**Grade Band (learn more):** A2 \- A4
  
  

Location
  
ESAC, Villanueva de la Cañada, Spain
  
  

Description
  
  

The European Space Agency maintains a world\-leading Science Programme with missions in heliophysics, planetary science, astrophysics and fundamental physics. Its mission is to empower Europe to lead space science.
  
  

The Science Operations Department (SCI\-S) within ESA’s Directorate of Science hosts the scientists and engineers that oversee the space missions from the study phase to the end of operations. It develops the science operation systems for the missions and operates the missions in space, as well as archiving and curating their data during operations and beyond. Its main objective is to maximise the scientific output of the missions for the benefit of humankind.
  
  

You will be assigned as Science Operations Scientist, initially for the Arrakihs mission under the direct responsibility of the Science Operations Development Manager for Arrakihs in the Science Operations Development Division.
  
  

Arrakihs is a “Fast” (F\-class) mission in ESA’s Science Programme. Its primary objective is to image the halos of galaxies in our nearby Universe to unprecedented low surface brightness, providing crucial data to answer unsolved questions in cosmology and galaxy evolution. Arrakihs is targeted for launch in the early 2030s.
  
  

Duties
  
  

You will be responsible for various aspects of the definition, implementation and testing of science operations activities for the Arrakihs mission, working in close collaboration with the Project Scientist, the Archive Scientist and the Science Operations Centre (SOC) Team and interfacing with the Instrument Operations and Science Data Centre (IOSDC) Team from the Arrakihs mission consortium.
  
  

During the development phase of the mission, your tasks and responsibilities will include:
  
  

acting as an interface between the Science Operations Centre, the Payload Team, the Flight Control Team and the Instrument Operations and Science Data Centre Team for the Arrakihs mission;
  
contributing to the overall ground segment operations definition, design and implementation;
  
coordinating and supporting the definition, development and testing of processes and tools for science mission planning activities;
  
providing support to the definition and validation of the instrument’s data products, as well as to the establishment of validation criteria and the development, implementation and testing of tools for their quality assessment in coordination with the Archive Scientist, the Project Scientist and the IOSDC Team;
  
acting as a product owner in the context of an Agile development strategy for the SOC system by providing the feedback, value and user acceptance testing for the various science operations functionalities;
  
supporting the Project Scientist and Science Operations Development Manager in analysing the impact of mission baseline changes, relating to operational rules and constraints, for example, on the scientific outcome of the mission;
  
supporting validation activities and all relevant compatibility, interfaces and end\-to\-end tests in preparation for the operation phase;
  
supporting the definition, preparation and execution of activities relating to the commissioning and science performance demonstration phases;
  
supporting the SOC interaction with the astronomical community in preparation for the Arrakihs filler programme, including the coordination of inputs and provision of relevant scientific and operational information;
  
supporting outreach activities promoting the Arrakihs mission and its science.
  
  

In addition to the above duties, you are expected to continue to carry out research and actively contribute to the scientific activities of the Department.
  
  

It is expected that the position will also involve support to other survey missions in development within the Division, for example the Ariel mission, which will study the atmosphere of exoplanets through spectroscopic observations during transits and eclipses.
  
  

Technical competencies
  
Experience in defining, setting up and/or operating scientific experiments for astrophysics research either in space or ground\-based facilities
  
Experience in coordinating internal/external stakeholders on scientific projects
  
Active researcher in a relevant field to the Arrakihs mission
  
Knowledge of scientific instruments performance and calibration specification and analysis
  
Behavioural competencies
  
  

Result Orientation
  
Operational Efficiency
  
Fostering Cooperation
  
Relationship Management
  
Continuous Improvement
  
Forward Thinking
  
  

Education and professional experience
  
  

A PhD in astronomy, physics or a related subject is required for this post, together with three years of relevant professional experience.
  
  

Additional requirements
  
  

International experience, i.e., outside your home country, as well as experience in diverse functional areas relevant to ESA activities.
  
  

**The following will be considered assets for the position:**  

* Experience in science operations of space\- or ground\-based facilities;
* Experience in analysing the science performance of instruments in space\- or ground\-based facilities;
* Experience with the Agile development methodology, preferably in the role of product owner;
* Proficiency in at least one scripting or programming language, for example Python;
* Experience with media and outreach activities.


Diversity, Equity and Inclusiveness
  
ESA is an equal opportunity employer, committed to achieving diversity within the workforce and creating an inclusive working environment. We therefore welcome applications from all qualified candidates irrespective of gender, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religious beliefs, age, disability or other characteristics.
  
  

At the Agency we value diversity, and we welcome people with disabilities. Whenever possible, we seek to accommodate individuals with disabilities by providing the necessary support at the workplace. The Human Resources Department can also provide assistance during the recruitment process. If you would like to discuss this further, please contact us via email at contact.human.resources@esa.int.
  
  

Important Information and Disclaimer
  
In principle, recruitment will be within the advertised grade band (A2\-A4\). However, if the selected candidate has less than four years of relevant professional experience following the completion of the master’s degree, the position may be filled at A1 level.
  
  

Applicants must be eligible to access information, technology, and hardware which is subject to European or US export control and sanctions regulations.
  
  

During the recruitment process, the Agency may request applicants to undergo selection tests. Additionally, successful candidates will need to undergo basic screening before appointment, which will be conducted by an external background screening service, in compliance with the European Space Agency's security procedures.
  
  

Note that ESA is in the process of transitioning to a Matrix setup, which could lead to organisational changes affecting this position.
  
  

The information published on ESA’s careers website regarding working conditions is correct at the time of publication. It is not intended to be exhaustive and may not address all questions you would have.
  
  

Nationality and Languages
  
Please note that applications are only considered from nationals of one of the following States: Austria, Belgium, Czechia, Denmark, Estonia, Finland, France, Germany, Greece, Hungary, Ireland, Italy, Luxembourg, the Netherlands, Norway, Poland, Portugal, Romania, Slovenia, Spain, Sweden, Switzerland, the United Kingdom and Canada, Cyprus, Latvia, Lithuania and Slovakia.
  
  

According to the ESA Convention, staff shall be recruited on the basis of their qualifications, taking into account an adequate distribution of posts among nationals of the Member States.
  
  

The working languages of the Agency are English and French. A good knowledge of one of these is required. Knowledge of another Member State language would be an asset.

Die Position
  
  

TheData Scientist \- Enterprise Search role is responsible for contributing to the design and development of the next\-generation Enterprise Search and information retrieval architectures.
  
This role will build context\-aware, generative AI\-driven search systems optimized for agentic readiness—enabling autonomous tool orchestration, deep semantic understanding, and intelligent information retrieval at an enterprise scale.
  
The data scientist will develop advanced AI solutions, with a strong focus on Generative AI, LLM\-based applications, and scalable data services. This requires to work with large datasets, develop and evaluate machine learning models, and collaborate with cross\-functional teams to improve the accuracy, coverage, relevance, and performance of search algorithms at enterprise scale.
  
  

This role involves direct communication with project stakeholders and contributes to team best practices, while identifying optimization opportunities that enhance the impact of moderately complex data solutions within larger product architectures. You will leverage advanced technical skills to translate business needs into actionable data science initiatives.
  
  

Job Responsibilities
  
  

Generative AI, Agentic AI and LLM Optimization
  
  

* Model Development\& Experimentation: Lead exploratory data analysis, feature engineering, model selection, training, validation, and performance evaluation for machine learning and AI\-enabled solutions. Design and evaluate multiple modeling approaches, establish appropriate evaluation metrics, and optimize models for scalability, reliability, and business impact.
* Experimentation and Innovation: lead experimental projects and drive innovation in enterprise search, exploring novel approaches like GraphRAG or agentic search patterns.
* Agentic AI Search: Develop and deploy intelligent agentic architectures that can interact with and enhance the enterprise search experience.
* RAG Experimentations (RAG Evaluation Framework): Design and conduct Retrieval\-Augmented Generation experiments to evaluate and improve search relevance and performance.
* LLM Model Evaluation: Evaluate the performance of Large Language Models in various enterprise search contexts, ensuring they meet business requirements and performance standards.
* Advanced Prompt Engineering: Design and optimize prompts to programmatically enhance the interaction and effectiveness of search queries and responses.


Business Problem Solving\& Decision Support
  
  

* Partner closely with business stakeholders and product teams to translate complex business challenges into analytical approaches, ML solutions, and scalable intelligence capabilities.
* Support data\-driven prioritization and strategic decision making through actionable insights, predictive models, and operational intelligence.
* Conducts A/B testing and experiments to assess the performance of search models and algorithms.

* PoC and knowledge sharing: Design and lead proof\-of\-value (PoV) projects, conduct knowledge\-sharing sessions, and deliver impactful demos to showcase capabilities and gather feedback.


Data Engineering\& Vector Databases
  
  

* Data Engineering\& Processing: Work with structured and unstructured data, building efficient pipelines for data ingestion, preprocessing, and feature engineering.
* Vector database experimentation: Conduct experiments with vector databases to improve the efficiency and accuracy of our search systems.
* Managing embeddings: Implement and optimize techniques for embeddings generation, indexation and retrieval to support advanced search queries and retrieval capabilities.
* Retrieval\& relevance tuning: Develop, evaluate, and tune retrieval algorithms to optimize search precision, recall, and relevance for diverse datasets.
* Data quality: Design data enhancement modules that extract, enrich, and validate document content and metadata, directly improving downstream model context, search recall, and agentic reasoning.


Model Lifecycle and integration
  
  

* Deployment, Testing, and Training of ML Models and Endpoints: Develop, deploy, and continuously refine machine learning models and endpoints to enhance search functionalities. Conduct rigorous testing and validation to ensure model accuracy and reliability.
* Development of ML Models for search: Create and deploy advanced runnable models, such as entity extraction models and metadata augmentation, to expand the capabilities of our search solutions.
* MLOps\& Monitoring: Implement best practices for model deployment, versioning, monitoring, and performance optimization.
* API\& MCP Interoperability: Interface with enterprise search engines, platforms, and other APIs to enhance our search functionalities and integrations. Familiarity with MCP and protocols for agent interoperability.

Technical Skills

* Has a solid understanding of natural language processing (NLP) techniques and tools.
* Possesses hands\-on experience with machine learning and deep learning frameworks and libraries (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit\-learn).

* Demonstrates excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to work with large, complex datasets.
* Proven ability to translate well\-defined business questions into clear analytical problems and technical solutions.


Additional Qualifications
  
  

* Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to manage direct communication with immediate project stakeholders.
* Ability to actively integrate feedback from technical peers and junior team members.
* Proactive mindset to identify potential optimizations or new analytical approaches within the project scope.
* Ability to work autonomously to achieve goals and deliver results, while actively collaborating with team members to meet shared team objectives.

description:
**About Creative Fabrica**



Creative Fabrica is a subscription platform serving millions of creators, designers, and crafters worldwide. We're built on the principle that everyone can be creative. We remove what stands in the way: expensive software, technical expertise, and time\-consuming production.



Our Studio AI suite offers more than 26 specialized AI tools that automate technical work: generate custom images, remove backgrounds, create fonts, and produce publication\-ready designs in minutes instead of hours.



Our content library contains 15\+ million commercially\-licensed fonts, graphics, SVGs, and templates, giving you professional\-quality building blocks without the expense or time of creating assets from scratch.

Creative Fabrica Studio is where people turn ideas into real creative work.



It's our AI\-native creative suite, image, video, audio, 3D, and a full design workspace, built so anyone can go from a rough idea to a professional asset in minutes. Generators, editors, and tools live in one product: studio.creativefabrica.com. Thousands of makers use Creative Fabrica; Studio is how we turn that audience into creators who ship work every day.



We're not polishing a finished product. We're redesigning Studio into an experience that matches how ambitious the tech already is: faster, clearer, more distinctive, and genuinely easy to use, the kind of product designers wish they got to shape from the ground up.



We are looking for a Product Designer who brings strong visual craft, a focus on user experience, and well structured Figma files that developers can build from smoothly.



As a Product Designer, you'll take ownership of the end\-to\-end design for Creative Fabrica Studio and raise the bar for usability and visual quality across the platform. You will work closely with developers and product as a hands\-on partner: independent enough to drive the design direction, collaborative enough to turn ideas into buildable UI quickly.



This is not a role for endless exploration or for lightly adapting patterns from elsewhere. We want someone who brings original product taste, ships thoughtfully and often, and uses AI tools to move faster without lowering the bar. You will have real ownership. Sometimes you will get a clear problem or flow; other times you will be expected to propose the better experience yourself and take it to a developer\-ready design.


**What you will do:**


* Lead the redesign of Studio end\-to\-end: information architecture, flows, UI, and interaction details that make the product easier and more delightful to use.
* Raise visual and interaction quality so Studio feels modern, distinctive, and worthy of an AI\-native creative product.
* Turn product goals and constraints into concrete screens, components, and prototypes that developers can implement with confidence.
* Partner daily with engineers: clarify intent, resolve edge cases early, and keep design and build in sync.
* Produce structured Figma work, clear hierarchy, components, variants, states, and specs, so handoff is efficient and unambiguous.
* Design for real creator workflows: reduce friction, improve discoverability, and make advanced AI capabilities feel simple.
* Move from concept to usable design quickly; prefer strong iterations over polishing one direction for days.
* Use AI tools to accelerate research, exploration, and production while keeping craft and judgment yourself.
* Build and evolve a coherent design system / UI language for Studio that scales across new features.
* Validate designs with lightweight methods (critiques, quick tests, usage feedback) and adjust without derailing delivery.
* Balance originality with clarity: distinctive where it matters, familiar where it helps users move fast.
* Stay current with product design, AI product UX, Figma workflows, and emerging patterns in generative\-media tools.


**What you will need:**


* 5\+ years designing digital products (UI/UX or product design), with a portfolio that shows shipped product work.
* Excellent UI craft: typography, layout, visual hierarchy, interaction design, and polish in complex product surfaces.
* Advanced Figma skills for developer handoff (components, variants, auto\-layout, clear states and specs).
* Proven ability to redesign or substantially improve a product experience with measurable usability gains.
* Proven ability to take a product or major surface from concept to polished, buildable UI quickly.
* Comfortable using AI tools in the design workflow; strong written and spoken English.
* Thrives in high\-pace environments: manages shifting priorities, ships on deadline, and stays decisive when briefs or constraints change.
* Independent and ownership driven: proposes direction, unblocks yourself, and partners with developers without heavy process.
* Original and tasteful: brings creative point of view; does not default to copy\-paste industry patterns.


**Nice to have:**


* Agency background delivering digital product, web, or app redesigns for real clients under commercial pressure.
* Experience designing AI, generative media, SaaS, or creator tools.
* Experience building or maintaining a product design system used by engineering.

  


### **Is this you?**



Get in touch! We'd love to speak to you.



You can apply by clicking the "Apply now" button.



Creative Fabrica is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

* Enable Conversational \& Background Agents \- Use Agentforce Studio and Agent Builder to configure chat and background agents; integrate with external channels including voice via hyperscaler APIs.
* Drive Prompt Engineering \& Lifecycle Strategy \- Lead prompt design, testing, monitoring, and iteration; define agent lifecycle best practices from development through refinement.
* Build Hands\-On Demos \& Prototypes \- Co\-create quick prototypes (\<2 weeks) with AEs demonstrating integration between Agentforce and external agents or services.
* Lead Pre\-Sales Workshops \- Facilitate whiteboarding, deep\-dive sessions, and quick enablement for customers and internal teams.
* Advise on Data \& Integration \- Integrate Data Cloud (D360\), CRM, MuleSoft APIs, and external agent endpoints ensuring cohesive architectures that align with compliance and governance policies.
* Support Early Adoption \- Occasionally assist in proof\-of\-value engagements post\-sale by tuning agents and guiding customers toward self\-sufficient enablement.
* Own Technical Architecture Decisions \- Oversee data modeling, identity resolution, real\-time vs. batch patterns, data graph design, and activation strategies within D360\.
* Own Technical Enablement \- Create and manage accessible technical documentation, knowledge bases, and FAQ resources to rapidly resolve internal technical inquiries, empowering specialist teams to handle technical discussions confidently.

  

**Required Qualifications**

* Technical Pre\-Sales/Consulting \- 7\+ years of hands\-on experience designing and delivering data, analytics, and AI architectures in enterprise environments.
* External Ecosystem Knowledge \- Strong understanding of external agent ecosystems and interoperability.
* Proven Track Record \- Experience in prompt engineering, agent lifecycle management, and hands\-on prototype development.
* AI \& ML Expertise \- Experience with machine learning concepts (predictive and generative AI), plus the ability to communicate value to diverse audiences.
* Data Stack Knowledge \- Deep expertise in modern cloud data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, Redshift) and data ingestion patterns (batch, streaming, CDC).
* Hands\-On Development \- Proficiency in programming (e.g., JavaScript, Python, SQL, R) and data frameworks like pandas or Jupyter.
* Excellent Communication (in both Spanish and English) \- Strong presentation skills; adept at explaining complex ideas and guiding stakeholders toward impactful solutions.
* Curiosity \& Continuous Learning \- Passion for exploring new AI frameworks, sharing insights, and experimenting with cutting\-edge technologies.

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Salesforce Expertise \- Hands\-on experience with Salesforce Agentforce and deep fluency with D360 and core Salesforce platform services.
* Advanced Integration \- Experience integrating Salesforce with external agents via APIs and open standards (MCP, A2A).
* Governance \& Observability \- Familiarity with prompt governance, observability, and monitoring frameworks.
* Cross\-Platform Background \- Background in cross\-platform integrations (e.g., Hyperscaler SDKs to Salesforce Flows).
* Multimodal Pipelines \- Prior exposure to conversational voice pipelines or multimodal integrations via hyperscaler services.
* Advanced AI/ML Frameworks \- Exposure to frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch), MLOps practices, and cloud AI platforms like Google Vertex AI or AWS Sagemaker.

Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and *be your best* , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can *do your best* . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. description:

Havas Market**Job Description :**

**About Us:**

  

We are Havas Market, part of the Havas Media Group. Our mission is to create meaningful connections between people and brands to drive business success with one vision, one voice and one P\&L. Havas is the only truly integrated marketing and communications company in the UK.

  

Havas Market is Havas Media Group’s specialist ecommerce and performance marketing agency. Our 150\-strong team brings together data, performance marketing, connected commerce and retail expertise to help brands drive measurable commercial growth.


Our Limitless Performance proposition connects brand, performance, commerce and loyalty to create more joined\-up customer experiences and move people closer to purchase. We work across a range of channels, including:

* Direct\-to\-consumer (D2C) media
* Marketplaces
* Retail media
* Social commerce
* Loyalty \& Partnerships
  

Our offer spans managed services, consultancy, technology and tools, supporting clients across multiple markets and categories.


As part of Havas Group, we also benefit from access to a broad range of complementary capabilities, including media, data and technology, digital, social, CRM, UX, creative, research, public relations, design and more – all under one roof at our London Kings' Cross office.

 **The Role**


This role sits within the Havas Market Ecommerce Client Team.


As a Senior Ecommerce Executive, you will support the Ecommerce Manager in delivering high\-quality client service across a portfolio of connected commerce clients. You will contribute to campaign coordination, performance analysis, reporting, project management and client communications, helping to ensure smooth day\-to\-day delivery across your accounts.


Our clients operate across a range of channels, including:

* Brand: OOH, BVOD and programmatic
* Performance: PPC and paid social
* Commerce: Amazon retail, Amazon Ads, retail media and TikTok Shop
  

This is an excellent opportunity for an ambitious ecommerce or performance marketing executive who wants to develop broader experience across the connected commerce environment. You are not expected to have in\-depth knowledge of every channel. However, you should have a strong appetite to learn and an interest in understanding how different channels work together to deliver against brand and commercial objectives for clients.

  

The role would suit someone with one to two years’ agency experience in ecommerce and/or performance marketing who is ready to take the next step in a client\-facing role. This role is hybrid, with 3\-days a week (Usually Tues, Weds \& Thurs) at our central Kings Cross office, and 2 days remote.

 **Key Responsibilities**

 **Client and campaign delivery**

* Support the Ecommerce Manager and Director in developing ecommerce strategies for clients.
* Contribute to campaign planning, annual planning and the development of ad hoc briefs.
* Build an understanding of clients’ businesses, customers and commercial objectives.
* Help ensure recommendations are practical, insight\-led and aligned with clients’ short\- and long\-term goals.
* Support the coordination of multi\-channel campaigns, working closely with internal activation teams.
* Schedule and coordinate internal stand\-ups, track actions and help ensure campaigns remain on schedule and on budget.
* Monitor campaign pacing and performance, escalating issues and performance challenges to the Ecommerce Manager where appropriate.
* Support the development of post\-campaign analyses (PCAs), ensuring they contain clear, actionable insights.
* Support the implementation of client innovation and testing roadmaps.
 **Planning and performance**

* Work with the Ecommerce Manager and activation teams to develop media plans, forecasts and performance benchmarks.
* Contribute to performance analysis across ecommerce, retail media and wider paid media channels.
* Identify opportunities to improve campaign performance and client outcomes.
* Help anticipate potential delivery issues and recommend ways to mitigate them.
 **Client management**

* Own agreed client workstreams and support the day\-to\-day management of client accounts.
* Lead weekly client meetings with confidence; crafting clear agenda and performance inisghts
* Act as a reliable point of contact for campaign updates, actions and operational queries.
* Build strong working relationships with clients and internal stakeholders.
* Communicate clearly, proactively and professionally across all projects.
 **Reporting and tools**

* Own the preparation of weekly and monthly performance reports.
* Translate data into clear, actionable insights and challenge assumptions where appropriate.
* Support the post\-campaign analysis process by briefing internal teams, collating findings and preparing presentation materials.
* Become proficient in relevant ecommerce, retail media and performance marketing tools, including proprietary Havas Market technology.
 **Digital shelf optimisation**

* Optimise product content and ecommerce operations across relevant commerce platforms.
* Help improve clients’ retail presence, discoverability and commercial performance.
* Monitor issues relating to content, availability, retailer compliance and platform execution, escalating where required.
 **Skills and Experience**

* Ideally one to two years’ experience in an agency, brand, retailer or consultancy environment, ideally within ecommerce, retail media or performance marketing.
* An analytical mindset and strong Excel/spreadsheet skills.
* Experience with campaign coordination, reporting or performance analysis.
* Working knowledge of Amazon Ads and Amazon retail platforms, including Vendor Central and/or Seller Central.
* Understanding of retail media and marketplace activity.
* Experience or exposure to PPC and paid social activation.
* Strong organisational and project management skills.
* Excellent attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities.
* The ability to work effectively in a fast\-paced, entrepreneurial agency environment.
* A collaborative, proactive and positive approach.
* A genuine interest in learning and developing across connected commerce.
 **Desirable Experience**

* Experience with both Amazon Vendor Central and Seller Central.
* Experience with TikTok Shop or social commerce.
* Familiarity with digital shelf metrics and optimisation.
* Experience with retail media networks or marketplace platforms beyond Amazon.
* Knowledge of ecommerce reporting or activation tools.
* Experience supporting new business, pitch or planning activity.
