**Our Values**


**Customers**



We relentlessly increase value for customer and do the right thing for them.


**Action**



We make 'thoughtfully fast' decisions, act quickly, cut through red tape, deliver progress not perfection, take ownership and accountability.


**Team Spirit**



We put the team ahead of ourselves, foster trust and respect, collaborate with passion, despise toxic politics, value our differences, and celebrate together.


**Innovation**



We challenge the status quo, experiment thoughtfully, and are novel and brilliant in what we create.


**Excellence**



We love to win, but we hate losing even more. We aspire to be the best and take pride in our work. When we fall short, we own it and come back stronger.

**About the Role**



The Marketing Director, Europe is a critical role responsible for building Billtrust's brand and demand generation engine across Europe from the ground up, in direct partnership with the CMO and cross\-functional leadership.



As part of scaling Billtrust across European markets, you will build go\-to\-market and brand awareness strategy in priority markets like the UK and Germany, develop market\-entry strategy for new geographies, and act as an embedded partner to regional sales, SDR, and CS teams.


**What You'll Do**


**Regional Strategy \& Leadership**


* Own the European marketing strategy and P\&L\-aligned plan, setting country/region priorities, targets, and budget allocation in direct support of pipeline and revenue goals set with the CMO and NA leadership.
* Develop market\-entry strategies for new European geographies, including sequencing, positioning, and channel selection.
* Operate with a high degree of autonomy, making day\-to\-day regional decisions while keeping the NA\-based CMO aligned on strategy, budget, and results.
* Report on regional marketing performance, pipeline contribution, and awareness metrics to the CMO and broader leadership
* Manage regional marketing budget, forecasting, and vendor contracts.


**Go\-to\-Market \& Demand Generation**


* Build and execute a go\-to\-market and brand\-awareness strategy tailored to each priority European market, recognizing the company is largely unknown particularly in UK \& Germany, two top priority markets, and requires demand generation from a low\-awareness starting point.
* Localize and adapt content, messaging, and campaigns into local languages and cultural context rather than simply translating NA assets.
* Plan and activate regional events (field marketing, trade shows, roadshows) end\-to\-end, from budget and vendor selection through execution and ROI reporting.
* Run digital marketing (paid, SEO/SEM, social, web) localized by market, with performance tracked against pipeline and awareness KPIs.


**Partnerships, PR \& Cross\-Functional Execution**


* Manage regional PR and comms, including relationships with local PR agency, to build brand credibility and press presence market by market.
* Build and manage a partner marketing program with regional resellers/partners, including co\-marketing funds, joint campaigns, and enablement.
* Work as an embedded partner to regional sales leaders, sellers, SDRs, and CSMs despite a lean team, aligning marketing activity tightly to sales priorities and pipeline coverage.
* Tap resources in North America for Operations support, content creation, web needs, etc.
* Source, hire, and manage external contractors and agencies (creative, digital, PR, events) to extend capacity.


**What You'll Bring**


**Required Skills:**


* 8–10 years in B2B marketing, with several years in a European regional or country marketing leadership role.
* Track record building marketing in new or low\-awareness markets (brand\-building/market\-entry experience), not just scaling an already\-known brand.
* Experience spanning multiple channels: field/events, digital, content, PR — able to both strategize and execute hands\-on given a lean team.
* Proven ability to manage agencies and contractors effectively, essentially running an "extended team" model.
* Experience operating autonomously and cross\-functionally with sales, SDRs, and CS in a matrixed, remote\-from\-HQ structure (reporting to a NA\-based CMO).
* Multi\-market European experience (especially UK, DACH, Benelux) with cultural and localization fluency.
* Strong analytical/planning skills — able to set and report against KPIs tied to pipeline and awareness goals.
* Based in London.
* Comfortable in a fast\-paced, resource\-constrained environment typical of scaling a US company into Europe.


**Preferred Skills:**


* Fintech (or B2B payments/financial software) background strongly preferred, with familiarity navigating European fintech buyer dynamics and competitive landscape.
* Partner/channel marketing experience strongly preferred.
* German language skills a plus in addition to fluent English.

**What You'll Get**



At Billtrust, we believe your total rewards should reflect the impact you make. Our benefits package includes comprehensive health coverage, competitive retirement, generous PTO and parental leave, flexible work options, and meaningful investment in your professional development. description:
**Own the business. Lead the team. Deliver results.**

Join our leadership team and take full responsibility for hotel performance, team development, and delivering an exceptional guest experience while driving revenue and operational success.


**Pay:** $62,000 salary per year (based on experience) \+ commission eligibility


**Benefits:** Benefits, PTO, and 401(k) available


**J\&P Hospitality Management, LLC**


**Job Description**


**Job Title:** General Manager  

**Reports to:** Area Manager  

**FLSA Status:** Exempt
  

**Location:** On\-Site, Single Property  

**Direct Reports:** 8\+, depending on the needs of the business  

**Department:** Property Operations


**JOB SUMMARY:**



The General Manager (GM) plans, directs, and coordinates all daily operations of the hotel. The GM is the primary business leader of the hotel, accountable for driving sales, maximizing revenue, and achieving strong GOP performance compared to budget, last year, and comp sets. The GM partners closely with the Area Manager, Regional Director of Sales and the Revenue Manager to ensure selling strategies and revenue management practices are executed at the property level. Along with sales, the GM oversees all day\-to\-day operations, including staffing, guest service, maintenance, safety, and compliance. Uses experience and sound judgment to solve problems and make decisions. Leads, trains, and holds team members accountable. Works with key leaders in the organization to meet company expectations and deliver a consistent guest experience.


**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**


* Manage the hotel according to the business plan and budget, with a strong focus on room sales.
* Deliver consistent sales growth and revenue performance by leading property\-level sales initiatives.
* Execute company sales programs and ensure measurable participation and results from staff.
* Work with the Regional Director of Sales to implement market\-level strategies, capture local accounts, and drive business\-to\-business sales.
* Partner with the Revenue Manager to optimize rates, inventory, and pricing decisions that increase market share.
* Achieve and exceed GOP targets compared to budget, last year, and comp sets.
* Review daily, weekly, and monthly performance reports and adjust strategies to remain competitive.
* Approve and monitor direct billing accounts and collections. Make sure guest payments are timely and rates are managed properly.
* Build relationships with local businesses, competitors, and community groups to promote the hotel.
* Knows area attractions and local services to assist guests and provide excellent hospitality.
* Conducts competitive visits to nearby hotels as part of the Lot Drive Program to gather insights and stay informed about local market trends.
* Ensure rooms meet brand and cleanliness standards through daily inspections.
* Oversee the daily audit, bank deposits, and reporting. Review and approve required front desk paperwork.
* Train the team on emergency procedures and safety standards in line with OSHA regulations.
* Commitment to keeping guests and staff safe.
* Maintain key control systems for guest and staff safety.
* Reviews daily front office procedures and assures proper transmission of all necessary information to the Hotel Support Center (HSC).
* Stay up to date on local, state, and federal laws that affect hotel operations and ensure compliance at all times.
* Encourage guest feedback and respond to issues quickly to maintain high satisfaction.
* Ensures proper cash\-handling and accountability procedures are being followed, including timely bank deposits.
* Recruit, hire, and train quality staff to build a strong team. Ensures a sales\-minded approach to service.
* Ensure all new hire paperwork and I\-9 forms are completed correctly and submitted on time.
* Approve and monitor time records. Ensure employees confirm their hours are recorded accurately.
* Submit accurate payroll data every pay period.
* Coach, develop, and train team members consistently.
* Set clear goals and hold team members accountable for sales and service outcomes.
* Highlight sales opportunities and revenue priorities with team members.
* Conduct performance reviews and use progressive discipline when needed to address performance issues.
* Be knowledgeable in and follow all J\&P programs. Implement J\&P programs as designed.
* Perform other job duties as assigned.


**QUALIFICATIONS:**


* 2\-5 years of General Manager experience.
* Success in managing a single\-unit business, ideally within hospitality, service, restaurants, or retail setting.
* Proven success driving sales growth and improving GOP performance.
* Strong leadership and coaching skills.
* Familiar with local, state, and federal employment laws and basic HR practices.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook, Teams).
* Strong organizational and time management skills.
* Ability to read, write, and communicate clearly in English. Bilingual in Spanish a plus.
* Clear verbal and communication skills.
* Good judgement and decision\-making skills.
* High School Diploma or equivalent required; College degree is a plus.


**EXPECTATIONS:**


* Must have a flexible schedule, including availability on nights, weekends, and holidays as needed.
* Valid driver’s license and Real ID\-compliant ID required.
* Must have reliable transportation.
* Must maintain a neat, professional appearance appropriate for a hotel environment.
* Must be 18 years of age at the time of hire and legally authorized to work in the United States without current of future visa sponsorship.
* Employment is subject to E\-Verify verification.
* Must be able to successfully pass a criminal background check in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws and company policy.


**PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:**


* Must be able to use a computer and phone for extended periods.
* Must be able to stand, walk, and climb stairs for long periods.
* Must be able to use hands, bend, stoop, kneel, and lift/move up to 25 pounds alone and up to 100 pounds with assistance.
* Must have the ability to detect odors such as smoke, gas, or strong cleaning chemicals to help ensure a safe environment for guests and staff.
* Must have vision abilities including close, distance, color, peripheral, and depth perception, as well as the ability to adjust focus.
* Must be able to perform the essential job functions with or without reasonable accommodation.

Dropbox isn’t just a workplace—it’s a living lab for designing a more enlightened way of working. Our Virtual First model combines the autonomy of a distributed workplace with the power of human connection, creating space for meaningful work and lasting relationships. Dropbox’s Virtual First way of working is designed to help people do their best work with flexibility, autonomy, and connection. We prioritize asynchronous communication to improve clarity, respect deep work time, and reduce unnecessary meetings. **NeighborWorks as a Company and an Employer**



At NeighborWorks® America, our people are humble, passionate and creative. We lead with empathy, encourage curiosity and embrace ambiguity. For over 45 years, Neighborhood Reinvestment Corp., a national, nonpartisan nonprofit organization known as NeighborWorks America, has worked to make every community a place of opportunity. Our network includes nearly 250 organizations in every state, the District of Columbia and Puerto Rico.



NeighborWorks America offers grant funding, peer exchange, technical assistance, evaluation tools and access to professional learning as the nation’s leading trainer of housing and community development professionals. NeighborWorks network organizations provide affordable homes, owned and rented, financial counseling and coaching, community building through resident engagement, and collaboration across health, employment and education. If our mission inspires you, read on to learn more about how you can support our work.



Caring for communities starts with caring for our internal community, our staff. Picture yourself in a collaborative and diverse hybrid environment surrounded by colleagues who challenge, encourage and inspire you. This opportunity offers an impressive total rewards package that includes a 401(k) match of up to 12%, 11 paid holidays, generous leave (including 40 hours of paid volunteer time) and industry\-leading benefits. Start your career with NeighborWorks America and take advantage of our Staff Training and Education Program (STEP), designed to support continued learning and professional development. Our benefits are designed to support staff holistically, enabling them to give their best in both work and life.



We are a mission\-based organization committed to fostering a high\-performing culture guided by our core values:


* We hold ourselves and each other accountable.
* We act with integrity.
* We lead with curiosity.
* We pursue excellence with courage.
* We respect, honor and celebrate each other.
* We collaborate with purpose.

  


**Work at a Glance:** Trusted Adviser and Strategic Collaborator for Network Organizations.


**Purpose of the Field Division:**



The Field Operations Division of NeighborWorks America (NWA) is responsible for delivering services, grants, and technical assistance to approximately 250 NeighborWorks organizations with the overall objective of sustaining a network of excellence that creates opportunities for people to live in affordable homes, improve their lives and strengthen their communities. The Field Operations Division is overseen by the Senior Vice President (SVP) of Field Operations, who is responsible for establishing the priorities and procedures for service delivery, grant programs and the identification of new affiliates. The primary relationship with NeighborWorks organizations is provided by staff in four regions across the country.


**Position Summary:**

The Senior Relationship Manager (Sr. RM) role is pivotal within the organization, focusing on serving a portfolio of network organizations (NWOs) and ensuring a deep understanding of their operations and needs. This position works closely with a team of relationship managers, other staff, and regional leadership in support of the region’s entire portfolio of NWOs.


**Essential Duties/Responsibilities:**


* Develop comprehensive understanding of organizations by sustaining relationships with network members’ leadership. Initiate and nurture state and local relationships which benefit local network members. Represent the region and NeighborWorks America in relationships with external stakeholders.


* Maintain deep knowledge of and actively promote NW’s portfolio of resources (including Initiatives, technical assistance, grant opportunities, etc.), ensuring network members have access to training, grant support, technical assistance, and other resources in the key lines of business.


* Serve as the primary point of contact between network organizations and NW America.


* Inform and advise NW America regarding strategic direction based on network input, identify issues confronting the network to which NW America may want to respond, and proactively offer solutions.


* In partnership with the NWOs, work to improve organizational health and performance. Diagnose challenges through analysis and assessment of financial reports and other supporting documents. Recommend strategies to maintain and develop optimal network organizational health and growth, which may include a potential training plan for the Board, executives, and/or staff. Assist network members with improving procedures and adopting best practices as requested.


* Work with Organizational Assessment Division in preparation for program reviews of network organizations, understand the organizational health issues in relation to network organizations’ lines of business and provide comments to discovery and draft reports. Provide input and/or produce write\-ups for the PROMPT Portal on each organization in coordination with quarterly Organizational Health Tracking System (OHTS) meetings. Represent the region in participating in OHTS Committee discussions, as needed. Develop action plans in coordination with network members to address items raised through the assessment process.
* Encourage organizations to think strategically about new lines of business, business models, practices, service delivery methodologies and service areas in order to have a greater impact within their service areas.


* Support network members’ efforts to develop comprehensive planning documents.


* Provide linkage between network members and NW, including the National Initiatives division and others, regarding participation in key initiatives such as Success Measures, Community Building \& Engagement, Rural Initiative, and Board Governance.


* Coordinate requests for technical assistance through third party contractors and/or other NW resources. Assure evaluation of all engagements by working closely with other regional staff to insure agreed upon outcomes for all technical assistance engagements. Provide technical assistance in areas of expertise.


* Lead collaborative working groups or teams of peers across the organization in order to achieve common goals.


* Have proficiency and demonstrated experience in one or more of the following areas: Real Estate Development; Asset Management; Homeownership; Lending/CDFIs; Financial Management; Resource Development; Organizational Management; or Board Governance.


* Assist organizations to deploy an equity lens in their programmatic and operational decision\-making.


* Build relationships with NWO boards of directors to assist them in key board responsibilities, particularly leadership transitions.


* Understand, evaluate and make recommendations on grant submissions
* Performs delegated responsibilities as designated by the supervisor in his/her absence.


* Broker impact of NW resources within assigned portfolio.


* Serve as region and/or Field division representative to division and/or corporate initiatives, programs, and working groups as agreed to by the supervisor. Help to mentor new regional staff.


* Other duties as required.


**Nature of Work Contacts:**

* NW network organizations and regional Field staff in order to strengthen organizational health and delivery of services provided to network organizations.


* Collaboration with other NW managers and staff.


* Federal Home Loan Banks and Federal Reserve Banks


* Statewide housing finance agencies
* Local and statewide strategic partners including funders, foundations and organizations operating in the community development industry.


* Vendors and professional services consultants.

title: Director of Field Marketing
description:
**Location:** East Coast–based candidates strongly preferred.

From developers practicing secure coding in Java to finance teams defending against AI\-generated voice phishing (vishing), we deliver training that actually reflects an employee’s real work.

title: Video Editor / Motion Designer
description:
**CapsLock** specializes in providing digital marketing services to businesses facing sales growth challenges. Our services include sales consulting, data analytics, and recruitment support, ensuring efficient and accelerated growth. Founded by industry professionals in IT, design, and data analytics, we address the market need for exclusive, scalable customer acquisition solutions.


At **CapsLock**, we value people, client orientation, quality, continuous improvement, integrity, and strong relationships. Our diverse, global team speaks over 10 languages whose ideas inspire the innovation that runs through everything we do, from unique technology to industry\-leading services and customer experiences.

 **﻿Role overview**

  

The Video Editor / Motion Designer at CapsLock creates and edits high\-performing video content with the primary goal of improving conversion rates. This role sits at the intersection of creative storytelling, motion design, and modern AI tooling — producing advertising videos that convert cold traffic across Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and landing pages.


You'll work closely with the Creative Director, marketers, and copywriters to develop, test, and iterate on video concepts, using AI tools alongside traditional post\-production to accelerate output and raise the quality bar.

 **Responsibilities**

**﻿**

**Video Creation \& Production**

* Develop video ads from concept to final delivery — funnel formats, YouTube, Facebook, and TikTok
* Edit and enhance videos using dialogue, graphics, music, sound design, and visual effects, ensuring logical sequencing and strong storytelling
* Create AI\-generated advertising creative for paid social and landing pages, converting cold traffic into warm leads
* Produce and refine photorealistic human characters in video, with attention to realism in motion, expression, and speech synchronisation
* Enhance video quality through upscaling, smoothness improvements, and post\-processing
* Deliver polished final cuts optimised for advertising performance goals

 **Concept Development \& Pre\-Production**

* Craft clear storylines and narrative structures tailored to platform and audience
* Prepare shoot guides and gather reference materials when collaborating with videographers
* Research and propose multiple creative angles, selecting the best options based on data and research
* Test different formats, calls\-to\-action, and visual approaches

 **AI Tools \& Optimization**

* Research, test, and integrate new AI tools into the production workflow to improve efficiency and output quality
* Experiment with AI\-assisted editing techniques including avatar generation, voice synthesis, and automated post\-production
* Use AI tools to reduce production time without compromising quality

 **Analytics \& Performance**

* Analyse video performance metrics and use insights to optimise creative
* Run A/B tests on formats, hooks, CTAs, and creative elements — monitor and document results promptly
* Build deep product knowledge and apply it to data\-driven creative decisions

 **Collaboration \& Trend Integration**

* Work closely with the Creative Director, copywriters, marketers, and designers to ensure creative alignment
* Track and apply the latest video trends, viral formats, and platform\-specific features
* Document all tasks clearly in ClickUp per team standards

  

Requirements:  

  

**Must\-Have Skills**

* Full post\-production capability: cutting, titling, colour correction, After Effects, sound mixing
* Strong command of video rhythm, pacing, transitions, typography, and sound design
* Skills in improving video quality — sharpness, smoothness, upscaling
* Hands\-on experience creating AI\-generated video from scratch or from references
* Ability to produce realistic human characters in video, including lip\-sync and speech\-to\-movement synchronisation
* Deep enough understanding of video editing to speak the language and spot problems early
* Ability to work from a detailed brief and proactively propose creative solutions
* Comfort collaborating with a Creative Director on iterations and new concepts

 **Technical Skills**

* 2\+ years of experience in video editing, post\-production, or motion design as a primary discipline
* Advanced proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro and After Effects. **Desktop\-based editing is required — portfolios built on mobile\-only tools such as CapCut will not be considered**
* Experience working within an agency or structured in\-house team, with established workflows and reporting lines
* Working experience with AI video tools: Veo, Higgsfield, Runway, Kling, HeyGen, or similar
* Experience with AI image generation tools: Midjourney, Stable Diffusion, or similar
* Solid understanding of video formats for YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, and Facebook
* Comfortable reviewing performance analytics and iterating based on data
* Upper\-intermediate English (B2\) or higher

 **﻿****Soft Skills**

* Curious to explore new tools, formats, and creative approaches
* Adaptable to shifting priorities and fast\-paced team dynamics
* High execution speed without compromising quality
* Consistent on\-time delivery and strong attention to deadlines
* Strong attention to detail, especially around compliance and brand guidelines
* Critical thinking and a problem\-solving mindset
* Clear, professional communication and team collaboration skills
* Initiative to find solutions even when processes are undefined

 **Why do we deserve your attention?**


Not only do we offer fair and competitive pay, but we also provide perks and benefits that support your well\-being and growth. Here are some of them:

 **Remote Work**


We are a truly remote\-first company. You choose where you feel the most productive and comfortable to make an impact.

 **Paid Time Off**


Work\-life balance matters to us, and we support it with paid time off for rest, personal time, or simply doing what makes you happy.

 **Ongoing Learning**


We believe in curiosity and growth. That’s why we support continuous learning with workshops, online courses, conferences, and certifications.

 **Home Office**


We help you set up your perfect workspace by covering equipment and furniture expenses, so you can do your best work from home.

 **Physical Well\-Being**


From gym memberships and yoga classes to home workout equipment or even a bicycle, we give you the flexibility to stay active your way.

 **Unlimited Sick Days**


Your health matters. Take the time you need to rest and recover \- we’ll be here when you’re ready to return.

 **Medical Coverage**


We support you and your family with reimbursement for medical insurance and health\-related expenses, including dental care and psychological support.

 **Co\-Working Space**


If you sometimes crave a change of scenery or more social interaction, we’ll cover the full cost of a co\-working space.

 **Fun Stuff**


From gaming nights and fitness challenges to annual retreats at world\-class resorts, we make sure there’s never a shortage of fun and connection.

title: Head of Education
description:
****Description****
****About us****
 Platzi is the largest technology school in the Hispanic world with over 7 million students and 4,000 companies trusting us to deliver effective online education. Our mission is to make Latin America a technology superpower. We do it by training companies and individuals in areas such as AI, Cybersecurity, English, Programming and Leadership.
   

  

 As an industry leader, our presence is highlighted by our massive and fanatic community, extensive press coverage and a daily stream of success stories from students. We operate mostly remote, with key offices in Bogotá, Medellín and Mexico City.
   

  

******Summary******
 As Head of Education at Platzi, you own the content engine and the team behind it: the Course Directors, the Postproduction Manager (who leads the editors). You own the content strategy end\-to\-end and you keep the whole system running. You report to the CPO.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on builder's role. You're a head, but you live in the operation and the detail. You code and ship tools, and you've already learned what Platzi needs to teach now, that's what lets you judge whether content is good and see where it should go next. You don't just decide what we teach; you design the strategy, read market demand, and shape a catalog that makes sense for Platzi and gives Growth an engine that works. And you back it with data.
   

  

****Requirements****
****Responsibilities****
* Lead the Education team: Course Directors, the Postproduction Manager (who leads the editors), and the partnerships lead.
* Design the content strategy: read market demand and Platzi's fit to decide what we teach and why.
* Own the content roadmap: decide what we build, in what order, and why.
* Own content quality: set the standard for a great course and go to the root cause when it's not met.
* Keep the system running end\-to\-end: production, postproduction, and publishing, on time and at quality.
* Build, don't just manage: ship internal tools, including AI, that scale how we produce and improve courses.
* Own the numbers: retention, acquisition, and enrollments per course and plan launches with Growth Marketing so the catalog drives results.


******Requirements******
* At least 7 years of experience, including leading a team with direct reports.
* You can code, and you've already built at least one tool with AI.
* You understand how to create content: you've made courses or educational content yourself.
* You've used metrics to make decisions: retention, acquisition, enrollments, or a similar funnel.
* Experience in startups or fast\-moving environments, close to new ways of learning.
* Fluent English and Spanish.


****Benefits****
**💻 Hardware**
 With Platzi's help, you will have 100% of the necessary work tools such as a laptop, smartphone, desk, ergonomic chair, monitor, and other accessories.
   

  

**📗 Books**
 We provide you with all the books you need to grow professionally on Kindle, and we give you the Kindle too 😉.
   

  

**🐣 Maternity/Paternity Leave**
 At Platzi, we believe in gender equity and the importance of parents in the upbringing and care of their children. We make this a reality for new mothers and fathers through extended maternity and paternity leave.
   

  

**💸 Option Pool**
 All members of the Platzi Team have the opportunity to own a part of Platzi and have company shares.
   

  

**🌴 Vacation**
 You have 15 days of vacation per year regardless of the country you are in, starting from the moment you join the team.
   

  

**💆‍♂️ Online Therapy**
 We care about your emotional health by covering the first four online therapy sessions with specialized companies.
   

  

**🌐 Team Syncs**
 Although we are in different parts of the world, Platzi teams meet in person during the year to exchange ideas, build, and strengthen bonds.
   

  

**🏖️ Villa Platzi**
 Every year, the entire team gathers somewhere in the world for a week to meet face\-to\-face, get to know each other, have interesting discussions, and plan ambitious projects.

description:
**Company Description**
**Join the team redefining how the world experiences design.**
 Hey, hello, hiya, g'day, mabuhay, kia ora, 你好, hallo, vítejte!
   

  

 Thanks for stopping by. We know job hunting can be a little time consuming and you're probably keen to find out what's on offer, so we'll get straight to the point.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Where and how you can work**
 Our headquarters is in sunny Sydney, Australia, but our team spans the globe. Since we don’t have a physical campus in Argentina, this role is fully remote—giving you the flexibility to do your best work from wherever you thrive.
   

  

**What You’d Be Doing In This Role**
 As Canva scales change continues to be part of our DNA. But we like to think that's all part of the fun. So this will give you the flavour of the type of things you'll be working on when you start, but this will likely evolve.
   

  

**At The Moment, This Role Is Focused On**
* Strategy. Act as the main leadership point of contact with responsibility for overall user and revenue growth in Argentina. You'll bring together local and global teams across marketing, sales, product, content and finance to create and execute a cohesive multi\-year growth strategy, and own the KPIs including MAUs and ARR.
* Localisation. Work closely with the regional team to optimise our product, content, pricing and packaging to meet the needs of local users, informed by a deep understanding of local market dynamics and cultural nuances across a range of audiences, including knowledge workers, SMBs, students, startup ecosystems, NGOs, and other emerging sectors.
* Leadership. Hire, inspire, drive and in some cases coach the in\-market team, ensuring a high quality bar for impact and working closely with local speciality leads on performance management.
* Budget. Partner closely with the regional team and marketing lead to shape the marketing strategy and deployment of budget.
* Sponsorship. Build and support high value relationships by acting as a local sponsor for enterprise sales, education, government, partnerships, etc.
* Public face. Represent Canva as a local figurehead across press, PR, events and community.


**You're probably a match if**
* You are strongly entrepreneurial. Founder\-style appetite for growing something big from a small start and working across everything from education to press.
* You possess experience growing a market. For example, as the regional GM or brand lead for a global SaaS company, or as a proven founder or growth lead in a startup in a high growth environment.
* You are a proven leader. Ability to grow, inspire, and coach high\-performing teams. You have high emotional intelligence and empathy, and are a deeply collaborative teammate.
* You are a strong communicator. Fully proficient in spoken and written English, and with the interpersonal skills to influence global and local stakeholders.
* You are keenly analytical. Deeply focused on KPIs and obsessive about driving actionable insights from disparate datasets and able to think about a market’s performance holistically.
* you are product oriented. Passion for improving the experience of users and the ability to translate local insights into product requirements with experience localising a global product for a particular market.
* You are values aligned. Genuinely excited by Canva’s mission and deeply aligned with our values, and with exceptional references to prove it.
* You are publicity savvy. Experience doing public speaking and acting as a public face to the press and other stakeholders.
* You are well networked. Ideally with routes into some combination of government departments, corporates, influencers, journalists and local talent


**About The Team**
 Canva’s International supergroup is a diverse, distributed team of marketers, strategists, and growth leaders focused on expanding Canva's presence in key global markets. Our team partners with functions across Marketing, Growth, Product, Sales, Partnerships, Content, Finance, and Strategy to drive sustainable user and revenue growth in international markets.
   

  

 As the Country Manager for Argentina, you will be the main point of contact and the driving force behind Canva’s success in the country. You will own and implement a multi\-year strategic roadmap, leading cross\-functional efforts to grow the user base and scale revenue.
   

  

 This role requires deep market knowledge, a growth mindset, and strong leadership capabilities to bring together local and global teams across marketing, sales, and product in a cohesive strategy.
   

  

**What's in it for you?**
 Achieving our crazy big goals motivates us to work hard \- and we do \- but you'll experience lots of moments of magic, connectivity and fun woven throughout life at Canva, too. We also offer a range of benefits to set you up for every success in and outside of work.
   

  

**Here's a Taste Of What's On Offer**
* Equity packages \- we want our success to be yours too
* Inclusive parental leave policy
* An annual Vibe \& Thrive package to support your wellbeing, social connection, office setup \& more
* Flexible leave options that empower you to be a force for good, take time to recharge and supports you personally


 Check out lifeatcanva.com for more info.
   

  

**Other Stuff To Know**
 We make hiring decisions based on your experience, skills and passion, as well as how you can enhance Canva and our culture. When you apply, please tell us the pronouns you use and any reasonable adjustments you may need during the interview process.
   

  

 We celebrate all types of skills and backgrounds at Canva so even if you don’t feel like your skills quite match what’s listed above \- we still want to hear from you!
   

  

 Please note that interviews are conducted virtually.

title: GENERAL MANAGER / MANAGING DIRECTOR Savvy Smart Deals
description:
**GENERAL MANAGER / MANAGING DIRECTOR Savvy Smart Deals**  

**Location:** Remote  

**Type:** Full\-Time, Senior Executive  

**Industry:** Global E\-Commerce, DTC, Consumer Products, Performance Marketing

 **THE ROLE**  

Savvy Smart Deals is looking for a senior operator to **run the business end to end**.



This is not a traditional General Manager role.

  

You will have full responsibility for the commercial performance of Savvy Smart Deals, including:


* P\&L
* Product strategy
* Sourcing
* Pricing
* Marketing
* Traffic
* Sales
* Inventory
* Budgets
* Operations
* Team performance
* Growth

  



You will effectively operate Savvy as the business owner, with responsibility for turning products into profitable, scalable businesses.

 **WHAT YOU WILL OWN**


**Business \& P\&L**

  

* Own revenue, margin, profit, budgets and forecasts
* Manage marketing spend and operating costs
* Review weekly performance and take corrective action quickly
* Ensure every major product and channel has clear economics

  


**Products \& Sourcing**

  

* Continuously identify strong new product opportunities
* Evaluate market demand, competition, margin and scalability
* Work with suppliers and sourcing teams
* Negotiate price, MOQ, terms, production and lead times
* Manage product launches and seasonal planning

**Marketing \& Offers**

* Negotiate payouts and commercial terms
* Secure profitable traffic at scale

* Prevent stockouts and excessive inventory
* Improve use of existing inventory through new offers, bundles and upsells
* Coordinate suppliers, fulfillment, logistics and warehouse operations

**Performance \& Analytics**  

You must understand and actively manage:


* Revenue
* Gross and net profit

* ROAS
* RPC
* CVR
* AOV
* Affiliate payouts
* Payment approval rates
* Refunds and chargebacks
* Inventory levels
* Recurring revenue
* Customer lifetime value
  


This is a data\-driven role. Decisions should be based on economics, not opinion.

 **Leadership**

  

* Lead the Savvy business and operating team
* Set priorities, owners and deadlines
* Hold teams accountable for results
* Coordinate sourcing, creative, marketing, technology, analytics, finance and operations
* Recruit and develop strong people
* Remove roadblocks and keep execution moving

  

  

**WHO WE WANT**  

We are looking for a proven **owner\-type operator**, not a corporate administrator.

  

You should have meaningful experience running or scaling an e\-commerce, DTC, consumer\-products or performance\-marketing business.

  

Strong candidates will have:


* Senior leadership experience
* Direct P\&L responsibility
* Experience launching and scaling products
* Strong commercial and negotiation skills
* Strong understanding of performance and affiliate marketing
* Experience with Shopify and direct\-response e\-commerce
* Strong financial and analytical ability
* Experience managing marketing budgets
* Understanding of sourcing, inventory and supply\-chain economics
* Experience leading cross\-functional teams
* Excellent English
* Strong technology and AI skills

  

  

Experience with international e\-commerce, Asian sourcing, Amazon, recurring\-revenue models and payment optimization is a strong advantage.

 **THE PERSON**  

We want someone who can:


* Make decisions
* Move quickly
* Negotiate hard
* Understand numbers
* Challenge weak assumptions
* Find opportunities
* Solve problems
* Lead people
* Take responsibility for results

  

  

You should be comfortable moving from a supplier negotiation to a P\&L review, then to a marketing campaign, traffic negotiation or inventory issue in the same day.

  

This role will not suit someone who waits for detailed instructions or manages mainly through meetings.

 **WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE**  

Success means building Savvy Smart Deals into a larger, more profitable and better\-run global e\-commerce business with:


* Strong new products
* Profitable traffic
* Faster launches
* Better conversion
* Higher AOV
* Growing recurring revenue
* Strong inventory management
* Accurate forecasting
* Clear accountability
* Consistent testing and optimization
* Increasing revenue and profit

  

  

**WHY JOIN**  

This is a rare opportunity to **run an entire business**, not one department.

  

You will have significant authority, direct access to ownership, strong internal resources and meaningful performance\-based upside.

  

If you have already built, operated or scaled an e\-commerce business and want full responsibility for the outcome, we want to speak with you.

title: Interior Design Associate Director
description:
TGP International is looking for an experienced and highly creative Senior Associate / Associate Director to join its studio.

  

TGP International is a global hospitality consultancy based in London, Dubai, and Cairo. We partner with ambitious brands, clients, and entrepreneurs to turn their visions into successful hospitality experiences through concept development, interior design, branding and graphic design, advisory, franchising, operations, and project management. Our multidisciplinary team brings together interior designers, brand designers, strategists, advisors, chefs, and hospitality operators. This combination of creative and commercial expertise makes TGP an exciting environment for people who are passionate about food, hospitality and creating memorable guest experiences.

  

We are looking for someone who shares that passion. Someone inspired by the opportunity to create world\-class restaurants, bars, food halls, and hospitality destinations, and who understands how exceptional design can transform the guest experience.

  

While TGP is an established international consultancy, we retain a strong entrepreneurial spirit. This is a senior role within our Interior Design team, offering significant studio responsibility, client exposure, and the opportunity to contribute directly to exciting hospitality projects.  

  

**Key Responsibilities:**  

**Design Expertise**

* Deliver world class creative solutions across multiple small, medium, and large\-scale projects simultaneously, and across multiple geographies (UK, Europe, Asia and Middle East)
* Lead projects and the creative process from concept to delivery; with proven track record of strong design narrative where storytelling remains at the heart of the project throughout its development
* Lead and contribute hands\-on to concept development and design presentations, test fits, spatial planning, and 3D models, with a strong focus on guest experience and operational functionality
* Review detailed drawing packages, finishes and FF\&E specifications ensuring technical requirements and design intent are successfully co\-ordinated, including liaising effectively with clients, consultants, contractors and suppliers throughout the design and delivery process
* Demonstrate deep knowledge of design detailing, materials, finishes, fixtures and furniture, including fabrication and construction processes
* Build and maintain strong professional relationships with suppliers, manufacturers, makers, and other industry partners

 **Project Leadership \& Management**

* Take accountability for the successful creative and commercial delivery of projects to TGP’s quality standards
* Maintain oversight and remain actively involved and hands\-on throughout the entire project process, from initial concept through to design development, documentation, and delivery
* Make informed decisions regarding project resourcing, priorities, workflows, and allocation of responsibilities across internal teams including weekly resource tracking and coordination of project scheduling
* Manage projects effectively against agreed programmes, budgets, contractual scope of services, and commercial requirements
* Identify project risks and challenges early and work proactively with leadership team to resolve them
* Provide clear and timely reporting to the leadership team on project progress, resourcing, and key issues

 **Team Development \& Management**

* Foster a collaborative and supportive environment in which knowledge and best practice are openly shared
* Lead, mentor and train junior team members to support their professional and creative development, and maximise team performance and quality design output
* Support department resource planning, forecasting, project allocation and ad\-hoc department admin
* Manage workloads and workflows across multiple concurrent projects, ensuring teams are appropriately supported
* Contribute positively to TGP’s studio culture and help maintain an environment that encourages collaboration and creativity

 **Client Engagement**

* Proactively manage existing client relationships, ensuring that opportunities for repeat work are maximised
* Present creative concepts and design thinking clearly, confidently, and persuasively to senior client stakeholders
* Actively engage with opportunities to develop new business, enhancing internal and external communications via events, forums, and publications
* Support the preparation of fee bids, RFPs, and fee negotiations on projects

 **Software Proficiency**

* Adobe Suite
* AutoCAD
* SketchUp
* PowerPoint
* Microsoft Office


Experience with the following would be advantageous:

* Miro
* Asana

  

The role is based in our Covent Garden studio in London, with a hybrid working model of three days per week in the studio, and two days working remotely from home.

 **Requirements** **What we are looking for:**


We are looking for an accomplished hospitality designer and creative leader who combines exceptional design ability with strong project, team, and client leadership.


The successful candidate will have:

* 10\+ years' professional experience in interior design or interior architecture, with significant experience in hospitality and F\&B environments
* An outstanding portfolio demonstrating exceptional creative quality across restaurants, food halls, bars, and other hospitality and commercial environments having worked through Riba stages 1\-6
* A proven ability to develop emotive, narrative\-driven, and design\-led concepts and experiences, across projects of varying scales and geographies
* Strong creative leadership, with the ability to take projects from initial concept and storytelling through design development and delivery, including technical and construction expertise
* The confidence and experience to operate autonomously, with minimal supervision from leadership team
* Strong leadership and mentoring capabilities, with experience developing and managing design teams
* Commercial awareness and an understanding of project programmes, budgets/value engineering, contracts, fees, and resourcing
* Excellent client\-facing, presentation, and communication skills
* A collaborative, adaptable, no\-ego approach, and a commitment to contributing positively to studio culture
* A bachelor’s degree in interior design, Interior Architecture or a related discipline from an accredited institution, or equivalent professional qualification
* The right to work in the UK

 **Benefits** **TGP International employee benefits:**

* Hybrid work arrangement: three days in the office and two days working remotely
* Company incentive scheme offering up to 5 to 10 per cent for introductions and 5 per cent for successful closures
* Remote work flexibility: one additional week per year to work remotely from your home country, which can be combined with up to two consecutive weeks of annual leave
* Structured professional development through a dedicated coaching and mentoring program
* Annual company gathering: a global team event bringing together employees from all offices
* An employee recognition program: regular recognition initiatives celebrating outstanding performance and contributions

title: Account Director - GCC
description:
#### **About Us**


For over two decades, The Boundary has been at the forefront of digital excellence. With a global team of 150\+ experts across London, New York, Dubai, and Auckland, we partner with the world's leading developers to deliver unparalleled architectural storytelling.


Founded by award\-winning architects, our work sits at the intersection of design intuition and technical mastery. From pioneering digital twin infrastructure to the seamless integration of AI and real\-time technology, we don’t just anticipate the future of the industry; we are already building it.

#### **The Opportunity**


The strongest client relationships do more than sustain great work. They create the trust, clarity and commercial confidence that allow ambitious ideas to move forward.


At The Boundary, we partner with leading developers, architects, real estate businesses and global brands to bring places and ideas to life. Our Account Directors sit at the centre of those partnerships \- understanding what matters to the client, aligning the right internal teams and ensuring that every interaction strengthens the relationship.


We are looking for an experienced Account Director to lead a portfolio of high\-value accounts across the GCC region. This is a senior client leadership role with clear accountability for relationship health, retention, account growth and service excellence.

#### **What we're looking for**


You are a strategic account leader who combines excellent judgement with strong commercial instincts. You understand how to build trusted, long\-term relationships while identifying the opportunities that create genuine value for both the client and the business.


You are comfortable working across complex, multi\-service accounts and high\-profile projects. You can move confidently between long\-range account planning, commercial discussions, delivery oversight and urgent issue resolution without losing sight of the wider relationship.


Clients trust you because you listen carefully, communicate clearly and follow through. Internal teams trust you because you translate client priorities into focused, achievable plans and advocate for the relationship without compromising delivery quality, capacity or process.


You are also an experienced people leader. You know how to mentor client\-service professionals, give useful feedback and raise standards while creating the confidence and clarity people need to perform at their best.

#### **What You'll Do**

**Lead strategic client relationships.** Act as the senior strategic lead and primary point of contact for a portfolio of key accounts, developing a detailed understanding of each client's objectives, stakeholders, priorities and long\-term opportunities.

**Build account plans that deliver growth.** Own relationship planning, support client tiering and identify well\-timed opportunities to retain, expand, cross\-sell and upsell services within existing accounts.

**Shape commercial opportunities.** Partner with Business Development and regional leadership on proposals, pitches and commercial discussions, ensuring opportunities are well scoped and aligned with client needs and business priorities.

**Provide delivery governance.** Work with Project Management, Production and Creative leaders to ensure briefs are translated into clear, achievable plans, risks are identified early and strategic deliverables remain aligned with expectations.

**Resolve issues with pace and judgement.** Take ownership of client concerns and escalations, establish clear resolution plans and maintain trust through professional, transparent communication.

**Create continuity from pitch to delivery.** Support the onboarding of high\-value projects and ensure the Client Services function is properly represented in project timelines, resourcing and creative\-development conversations.

**Develop the Client Services team.** Mentor Senior Managers and Managers across multiple accounts, contribute to onboarding and training, and provide clear feedback that strengthens commercial awareness and service quality.

**Improve how we work.** Champion consistent use of systems, SOPs and shared templates; identify process gaps; and lead post\-mortems or service audits that turn project experience into practical improvement.

**Maintain accurate account intelligence.** Track account health, engagement, feedback, opportunities and risks, ensuring information is complete, current and visible to the relevant leadership teams.

#### **What You'll Bring**

**Substantial senior client\-services experience.** Typically eight or more years in strategic account management or a comparable client leadership role, with responsibility for significant, complex accounts.

**A proven record of account growth.** Evidence of retaining and expanding key relationships, identifying commercially sound opportunities and contributing to successful proposals or pitches.

**Experience in a relevant environment.** A background in a creative, advertising, architectural, real estate, SaaS or related professional\-services business. Agency or creative\-production experience would be particularly valuable.

**Strong commercial acumen.** Confidence discussing scope, budgets, value and delivery trade\-offs, with the judgement to balance client priorities against operational and commercial realities.

**Executive\-level communication.** Excellent presentation, negotiation and stakeholder\-management skills, including the ability to lead high\-stakes conversations and build credibility with senior decision\-makers.

**Delivery understanding.** A practical knowledge of project\-delivery workflows and the ability to work effectively with Project Management, Production, Creative and Finance teams.

**People leadership.** Experience mentoring colleagues, providing performance feedback and improving capability across a client\-services team.

**A proactive, solutions\-focused approach.** You are tenacious, organised and accountable, absorb new technical and industry knowledge quickly, and respond constructively to feedback.

**Relevant education or equivalent experience.** A bachelor's degree in Management, Marketing, Real Estate or a related field is preferred, but substantial relevant experience is equally important.

title: Marketing & Growth Manager
description:
Rite is one of the fastest\-growing wellness brands in the Middle East, making daily nutrition enjoyable through functional gummies and drink mixes.
 



 Founded in Dubai and now operating locally in Saudi Arabia, we're building much more than a supplement brand, we're creating a wellness ecosystem powered by content, community, education, and exceptional products.
 



 Rite is currently available online and in more than 300\+ stores.
 



 We're looking for an entrepreneurial marketing leader who wants to continue building a strong brand, not simply manage and execute.
 



  





**ROLE OVERVIEW** 




  





 As our Marketing \& Growth Manager, you will own the execution of Rite's marketing strategy across the UAE and Saudi Arabia.
 



 You will be responsible for ensuring every customer touchpoint \- from paid advertising and social media to CRM, influencers, and content \- works together to build a premium brand while driving profitable growth.
 



 Rather than executing every task yourself, your role is to lead internal and external partners, challenge ideas, improve creative quality, and make sure every initiative contributes to business growth.
 



 You'll work closely with the founders and become one of the key leaders shaping Rite's future.
 



  





**YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES** 




  





**Brand \& Creative Leadership** 



* Own Rite's brand positioning across all channels.
* Define the creative direction for advertising and organic content, both online and offline.
* Ensure consistency across Meta, TikTok, Snapchat, CRM, and the website.
* Challenge and improve every creative before production.
* Build a premium, recognizable wellness brand online and offline.



  





**Performance Marketing** 




 Work closely with our Media Buyer, UGC ads agency, and Creative Strategist by:
 


* Reviewing weekly performance.
* Identifying winning creative angles for the UAE and KSA markets.
* Defining testing priorities with our Creative Strategist and adapting them culturally to both countries.
* Ensuring creative production aligns with performance insights.
* Coordinating creative strategy with media buying.



  





**Content \& Social Media** 




 Own:
 


* Content calendar.
* Social strategy.
* Organic growth.
* Video production for product launches or specific campaigns.
* UGC planning.
* Community building.
* Brand storytelling.



 Coordinate with external UGC agencies and freelance creators.
 



 Manage our in\-house Social Media \& Influencer Executive, who will support you with execution.
 



  





**Influencer Strategy** 




 Lead the entire influencer programme strategy by managing our Influencer \& Partnerships Manager and external agencies responsible for execution.
 



 Responsibilities include:
 


* Supporting creator sourcing.
* Supporting negotiations.
* Leading the affiliate strategy and ecosystem.
* Leading the whitelisting strategy.
* Campaign execution.
* Performance reporting.



 Build long\-term relationships with creators across the UAE and Saudi Arabia and ensure that deliverables are properly executed by your team and external agencies.
 



  





**Partnerships \& Brand Activations** 




 Lead Rite's partnership strategy to increase brand awareness, customer acquisition, and community engagement.
 


* Develop co\-marketing campaigns and brand collaborations.
* Support our Brand Partnerships \& Sales Manager with brand activations, pop\-ups, sampling campaigns, and wellness events.
* Support the creation of packaging, PR boxes, and marketing collateral.
* Manage sponsorship opportunities and experiential marketing initiatives.
* Create partnerships that generate both commercial opportunities and long\-term brand equity.



  





**CRM \& Customer Retention** 




 Be the main point of contact for our CRM agency and support them with strategy and execution.
 



 Own:
 


* Email strategy.
* Customer journeys.
* Campaign calendar.
* Loyalty initiatives.
* Product launches.



  





**Agency Management** 




 Coordinate multiple external partners, including:
 


* Creative agencies.
* UGC agencies and UGC creators.
* Production companies.
* Influencer agencies.
* CRM agency.
* Freelancers, including video editors and graphic designers.



 Ensure everyone works toward the same objectives.
 



  





**Team Leadership** 




 Manage and work closely with:
 


* Creative Strategist, remote.
* In\-house Graphic Designer.
* In\-house Social Media \& Influencer Executive.
* Country Manager Saudi Arabia, based in Riyadh.



 Create a high\-performance culture focused on accountability, speed, and continuous improvement.
 



  





**We're Looking for Someone Who...** 



* Has 3–5\+ years of experience in e\-commerce, DTC, or consumer brands.
* Has extensive experience in performance marketing, offline marketing, content, social media, and influencer management.
* Understands how strong marketing drives acquisition.
* Has managed multiple agencies and cross\-functional teams.
* Has deep knowledge of UAE and Saudi consumer behaviour.
* Understands influencer marketing beyond vanity metrics.
* Thinks commercially, not just creatively.
* Is highly organised and execution\-focused.
* Is proactive, curious, and constantly looking for better ways of doing things.
* Has strong skills in the use of AI to set up efficient systems and SOPs.
* Is comfortable working in a fast\-moving startup environment.



  





**The Entrepreneurial Mindset We're Looking For** 




 We're not looking for someone who waits for instructions.
 



 We want someone who:
 


* Treats Rite as if it were their own company.
* Challenges existing ideas and proposes better ones.
* Takes ownership rather than simply completing tasks.
* Is obsessed with customer experience and business growth.
* Moves fast, learns quickly, and embraces experimentation.
* Is comfortable wearing multiple hats.
* Makes decisions using both data and intuition.
* Inspires the team through energy, curiosity, and ambition.



  





**What We Offer** 



* A unique opportunity to build one of the fastest\-growing wellness brands in the Middle East from the inside.
* High ownership and autonomy, with the ability to shape our brand, growth strategy, and partnership ecosystem alongside the founders.
* A competitive salary complemented by a performance\-based bonus.
* The chance to recruit, lead, and develop a high\-performing marketing team as the company scales.
* Exposure to multiple high\-growth markets, with a strong focus on the UAE and Saudi Arabia and future international expansion.
* A dynamic, entrepreneurial environment where ideas move quickly from concept to execution without unnecessary bureaucracy.
* Company visa, comprehensive health insurance, annual flight ticket, generous annual leave, and the tools you need to perform at your best.
* Flexible working arrangements and the opportunity to travel to Saudi Arabia for key partnerships, product launches, retail activations, and industry events.
* Unlimited access to Rite products and the opportunity to help shape the future of wellness in the region.

title: Director of AI Experience Design
description:
At Edelman Financial Engines (EFE), our purpose is to guide people with the financial advice they need to thrive.

We believe that every dollar saved represents a lifetime of hard work and aspirations, and every dollar invested has a job to do for our clients. That's why we are committed to managing our clients' investments by truly understanding them as people first and then delivering advice, strategies and solutions to help them feel confident about the plans they are making, whether for today, tomorrow, or in the great unknown future. Our goal is to build long\-term relationships based on respect, integrity, and a belief that our responsibility is to help people make smart investments decisions in every stage of their lives.

Our culture is grounded in our CORE values: Client First, One Team, Respectful Candor, and Endless Curiosity. These values guide everything we do, for our clients and each other. We are committed to moving forward together. If you are inspired by purpose\-driven work and a collaborative, values\-led culture, we invite you to explore a career with us.  

As a Director of AI Experience Design within the AI Center of Excellence, you will play a pivotal role in shaping how AI transforms the advisor, client, and employee experience across Edelman Financial Engines. This role is responsible for defining and driving a human\-centered AI experience strategy that combines behavioral science, design thinking, and data\-driven decision making to create intuitive, trusted, and outcome\-oriented AI solutions. You will champion a deep understanding of user behavior, needs, motivations, and decision\-making patterns to influence the design of AI\-powered tools, workflows, recommendations, and agentic experiences that drive adoption, engagement, trust, productivity, and business impact.



In addition to being a highly collaborative and influential leader, we are seeking a candidate who brings a unique blend of UX leadership, behavioral design expertise, and AI product innovation. The ideal candidate has a proven track record of translating complex technologies into simple, intuitive experiences and using behavioral insights, user research, and data to drive measurable results. If you are passionate about designing the future of human\-AI interaction, thrive in rapidly evolving environments, and believe exceptional experiences should be measured not only by usability but by the outcomes they create, this is an opportunity to make a lasting impact on the future of AI at Edelman Financial Engines.


**Responsibilities:**


* AI Integration \& Design
	+ Define and champion experience principles for AI\-powered products, tools, and workflows across the organization.
	+ Design conversational, multimodal, and agent\-assisted experiences that support natural and intuitive user interactions.
	+ Create user journeys that effectively blend human expertise with AI\-driven recommendations and automation.
	+ Establish AI UX standards, interaction patterns, and design guidelines that promote consistency, accessibility, trust, and usability.
	+ Conduct user research to understand customer behaviors, needs, mental models, and emerging expectations related to AI\-driven experiences.
	+ Drive the development of personas, journey maps, service blueprints, and experience frameworks for AI\-enabled products.
	+ Ensure AI experiences are transparent, explainable, and aligned with responsible AI principles.
* Product Design Execution \& Collaboration
	+ Partner closely with Product Managers, Engineers, Architects, and Data teams throughout the product lifecycle to deliver high\-quality AI\-centered experiences.
	+ Translate user insights into wireframes, prototypes, workflows, and interaction designs that can be rapidly tested and validated.
	+ Participate in product discovery, experimentation, and iterative design processes to continuously improve user outcomes.
	+ Collaborate across multiple squads to drive experience consistency across products, channels, and business capabilities.
	+ Advocate for user\-centric decision\-making throughout planning, prioritization, and execution activities.
	+ Facilitate design reviews and experience assessments to ensure solutions meet usability and accessibility standards
* Continuous Optimization
	+ Leverage analytics and user feedback to refine and improve human\-led, AI\-enabled experiences
	+ Monitor performance of AI\-enabled features and drive optimization
	+ Ensure consistent and responsible utilization of AI across multiple execution teams

**Requirements:**


* Bachelor's degree required
* 5\-10\+ years of experience spanning UX design, product design
* Experience deploying AI/ML solutions in regulated environments (financial services strongly preferred)
* Experience with Product development lifecycle from ideation to execution
* Experience working with Agile product teams
* Strong understanding of AI/ML ecosystems, LLMs, data platforms, and orchestration layers.
* Track record of balancing innovation, risk, and regulatory compliance.
* Experience working with multiple stakeholders in different areas (ex: Data, Architecture, Compliance)
* Experience working with ADA Compliant design
* Strong understanding of AI (within the landscape of regulated industries preferred)
* Ability to design experiences that build user trust, transparency, and confidence in AI\-driven interactions.
* Proficiency in journey mapping, prototyping, wireframing, design systems, and usability testing.
* Strong communication and storytelling skills with the ability to influence stakeholders across business and technology teams.
* Ability to understand interdependent ecosystems and proactively look for opportunities for scale and consistency.
* Ability to leverage data to drive optimization across tool sets

**About Edelman Financial Engines**
Since 1986, Edelman Financial Engines has been committed to always acting in the best interests of our clients. We were founded on the belief that all investors – not just the wealthy – deserve access to personal, comprehensive financial planning and investment advice. Recognized by *Barron's* as a top RIA firm for eight years in a row (awarded each September (2018\-2025\) based on prior 12\-month data through June 30\)1, we support more than 1\.27 million clients across 140\+ offices nationwide and manage over $324 billion in assets 2\.
