title: Eastern Oregon Regional Hub Organizer
description:
**Position Summary**

Visión Comunitaria de Oregon (VCO) is seeking an Eastern Oregon Regional Hub Organizer to build and lead the Eastern Oregon region’s hub as part of our statewide organizing infrastructure. This role develops community leadership pipelines, advances culturally rooted campaigns, and ensures regional priorities feed into VCO’s advocacy, data, and coalition work.

The ideal candidate is a bilingual, bicultural, racial equity\-driven professional eager to help build the infrastructure of a growing statewide organization in its first year as an independent 501(c)(3\).

VCO offers a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and their dependents; professional development support; language pay differential stipends; WiFi stipend and partial cell phone reimbursement; and travel and lodging coverage for work\-related activities.

**Key Deadlines and Proposed Timeline**

● Applications Due – Oct 2, 2026

● First Round of Virtual Interviews – Oct 14, 2026 \- Oct 16, 2026

● Second Round of Interviews – Oct 21, 2026 \- Oct 23, 2026

● Reference Checks – Oct 26, 2026 \- Oct 27, 2026

● First Day of Work (tentative) – Nov 16, 2026

**Organizational Summary**

Visión Comunitaria de Oregon (VCO) is a collective of Latine/x/a/o leaders and organizations dedicated to creating and implementing a unified agenda to guide our advocacy, policy, and service provisions and strengthen relationships across Oregon. The purpose of VCO is to build out a statewide strategy that has representation from the continental Americas and collective infrastructure centering Latinx/a/e/o, Indigena, Afro\-Latine/x/a/o communities to help advance the wellbeing of all Oregon communities. VCO is in an early developmental stage as an organization. Like many emerging organizations rooted in movement values, we are building infrastructure, programs, policies, and culture in real time while simultaneously carrying a bold mission and deep commitment to community.

**Values**

* In Lak’ech Ala K’in – You Are My Other Me (K’iche Maya)
* Cariño – Our Ability To See Each Other and To Be Seen
* Humility – We Are One Piece of the Puzzle, there are others that started this work and will continue the work.
* Relationship to and Responsibility for Land
* Health, Spirituality, Well\-being, and Healing
* Collaboration – Building Off Each Other Strengths
* Our Community is Powerful When Organized!
* The Diversity in the Diaspora of our Latin American Culture – Embrace it and Address Our Internalized Oppression.
* Intersectionality Needs to be Cross\-Cultural, Intergenerational, and with Solidarity.
* “The Fierce Urgency of Now.” – MLK, Jr.

**Vision**

* An Oregon where the diaspora of Latine/x/a/os is embraced and where our communities can organize interculturally, intergenerationally, and intersectionally.
* We envision a green space where our children can play.
* We envision beautiful and diverse neighborhoods where all are welcome.
* We envision healthy food that is connected to our roots.
* We envision collective wealth that is community owned and led.
* We envision the Latine/x/a/o community changing the face of Oregon through its vote and its voice–families voting together and making a difference.
* We envision a statewide Latine/x/a/o community that is connected.
* We envision an Oregon where our cultural traditions are celebrated and valued.
* We envision an Oregon where we are home and we belong.

**Key Responsibilities**

The Eastern Oregon Regional Hub Organizer is responsible for:

**Program Development \& Planning**

* Implement VCO’s Regional Hubs plan in alignment with the Hub Charter and statewide mechanisms, with specific focus on the Eastern Oregon region.
* Support the development of annual hub goals, timelines, and deliverables, ensuring regional priorities feed into VCO’s statewide advocacy agenda.

**Leadership Development \& Organizing**

* Identify, recruit, and support community leaders through culturally rooted engagement methods (e.g., town halls, home visits, listening sessions, canvassing, phone banking).
* Train and mentor Hub Co\-Chairs and community members in leadership development, organizing skills, and campaign strategy.
* Build intergenerational and intercultural leadership pipelines to strengthen long\-term organizing power.

**Messaging, Campaigns \& Coalition Engagement**

* Draft and adapt multilingual talking points, testimonies, speeches, and social media content for hub priorities.
* Collaborate with the Executive Director to ensure consistent messaging, brand alignment, and media amplification of hub voices.
* Support campaign development and management, including direct actions, resource sharing, and coordinated advocacy with coalition partners.

**Stakeholder Engagement \& Policy Advocacy**

* Cultivate relationships with community organizations, local leaders, elected officials, and coalition partners in the region.
* Mobilize hub members to participate in statewide campaigns, legislative testimony, and lobbying.
* Coordinate rapid response communications and actions when urgent issues arise in the region.

**Hub Infrastructure \& Data Management**

* Plan and facilitate quarterly hub meetings, ensuring participatory decision\-making and accountability to board\-approved policies.
* Enter and track data in VCO’s statewide registry/EveryAction database, capturing both qualitative stories and quantitative engagement metrics.
* Maintain accurate records of regional leaders, affiliates, and organizational partners.

**Evaluation \& Accountability**

* Track and report on hub performance metrics (participation, leadership growth, data contributions, and policy impact) for quarterly reviews and board reporting.
* Document lessons learned, emerging regional issues, and community feedback to refine hub strategy.

**Minimum Job Requirements**

Bachelor’s degree and three (3\) to five (5\) years of related experience are required. An equivalent combination of education and experience sufficient to demonstrate the ability to perform the duties of the position may be considered.

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**

We believe in personal and professional growth and transformation. The work history and experience of the successful candidate will include:

* Strong organizational, planning, and time management skills, with the ability to balance multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and maintain attention to detail in a fast\-paced environment**.**
* Proficiency in office systems and communications technology tools (e.g., Google Workspace, Zoom, project/task management software, EveryAction, or comparable CRM platforms).
* Proven facilitation and coalition\-building experience with diverse stakeholders in grassroots or policy settings.
* Excellent facilitation, administrative, and communications skills, including professional writing, editing, and verbal communication in both English and Spanish.
* Strong problem\-solving and sound judgment, with the ability to work independently while thriving in a collaborative team environment.
* Experience designing, implementing, and evaluating plans, projects, and organizational systems with measurable outcomes.
* Demonstrated commitment to equity, inclusion, and community\-centered values, with the ability to work effectively across cultures, languages, and identities.
* Ability and willingness to travel within Oregon for regional hub meetings and events; valid driver’s license and reliable transportation required.

**Preferred Skills and Abilities**

* Bilingual fluency in Spanish; additional languages relevant to Oregon’s Afro, Indígena, and Latine/x/a/o communities strongly preferred.
* Bicultural and/or professional experience working directly with Afro, Indígena, and Latine/x/a/o communities in Oregon, with demonstrated cultural humility and equity\-centered practice.
* High adaptability and initiative, with the ability to anticipate organizational needs, comfortable with ambiguity, propose solutions, and thrive in a start\-up nonprofit environment during a period of transition and growth.
* Willingness to engage in difficult conversations, share feedback, and cultivate a culture of accountability and relationship building.
* Flexibility to work evenings and weekends as needed, particularly for community events, statewide gatherings, and rapid\-response activities.
* Strong ties to Oregon’s communities, or willingness to relocate and establish deep connections across the state.

**Working Conditions, Hours, and Location**

This full\-time position is hybrid at least until July 1st, 2027\. The typical work week will be 9 am\-5 pm Monday through Friday, and some weekends scheduled. Flexibility to work non\-traditional office hours, including nights, weekends, and a willingness to travel within Oregon, is required.

While working from home, personal, stable, and high\-speed internet access will be required to perform the functions of this position. There may be occasions that require employees scheduled to be working from home to report to the office or alternative working location.

Every effort will be made to provide reasonable notice. However, employees may be required to report to an in\-person office or alternative working location on short notice.

The physical demands described here represent those that an employee must meet to perform the essential functions of this position successfully. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the functions. While performing the duties of this position, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear. The employee frequently is required to use hands or fingers, handle or feel objects, tools, or controls. The employee is occasionally required to stand, walk, sit, and reach with hands and arms. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds. Specific vision abilities this position requires include close vision, distance vision, and the ability to adjust focus. The noise level in the work environment is usually low to moderate.

**Process and Timeline**

Applications will be accepted on a rolling basis and will be reviewed beginning the week of September 28th. Applications received after Friday, October 2nd, COB (Close of Business) may not be reviewed.

**To Apply**

Please send the following to info@visioncomunitaria.org with the subject line “Eastern Oregon Regional Hub Organizer Application: Your First and Last Name”. Finalists will be asked for references. Please include the following as part of your application:

* Cover Letter
* Resume

**Visión Comunitaria de Oregon’s Work Culture**

* VCO is a Latine culturally specific organization grounded in collective and culturally rooted movement values, particularly in service to Afro\-Latine and Indígena communities.
* We are committed to operationalizing racial justice, gender justice, and economic justice practices within our organization to sustain a multiracial, multiethnic coalition with integrity.
* VCO operates at the intersection of organizing, culture, identity, leadership, and systems change, which will require us to lean into difficult conversations and stay connected through ambiguity, difference, tension, healing, and change.
* We encourage shared voice, mutual respect, and collective problem\-solving while fostering the leadership of staff and volunteers.
* We are committed to building a healthy organizational culture that is both accountable and relationship\-oriented.
* We grapple with the “fierce urgency of now” and building an intentional and authentic organization and programs, centering rural communities.
* VCO is an organization in formation that may require staff to be co\-creators and adapt as needs are uncovered or systems evolve.

**Equal Opportunity Employer**

Visión Comunitaria de Oregon is committed to advancing equity in all we do. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, marital or familial status, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, or any other basis prohibited by local, state, or federal law. We encourage people of all backgrounds to apply, including people of color, women, LGBTQ individuals, people with disabilities, veterans, and others who demonstrate the ability to help us achieve our vision. Successful candidates will commit to an equitable and inclusive workplace, including but not limited to racial equity, accessibility for individuals with disabilities, use of gender\-inclusive language, and cultural sensitivity.

As an Equal Opportunity Employer, Visión Comunitaria de Oregon does not discriminate in employment based on race, color, religion, sex, or national origin. Qualified applicants are considered for all positions without regard to age, marital status, sexual orientation, or the presence of a non\-job\-related medical condition or handicap.

description:
**About Us**



Super Star Car Wash is a leading provider of car wash, detail, and lubrication services across Arizona, California, Texas, and Colorado. Our mission is simple: fast, high\-quality, professional service in a friendly atmosphere \- while creating a rewarding environment for our Team Members. We believe unforgettable experiences are created one interaction at a time. That's what being SUPER is all about.


This role will be based in our North Phoenix corporate office and will work in office 3 days with the option to work remotely 2 days per week.


**About the Role**



The Instructional Designer is responsible for designing, building, and maintaining training content within the company's Learning Management System (LMS), Opus. This role owns assigned content development from needs assessment through design, development, launch, and ongoing improvement, with direction and supervision from the Manager or Director. The Instructional Designer partners with subject matter experts and business leaders to identify learning needs, gather and validate content, and create clear, engaging, and practical learning experiences aligned with brand and operational standards.



Beyond content creation, this person must be a confident, credible presenter across very different settings: leading virtual sessions in Microsoft Teams, presenting to large in\-person audiences (all\-hands meetings, leadership conferences, regional trainings), and delivering hands\-on training at the store level with small frontline teams. The ability to adjust tone, pacing, and delivery style across these formats is essential to the role.


**Key Responsibilities**

**Course Development \& Design**


* **Assess Training Needs:** Conduct needs assessments with business leaders, subject matter experts, and stakeholders to identify performance needs, target audiences, desired outcomes, and appropriate training solutions.
* **Build Courses:** Build and format training content in Opus, including text, images, videos, knowledge checks, assignments, and other learning activities.
* **Design Content:** Create course outlines, learning scripts, interactive content, and assessments that translate operational information into clear, engaging, and practical training.
* **Collaborate:** Partner with subject matter experts and stakeholders to gather and validate content, clarify processes and requirements, and ensure training is accurate and current.
* **Review \& Test:** Review training for accuracy, clarity, consistency, instructional effectiveness, and functionality, including links, media, and assessments, before launch.
* **Maintain Content:** Review and update existing training to keep content accurate, current, and aligned with operational and brand standards; correct broken links and other content or functionality issues.


**Cross\-Departmental Partnership \& LMS Support**


* **Serve as Point of Contact:** Serve as the primary point of contact for departments requesting new or updated training content in Opus (Operations, HR, Safety, Marketing, IT, etc.).
* **Manage Content Requests:** Guide stakeholders through the content\-development process from initial request and needs assessment through design, review, build, testing, and launch.
* **Support LMS Administration:** Support Opus administration, including course organization, catalog structure, user groups, and assignment rules, in partnership with appropriate system administrators.
* **Troubleshoot LMS Issues:** Help identify and resolve course enrollment, completion, reporting, and content\-related issues in Opus, escalating system issues when needed.
* **Apply Content Standards:** Follow established templates, style guides, instructional design standards, and brand guidelines to ensure consistency across training content.
* **Support LMS Reporting:** Pull and interpret Opus completion and compliance reports to support training follow\-up, evaluation, and business needs.


**Physical \& Environmental Requirements**



The role requires keyboarding, hearing, and verbal communication, along with frequent standing and walking, and periodic bending, twisting, kneeling, crouching, and mobility across uneven surfaces. title: Marketing and Communications Specialist
description:
**Who We Are and What We Do**

Save The Bay’s mission is to protect and restore the Bay for people and wildlife. We are the only regional organization that integrates political advocacy, wetland restoration, and education to shape a healthy and resilient region. We are a team of passionate, creative, strategic and collaborative people, dedicated to the urgent work of building Bay Area resilience and hope in the face of the escalating impacts of climate change.

Over two decades, Save The Bay has become a Bay Area leader in the science and practice of habitat restoration, focused on tidal marsh transition zone habitat at landscape\-scale for recovery of endangered species, and for ecosystem resilience in the face of climate change. We enlist thousands of volunteers annually to restore the shoreline and educate Bay Area students to be the next generation of Bay stewards through hands\-on experiential education and online learning.

**Position Summary**

The Marketing \& Communications Specialist advances Save The Bay's mission by developing the stories, messaging, and campaigns that connect the organization's programs to the people who need to hear about them – volunteers, donors, event attendees, petition signers, and dedicated community members. This role is central to growing Save The Bay's constituency and building the support\-to\-donor pipeline.

The right candidate brings a strong visual eye, a clear narrative voice, and comfort working across multiple platforms and tools – from social media and Asana to CMS and CRM systems. This position reports to the Director of Communications.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

**Storytelling, Narrative, \& Communications – 40%** 

* Implement the marketing and communications strategy, developing stories and campaigns that support program impact, fundraising, and audience engagement
* Collaborate across teams to identify stories and develop communications that convey impact, mobilize supporters, and deepen engagement
* Write, edit, and review content across digital and print media including blog posts, newsletters, email appeals, and advocacy materials. Partner with the Communications Coordinator on social content and cross\-channel production
* Build and manage email communications, audience segmentation, and cultivation journeys across supporter groups — subscribers, volunteers, event attendees, and donors
* Manage the editorial calendar balancing engagement with list health and maintaining alignment with the overall communications plan
* Protect and apply brand standards across all content and platforms, maintaining consistent voice, tone, and visual identity

**Constituency Growth \& Audience Development – 40%**

* Execute, analyze and refine constituency growth campaigns and strategies to grow Save The Bay’s email list, supporter base, and donor pipeline
* Support the execution of paid acquisition campaigns (Meta ads, list buys, petition\-based acquisition) and help track performance against cost\-per\-acquisition and engagement benchmarks
* Maintain acquisition dashboard tracking subscriber growth, engagement rates, and donor conversion by source
* Identify and pursue cross\-promotion opportunities with allied organizations, outdoor recreation groups, and community partners to expand reach
* Manage influencer relationships and activations in coordination with external partners

**Events – 10%**

* Project\-manage Save The Bay’s communications\-driven programs and events — including Climate Conversations and Bay Trail community events
* Provide on\-site support during Save The Bay events, assisting with logistics and capturing communications content
* Support communications for organization\-wide events led by other teams, collaborating with the Coordinator on email campaigns, event materials, and social content

**Workflow \& Operations – 10%**

* Manage the day\-to\-day communications workflow, ensuring projects stay on track and deadlines are met
* Support internal training and onboarding for staff on digital tools and best practices, including email marketing platforms, Pardot, and content management systems

**Other duties as assigned.** 

**Qualifications and Experience**

**Experience**

* 3\-5 years of experience in communications, digital marketing, or content strategy
* Experience supporting email list or digital audience growth through a combination of organic and paid channels
* Experience with email marketing strategy, including segmentation, automation, and performance optimization
* A bachelor’s degree in communications, marketing, journalism, or a related field is preferred but not required. Equivalent work experience will be considered

**Key Skills \& Competencies**

* Strong writing, editing, and storytelling skills with the ability to craft compelling narratives for diverse audiences across email, web, and campaign formats
* Proficiency with email marketing platforms (Pardot or similar marketing automation tools) and CRM systems (Salesforce experience a plus)
* Working knowledge of HTML and CSS, particularly as applied to email templates and web content with ability to review, troubleshoot, and refine layouts
* A strong visual eye and brand instinct, evaluating design, tone, and visual consistency across materials and giving clear feedback to the Coordinator and external designers
* Experience with digital advertising (Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads) for audience acquisition.
* Working knowledge of website content management (WordPress), SEO fundamentals, and web analytics (Google Analytics)
* Comfort with data: able to read analytics dashboards, track KPIs, and use performance data to inform decisions

**Leadership \& Interpersonal Skills**

* Collaborative and proactive approach, with the ability to work across departments, manage competing priorities, and move work forward without waiting to be asked
* Strong project management skills, able to manage multiple workstreams, coordinate across teams, and meet deadlines. Experience with Asana or similar tools preferred
* A commitment to equity, inclusion, and respectful communication in all aspects of work

**Other Requirements**

* Passion for environmental protection, outdoor recreation, or community\-based advocacy
* Willingness to work occasional evenings or weekends for events as needed
* Clean background check

**Position Logistics**

**Location:** Our work is performed mostly remotely with periodic in\-person staff and team meetings in our office based in Oakland, CA, and our various restoration sites around the San Francisco Bay Area. Employees must reside in California / Bay Area.

**Compensation and Benefits**

This is a regular, full\-time, non\-exempt position. Starting wage for this position is $38\.34 per hour and is not subject to negotiation. We provide annual cost\-of\-living increase each January 1, and additional 3 percent increases at service mileposts of 3 years in the position, 5 years, 10 years and subsequent 5\-year intervals. To maintain internal pay equity, we do not utilize individual merit increases. We offer an excellent benefit package including medical, dental, vision, acupuncture/chiropractic, and life insurance; 12 paid vacation days per year to start, 13\-14 paid holidays and 12 days of sick leave per calendar year; 403(b) retirement plan; stipend for working remotely and funds for home office workstation equipment and furniture.

**How To Apply**: This position is open until filled. To apply, please email a cover letter and resume to jobs@savesfbay.org. Please make sure to include the position title –**Marketing \& Communications Specialist** – in the subject line. In the body of the email, please share where you found this job listing.

**Hiring Timeline** (This is our ideal timeline, but it may be subject to changes):

* The priority deadline for applications is **September 25, 2026**
* We will review resumes and conduct interviews on a rolling basis
* Finalists will be invited to submit three references
* We would like to make an offer to a candidate by **Mid\-October** and have the candidate start on **November 3\.**

**COVID\-19 Policy:** All new hires must be fully vaccinated prior to their start of employment unless they are pre\-qualified by HR for exemption.

**Work Environment:** We welcome people of all cultural backgrounds, gender expression and sexual orientation to apply and thrive with our growing team. Save The Bay is an equal opportunity employer that strives to recruit a diverse workforce and provide an equitable, and inclusive workplace for all.

**DEI Statement:** Committed to attracting and retaining a diverse staff, Save The Bay will honor your experiences, perspectives and unique identity. Together, our community strives to create and maintain working environments that are inclusive, equitable and welcoming.

**Our Leadership Philosophy:** At Save the Bay, we take a person\-centered approach to leadership. As leaders, we strive to embody our organizational core values and create a work environment that fosters belonging, authenticity, accountability, and care.

**Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion (DEI) – Progress and Commitment**

Save The Bay has been reckoning with our positionality within a predominantly white\-led environmental movement, evolving our workplace practices and our program approaches. Most of our DEI efforts began and continue to be fueled by employee leaders, who have informed and continue to influence our internal practices and investments, mission\-driven programs and community partnerships. Staff and board input helped create our organizational core values that guide Save The Bay’s leadership philosophy and operations and our Strategic Plan.

We are working to build more respectful and inclusive working environments and have updated our hiring practices to advance inclusiveness and reduce bias. We have implemented new compensation practices to support greater transparency, equity and competitiveness, and established a Living Wage floor. We adopted a new performance management system designed to provide structured, supportive, and regular opportunities for conversation and feedback between supervisors and their direct reports. We have taken steps to expand investment in professional development for all staff, tailored to individual needs with supervisor support.

Our programming embraces community\-driven efforts that seek to reduce the impacts of climate change in our region, and we work to expand funding and support for frontline communities on the Bay shoreline. We offer affinity\-based volunteer programs led by staff who share those identities and are designed to invite a broad range of participants to share in the work of habitat restoration. We strive to be accountable and effective allies with indigenous peoples and environmental justice advocates.

We continue to commit time and resources to advance DEI efforts and work toward more equitable outcomes. We seek candidates who will help us advance this work, understanding that it demands compassion, resilience, patience, and endurance, along with a willingness to learn and grow alongside others.

description:
*Hybrid office hours \- in office Monday through Thursday, remote Fridays* 




  





 The Director, Marketing will be responsible for developing and executing the brand marketing strategy and annual marketing calendar for the U.S. market, with responsibility for key collections within the Bulova brand portfolio, including Accutron within the Bulova business. Reporting to the SVP Marketing, Bulova, this role will own all elements of the marketing process—from consumer insight gathering and strategic planning to campaign development, execution, and performance measurement—with the goal of building brand awareness, strengthening brand equity, and driving consumer consideration for new product launches and core collections across the Bulova ecosystem.
 



  





**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES** 



* Develop and execute integrated marketing strategies that increase brand awareness, drive consumer engagement, and support business growth across assigned Bulova collections, including the Accutron portfolio.
* Lead the annual marketing planning process, establishing strategic priorities and marketing calendars aligned with business objectives and direction from the SVP Marketing, Bulova.
* Partner with PR, Social Media, Creative, Digital Marketing, Media, Sales, Product Development, and Consumer Insights teams to develop and execute best\-in\-class, omnichannel marketing campaigns.
* Develop comprehensive campaign briefs and ensure consistent brand messaging across all consumer touchpoints.
* Manage marketing initiatives from concept through execution, measurement, and optimization, ensuring projects are delivered on time and within budget.
* Identify and cultivate strategic partnerships, collaborations, and experiential marketing opportunities that enhance brand relevance and consumer engagement.
* Leverage consumer insights, competitive analysis, and performance analytics to identify growth opportunities and inform marketing strategy.
* Serve as the primary marketing lead for assigned collections, partnering closely with Citizen Watch America leadership, global markets, agency partners, and cross\-functional teams to ensure successful execution of marketing initiatives.
* Champion innovation by identifying emerging trends in luxury, fashion, digital marketing, and consumer behavior to keep the brand culturally relevant and competitive.



  





**QUALIFICATIONS** 



* Proven leadership skills with the ability to influence and collaborate across cross\-functional teams.
* Strategic thinker with strong business acumen and the ability to translate consumer insights into impactful marketing strategies.
* Exceptional communication, presentation, and relationship management skills.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and project management capabilities.
* Digital\-first mindset with experience leading integrated marketing campaigns across paid, owned, earned, and retail channels.
* **Required:** 
 Experience marketing luxury consumer brands, with a strong preference for jewelry, watches, fashion, or other premium lifestyle categories.
* Demonstrated ability to steward premium brands while balancing commercial objectives with long\-term brand equity.



  





**EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE** 




 Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field required. MBA is a plus.
 



  





 15\+ years of progressive marketing experience, including experience developing integrated brand strategies for luxury consumer brands. Experience in jewelry, watches, fashion, or other premium lifestyle categories is strongly preferred. Proven success leading cross\-functional teams, managing agency partners, and delivering measurable business results.

description:
Figma is growing our team of passionate creatives and builders on a mission to make design accessible to all. Figma’s platform helps teams bring ideas to life—whether you're brainstorming, creating a prototype, translating designs into code, or iterating with AI. If you're excited to shape the future of design and collaboration, join us!

Our unified platform bridges the gap between AI capabilities and human creativity, and lets professional creatives and designers harness the power of the world’s leading AI models without losing precision, expression, or soul. Together, we’re building tools that help people move faster without sacrificing quality, precision, or craft — a platform where AI supports creativity instead of flattening it.
   

  

 We’re looking for a marketing leader who can make Figma Weave the name people think of for AI\-native creative work — and build the brand, the demand, and the team to get there. You’ll own marketing for Weave end to end, operating with the autonomy of a startup and the reach of Figma behind you. Generative media is one of the most exciting and fast\-moving spaces in technology. The opportunity is enormous and the audience is passionate. Whoever defines what great AI\-native creative tooling looks like and makes the world believe it wins. That story is yours to tell.

* Experience as an executive marketing leader who has built brand and driven growth at a high\-growth software, SaaS, or consumer\-tech company

title: Director of Engineering - Quality & Reliability
description:
**COMPANY:** Canoe Intelligence

**WEBSITE**: https://canoeintelligence.com/

**TITLE:** **Director of Engineering \- Quality \& Reliability**

**LOCATION:** New York City (hybrid)


**SALARY**: $200,000 \- $230,000 base salary

**The Role:**


We are seeking an experienced engineering leader to build and lead our Quality and Reliability organization. AI\-native development practices have significantly increased our engineering velocity, and this role owns the other half of that equation: ensuring the software we ship is reliable, performant, and trustworthy as we scale. The ideal candidate will have built a reliability or quality engineering practice from the ground up and will bring deep quality expertise to an established QA team. This role is an exciting opportunity to stand up a new Site Reliability Engineering function, take formal ownership of incident management across the company, and lead a talented quality organization. The role reports to the VP of Application Development as a peer of our other engineering guild leads.

 **What You’ll Do:**

* Build Canoe's Site Reliability Engineering practice from the ground up, including SLOs and error budgets on critical services, observability and alerting standards, production readiness reviews, and on\-call design.
* Own incident management across Canoe end to end, including process, tooling, escalation paths, retrospective quality, and follow\-through on corrective actions.
* Lead our Quality Engineering organization and build lasting in\-house quality leadership and expertise.
* Define a risk\-based quality strategy, including quality gates in our CI/CD pipelines, and continue our shift from manual verification toward automation\-first, AI\-assisted testing and specification\-driven development.
* Define and report executive\-level KPIs for quality and reliability, such as escape rates, incident trends, and error\-budget consumption, and use them to inform engineering priorities across teams.
* Serve as Technical Governance Owner for our testing and incident management topics, bringing a reliability, testability, and operability perspective to technical decisions in partnership with our architects.

 **What We’re Looking For:**

* Minimum of 10 years of software engineering experience, including 4 years leading quality, reliability, or platform engineering teams.
* Experience building an SRE, reliability, or quality engineering practice from scratch, rather than inheriting a mature one.
* Experience formally owning incident management for a company or major platform, from incident response through high\-quality retrospectives and follow\-through.
* Deep quality engineering background, including ownership of quality strategy and experience leading distributed or offshore QA teams.
* Demonstrated expertise applying LLMs and agentic tools such as Claude Code to real engineering workflows, with a concrete point of view on how AI reshapes testing and verification.
* Fluency with quality and reliability metrics such as escape rate, flake rate, MTTD/MTTR, and SLO attainment, including experience reporting them at the executive level.
* Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills with geographically distributed teams across multiple time zones.
* Ability to work effectively with ambiguous or missing information and adapt quickly in a startup\-like environment.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).

 **Preferred Experience**

* Hands\-on experience with our core technologies or similar stacks: Python, TypeScript, PHP/Laravel, Kafka, AWS, Terraform, PostgreSQL, Redis, ElasticSearch, Datadog.
* Fintech or other environments where data integrity and client trust are the product.

 **What You’ll Get:**

* Medical, dental, vision benefits
* Flexible PTO
* 401(k)
* Flexible work from home policy
* Home office stipend
* Employee Assistance Program
* Gym/Wifi reimbursement
* Education assistance
* Parental Leave

 **Our Values:**

* Client First —\> Listen, and deliver client\-centric solutions
* Be An Owner —\> Take initiative, improve situations, drive positive outcomes
* Excellence —\> Always set the highest standard for yourself and others
* Win Together —\> 1 \+ 1 \= 3

**Who We Are:**


Canoe is reimagining alternative investment data processes for hundreds of leading institutional investors, capital allocators, asset servicing firms and wealth managers. By combining industry expertise with the most sophisticated data capture technologies, Canoe’s technology automates the highly\-frustrating, time\-consuming, and costly manual workflows related to alternative investment document and data management, extraction and delivery. With Canoe, clients can refocus capital and human resources on business performance and growth, increase efficiency, and gain deeper access to their data. Canoe’s AI\-driven platform was developed in 2013 for Portage Partners LLC, a private investment firm.


Canoe is an equal opportunity employer. All aspects of employment including the decision to hire, promote, discipline, or discharge, will be based on merit, competence, performance, and business needs. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, marital status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic information, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other status protected under federal, state, or local law.

**Hiring Department**
---------------------

  


The University of Texas Permian Basin welcomes applications for the position of Director of Enrollment Management Systems and Slate Captain

 **Salary Range**


$95,000\.00 depending on qualifications  

  

Remote work / hybrid arrangements may be considered for highly qualified candidate.


**Essential Functions**
-----------------------

  


The Director of Enrollment Management Systems and Slate Captain provides functional leadership for Enrollment Management systems, Slate CRM governance, system optimization, data integrity, reporting, process design, user support, and continued system expansion in support of the University’s enrollment goals. This position serves as the lead functional administrator and primary technical expert for Technolutions Slate CRM and works closely with Undergraduate Admissions, Undergraduate Recruiting, Dual Credit, the Welcome Center, Graduate Admissions, Communications and Marketing, the Registrar’s Office, Information Technology, Student Affairs, and other campus partners. The position supervises assigned staff directly or indirectly, provides leadership over assigned cost\-center responsibilities, and coordinates approved vendor and service\-provider work related to Slate and Enrollment Management systems. The role strengthens enrollment operations by improving system use, documentation, access governance, reporting, and cross\-functional processes while distinguishing Slate functional ownership from institution\-wide IT architecture or final admissions policy authority.  

  

Slate Administration and Technical Support  

  

1\. Serve as the lead functional administrator, primary technical expert, and Slate Captain for Technolutions Slate CRM.  

  

2\. Maintain comprehensive knowledge of Slate structures, tables, forms, data integrity practices, security, user profiles, access levels, and data flow across processes and units.  

  

3\. Train users and provide technical and functional support for local and baseline Slate processes.  

  

4\. Write and test SQL\-supported Slate processes, analyze technical and functional issues, respond to ad hoc information requests, and develop written procedures for system processes.  

  

5\. Serve as the primary functional contact for SQL\-supported Slate process design and related enrollment systems workflows.  

  

6\. Coordinate with outside vendors and system partners, including Common Application, ApplyTexas, CRM systems, Smartsheet, and other partners, to support approved configurations, vendor file processes, data exchange, and critical Enrollment Management workflows.  

  

7\. Design, configure, test, and implement Slate tools that support recruitment, application management, yield, communication, and enrollment operations.  

  

Enrollment Systems Management and Optimization  

  

8\. Provide leadership for Enrollment Management systems, Slate projects, system governance, process design, and system optimization.  

  

9\. Oversee and document current and proposed operational processes that support data integrity for Slate, admissions applications, vendor files, Banner\-related enrollment processes, and related Enrollment Management workflows in collaboration with the appropriate system owners.  

  

10\. Create, test, and maintain data imports and exports, including Common Application, ApplyTexas, Encoura, College Board, EAB, data sharing agreements with ISD and transfer partners, and other vendor files.  

  

11\. Work with users to monitor, integrate, automate, and troubleshoot Slate data transfers and develop operational reporting.  

  

12\. Build and maintain Slate\-hosted applications, forms, portals, and related tools to support import, mapping, review, communication, reporting, and enrollment data processes.  

  

13\. Regularly assess Slate and related Enrollment Management systems and make strategic and operational improvement recommendations to Enrollment Management leadership.  

  

14\. Develop and maintain a roadmap for continued Slate expansion, optimization, training, documentation, and system adoption.  

  

Data Integrity, Reporting, and Documentation  

  

15\. Maintain data integrity by developing, scheduling, and performing regular data audits, cleanup projects, and quality\-control reviews.  

  

16\. Respond to ad hoc information requests related to Slate, admissions, recruitment, enrollment operations, and enrollment system processes.  

  

17\. Develop and maintain written procedures for Slate processes, reporting, data transfers, access governance, user support, and system workflows.  

  

18\. Prepare reports, data summaries, dashboards, and system documentation to support Enrollment Management operations, leadership review, process improvement, and data\-informed decisions.  

  

Slate Governance and System Access  

  

19\. Develop and maintain a Slate governance structure that supports information security, appropriate system access, consistent practices, and functional accountability within Enrollment Management.  

  

20\. Develop and maintain system access governance for Slate users and related Enrollment Management systems in alignment with institutional security expectations.  

  

21\. Co\-manage internal and external Slate user accounts, roles, permissions, and access reviews in support of governance and security.  

  

Project Leadership and Cross Departmental Coordination  

  

22\. Lead project management and planning related to Slate implementation, optimization, continued expansion, training, documentation, and process improvement.  

  

23\. Develop project timelines, evaluate project effectiveness, and help create the annual Enrollment Management systems and technology timeline.  

  

24\. Serve on the Enrollment Management Leadership Team and represent Slate and Enrollment Management systems needs in leadership discussions.  

  

25\. Serve as the primary Enrollment Management liaison with Information Technology, Institutional Effectiveness, Academic Affairs, Finance, and other departments for business needs related to Slate and related enrollment systems.  

  

26\. Lead or participate in cross\-departmental projects related to Slate, Enrollment Management systems, admissions operations, system\-enabled student services, and related process improvements.  

  

27\. Provide support to Enrollment Management and Student Affairs leadership on changes and innovations that improve student services and enrollment operations.  

  

Staff Supervision, Training, User Support, and Cost\-Center Leadership  

  

28\. Supervise directly and indirectly assigned staff responsible for Enrollment Management systems, including Slate, by assigning work, setting expectations, monitoring work quality, providing guidance, and supporting performance feedback through established University processes.


29\. Coordinate and provide timely staff and user training for effective Slate use, reporting, documentation, access governance, and consistent process execution.  

  

30\. Serve as a Slate resource for users across the University, including Communications and Marketing, Information Technology, Academic Advising, Alumni Engagement, Student Engagement, Athletics, Dual Credit, and other units using or affected by Slate processes.  

  

31\. Coordinate with approved vendors and contracted service providers related to Slate or Enrollment Management systems, support implementation of approved service scopes, and route procurement, contract approval, or budget approval matters through established University channels.  

  

32\. Provide leadership over assigned cost\-center responsibilities by monitoring system\-related needs, supporting budget planning information, tracking approved expenditures, and escalating final budget decisions through established University channels.  

  

33\. Perform other related duties as assigned by the immediate supervisor. The job description is not a complete list of all responsibilities and duties performed by employees.


**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------



1\. Master’s degree from an accredited college or university.
  

  

2\. Three (3\) years of experience with Technolutions Slate CRM or comparable higher education CRM administration.
  

  

3\. Experience managing or supervising full\-time staff, including assigning work, monitoring performance or work quality, and providing training or guidance.
  

  

4\. Experience supporting enrollment systems, admissions operations, student information systems, data imports and exports, reporting, or system process improvement.
  

  

5\. Experience developing documentation, procedures, training materials, reports, or process workflows for system users.

description:
**Meet True Vet**

**At True Vet Solutions, we believe no veteran should have to fight alone for what they already earned.**


Every day in America, veterans walk away from disability benefits they qualify for, not because they don't deserve them, but because the system meant to serve them is slow, confusing, and built to wear people down. We exist to change that. We stand between the veteran and the system, and we do not stop until they receive every benefit they earned.


We are a team of high\-empathy, high\-standards people doing work that actually matters. We answer the call when someone who served is at the end of their rope, and we turn it into an outcome that changes their life. The proof is in what our clients live:

* Tens of thousands of veterans represented
* $350M\+ in lifetime benefits secured for the people who served
* 4\.9\-star client rating across 634 reviews

**Where we're going**


We are not building a small shop that helps a few hundred veterans a year. There are millions of veterans in this country leaving earned benefits on the table, and we intend to reach them. We are building the most trusted veteran advocacy organization in America, and we are building it fast. If you are looking for a ceiling, this is the wrong place. If you are looking for a mission big enough to spend a career on, and a company moving fast enough for you to grow into the leader you're capable of becoming, keep reading.

**THE MANDATE**


You own the performance, integrity, and growth of our national advocate network. You build the teams, set the standard, hold the line on compliance, and expand our reach into every community where veterans need us. This is a builder’s seat: field\-operations leadership at national scale, with the mandate and the runway to construct the systems behind it.

**WHAT YOU’LL OWN**

* Team \& Talent: Recruit, onboard, and develop advocates and field leaders across every market. Set the hiring, training, and onboarding standards that scale cleanly as we grow.
* Performance \& Accountability: Own productivity, lead quality, and outreach output. Run evaluations, audits, and corrective action; design the incentives and recognition that move results.
* Integrity \& Compliance: Guarantee every client engagement is ethical, accurate, and mission\-aligned. Investigate concerns, close gaps, and build durable controls that protect veterans and the firm.
* Reach \& Partnerships: Build relationships with veteran groups, nonprofits, healthcare partners, and event hosts. Represent the organization wherever veterans gather and turn reach into opportunity.
* Operating System: Translate outreach and performance data into decisions. Inform budget and resourcing, and architect the scalable systems that carry national expansion.

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE IN THE FIRST 12 MONTHS**

* A staffed, trained, and accountable advocate network performing to one national standard.
* Lead quality and outreach output leadership can forecast and trust.
* A compliance posture that is proactive, fully documented, and defensible — by design, not by exception.
* A partnership pipeline that compounds reach quarter over quarter.

**NON\-NEGOTIABLES**

* 5\+ years leading multi\-state or national field, outreach, or operations teams.
* A proven record of building performance systems — and holding teams to them at scale.
* Fluency with CRM and reporting tools; you manage by data, not by anecdote.
* Willingness to travel nationally.

**WHAT SETS YOU APART**

* Background in veteran advocacy, disability services, or healthcare outreach.
* Experience standing up field operations from an early\-stage foundation.
* Public\-speaking range and a track record of partnership development.
* Bachelor’s degree in a related field (preferred, not required).

**Condition of Employment**


A Level 2 background check is required.

**What we offer you**

* Daily coaching and real skill development, you will be sharper in six months than you have ever been
* A clear path to grow: we promote from within and invest in the people who invest in the mission
* A team that has your back, and a standard worth being held to
* Work that lets you end the day knowing you changed the life of someone who served

**Benefits**

* Remote\-first work, from anywhere in the USA
* Employer\-sponsored medical, dental, and vision coverage
* Paid time off and company\-wide holidays
* Hospitality experiences and team gatherings that make remote feel connected

**Our Core Values**


Our values are the heart of this company. The right person for any role here recognizes themselves in each of them.

**Empathy, Without Exception**


Every veteran is a person who served, not a case number. We lead with understanding and we hold that standard on the hardest days, in the longest calls, with the most frustrated client. Empathy is the one thing we will never trade away.

**Remarkable Character**


We do right by veterans when no one is watching. We tell each other hard truths with care, accept them with humility, and keep our words and our actions pointed at the same goal.

**Relentless Advocacy**


We fight for every benefit a veteran earned, and we do not quit when the system pushes back. It is us against the issue, never us against the veteran, and never each other.

**Competitive Greatness**


We hold ourselves to an elite standard because the people who served deserve elite representation. We compound small improvements into outsized results, and we build each other into leaders along the way.

**How to apply**


If this is the mission you've been looking for, apply now. Tell us why this work matters to you, we read every one.


True Vet Solutions is an equal opportunity employer. We hire for character and capability, and we welcome applicants of every background. Veterans and military spouses are strongly encouraged to apply.
